games.title: Twist Your Path
games.description:
This is a single-player arcade game about reaction and focus. The character runs forward along a rotating trunk, and your task is to turn the path at the right moment to avoid obstacles. The longer you survive, the higher your score becomes.

You can collect coins during runs and use them to unlock new characters. The game is built for short sessions: the rules are simple, but the speed and direction changes quickly make every run tense.

games.title: Cat Block Puzzle
games.description:
Cat Block Puzzle is a fun and relaxing block slide puzzle game with a cute cat theme. 
In this game, you slide blocks across the board and arrange them to match the target picture. 
Every level gives you a new puzzle to solve, and each move matters. 
It is simple to start, but it becomes more challenging as the puzzles get harder.

games.title: Magic Potion School For Witch
games.description: Magic Potion School for Witch is an enchanting match-3 puzzle game where young witches cast spells with a wand to connect and pop numbered magical bubbles and shapes like triangles and squares in a bubbling cauldron, mastering potion brewing through increasingly challenging levels in a whimsical wizarding academy.

games.title: Chaos Arena
games.description:
Pull. Launch. CHAOS.

Fling your spinner into the arena with one simple swipe and watch the mayhem unfold! Smash into enemies, bounce off walls, and knock out every opponent to claim victory. Earn skins, beat tricky bosses, adjust your build to destroy everything.

Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Jump in, start flinging, and let the chaos begin.

games.title: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle
games.description: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle is a charming and addictive one-line puzzle game where players draw a single continuous line to connect and activate all the water pipes on the farm. Set in a vibrant, colorful cartoon farm filled with blooming flowers, cute animals, and relaxing scenery, the core gameplay revolves around clever pipe-connecting logic that challenges your spatial thinking. With its relaxing atmosphere, satisfying one-stroke mechanics, and progressively tricky levels, it brings the joy of farming and puzzle-solving together in one delightful package.

games.title: Archer Madness: Crystal Defense
games.description:
Archer Madness: Crystal Defense is an exciting casual tower defense game packed with endless waves of monsters, powerful archers, and addictive strategic gameplay!

The Crystal Core is under attack, and only you can protect it from the invading monster army. Start as a rookie archer and gradually unlock powerful abilities, upgrade your weapons, and build the ultimate defense lineup. Place Arrow Towers wisely, combine different tower skills, and create unique strategies to stop increasingly dangerous enemies.

Explore colorful worlds filled with forests, castles, and mysterious battlefields while enjoying smooth controls and satisfying combat. Collect resources, strengthen your archers, upgrade your towers, and discover powerful combinations to survive every wave.

Game Features:

• Fast-paced tower defense battles with endless monster waves
• Multiple Arrow Towers with unique skills and attack styles
• Train your archer and unlock powerful abilities
• Build different defensive formations and strategies
• Upgrade weapons, towers, and talents to defeat stronger enemies
• Bright cartoon graphics with beautiful maps and animations
• Easy to learn but challenging to master

Be brave and defend the Crystal Core! If it falls, the entire continent will become the monsters' kingdom!

games.title: Toytopia
games.description: Toytopia is a cozy merge game where you are tasked to combine and produce art materials which you can use to fix broken toys. Each toy presents a unique challenge and difficulty.

games.title: Card Sort: Challenge
games.description:
Card Sort: Challenge is a colorful logic puzzle with card sorting, tricky obstacles, boosters, daily rewards, achievements, and customization.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?

A: The game is a puzzle for sorting cards by colors.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?

A: Unique graphics, special cards, and obstacles like fog, bombs, chains, and locks.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, players need to complete more levels to earn more coins.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has currencies: gold and diamonds, which can be spent on card colors, themes, and buying boosters.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-app purchases. Players can buy diamonds, but donations do not speed up game progress as actions are limited by levels.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are there (daily, monthly, all-time, etc.)?

A: The game has daily, monthly, and all-time leaderboards sorted by win rate and number of levels completed.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can the appearance of the hero be customized, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, in the game, players can change the theme and colors of cards.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to return?

A: Yes, the game features a wheel of fortune and daily tasks.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: The game has sound, but it is not necessary for progression.

games.title: Tall Grass
games.description:
Every blade of tall grass hides something: a shard, a heart or a monster.
Trample it and find out. Cleared tiles reveal how many monsters lurk in the
eight tiles around them, so every step is a read as much as a gamble.

The gate opens before the field is cleared: leave with what you have or push
deeper for the shards and upgrades you'll need when the Pumpking wakes.

No two days play the same. The weather turns over each morning — rain slows
the waking, mist shortens what you can read, frost slows the whole field,
dusk cuts the light — and something is hiding in every field that only a
careful eye will find.

One thumb, one verb, fully turn-based: nothing happens until you move, so
there are no reflexes to fail.

games.title: DOP Fun: Delete One Part
games.description:
Play the popular logic game DOP Fun: Delete One Part! This game invites you to use logic to tackle engaging and smart puzzles, each erasure unveiling new secrets. Prepare to become a true detective as you explore images and uncover the hidden mysteries behind them. Get ready for each level to surprise you with unexpected plot twists!  

Simple and clear gameplay makes DOP Fun: Delete One Part the perfect choice for anyone looking for quality entertainment. Simply swipe the eraser across the screen to remove parts of the drawing and discover what is hidden behind it. The game is suitable for both children and adults, enhancing skills in critical thinking and attention to detail.  

Enjoy the colorful graphics and creative challenges that will keep you entertained. It strengthens mental abilities and provides tons of fun for players of all ages.

games.title: Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!
games.description:
🌟 Welcome to "Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!" — an exciting online game with ragdoll physics, where every descent turns into a real adventure! Roll, tumble, dodge obstacles and prove that you are the best in this crazy race with epic falls and popular meme heroes!

If you like such popular games as "Deadly Slide!" or "Ragdoll Crash Test: Throw and Break!", then quickly click "Play" and enjoy the exciting gameplay.

🔥 Game features:
- Simple and intuitive controls
- Funny ragdoll physics: watch your hero tumble, break and get up again! 🤸
- Cartoon 3D graphics and funny animations make every fall even funnier
- Skin shop: play as Hagi Wagi, Stickman, Noob, Obby and other popular heroes
- Compete in the leaderboard and show the best result
- Online game for any device: smartphone, PC or tablet

games.title: Talking Veggies: Meme Merge
games.description: Welcome to Talking Veggies: Meme Merge! Drop and merge hilarious talking vegetables in this addictive physics-based puzzle game. Combine two identical veggies to create a bigger one, all the way up to the legendary Boss Watermelon! Earn coins, buy crazy upgrades for your jar, and open gacha boxes to unlock rare meme skins with powerful buffs. Can you reach the ultimate high score without spilling your veggies?

games.title: 2048 Knights
games.description: 2048 Knights is a puzzle twist on the classic 2048. Slide your knights across the board, merge matching numbers to forge stronger units, and reach the goal in as few moves as you can. Every level is hand-crafted — plus daily challenges and 60-second time trials to keep you coming back.

games.title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
games.description: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle is a vibrant multiplayer party shooter that blends competition, speed, and pure joy. The core philosophy centers on "fast-paced chaotic fun," combining adorable mini-characters with intense firefights. Players face off in colorful miniature arenas, using the terrain and randomized weapon drops to outsmart opponents. What makes it stand out is its minimalist controls and high-energy gameplay, delivering an adrenaline-pumping shooting experience in bite-sized sessions, whether playing solo or against friends.

games.title: Aquarium of Surprises
games.description:
Aquarium of Surprises is a calm idle game about a small tank. Fish swim on their own and earn coins while you decide what to add next: 10 kinds of fish, 7 plants, 7 decorations and 11 upgrades, each with a clear effect.

Events arrive quietly — coin bubbles, a drifting chest, glass to clean, or one of 6 rare visitors that joins a collection of 16 creatures. Pearls unlock special decorations and 4 aquarium themes.

No timers, no pressure, no forced ads. All graphics are vector, the sound is synthesised in the browser, and the whole game is under 150 KB.

games.title: Animal Blocks
games.description: Animal Blocks is a delightful fusion of block puzzle mechanics and charming animal-themed visuals. Crafted for casual fun, this game offers a colorful and relaxing experience perfect for quick play sessions or winding down.

games.title: Match Master
games.description:
Get ready for a new, challenging and original matching pairs brain game.
You need to match 3D objects on the ground and pop them all! When you clear a level, you will find new objects to pair. Sort and find all pairs, clear the board and win!

Start searching for hidden object and matching tile pairs - Match 3D is a perfect way to zen relaxing and at the same time testing your memory and mind skills.

games.title: Chess Royale
games.description: A non-standard chess game in which kings have magical powers. The player needs to cut down the enemy king, building a victorious tactics by combining the queue of moves and magical abilities.

games.title: Drago Warrior Tower Defense
games.description: Defend your kingdom in Drago Warrior Tower Defense, an epic strategy tower defense game where ferocious dragons threaten a trapped warrior hero! As the last guardian, summon legendary heroes, command powerful dragons, and deploy diverse towers to build an impenetrable defense against waves of dark monsters. The core idea is tactical placement and skill activation—unique for its dragon-commanding mechanics, hero spells, manual targeting, and fiery boss battles that blend classic TD with mythical fantasy flair!

games.title: Retro Run
games.description: Retro Run is a free to play pc game. Players must use A and D to navigate side to side to avoid some obstacles while using orbs to smash through others. Collect power-ups along the journey to get yourself out of sticky situations. But be careful! If you lose all your orbs, you will be forced to restart. Pressing space to recall orbs or smashing special crystals throughout the progression will restore balls. Can you make it to the end?

games.title: Ninja Survival Simulator
games.description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

games.title: Castle Claw
games.description: Castle Claw is a fast arcade strategy game where every capsule pull changes the battle. Move the claw, drop it into the capsule field, summon units, and push your army toward the enemy castle. Between runs, upgrade claw size, claw speed, army health, army damage, and support claws. The game includes a 30-level campaign, endless mode, daily quests, weekly contracts, skins, command talents,  storage, lifecycle messages, and leaderboard submission.

games.title: Safari Merge
games.description:
Safari Merge is a bite-sized merge puzzle: grass sprouts onto the board, and you drag matching creatures together to combine them into the next animal up the chain. Keep the board from filling up, chain merges for combo bonuses, and unlock all 18 creatures. Each new animal comes with a real fact about how it fits into the natural world!

 -  18 creatures to discover, ordered along a real food chain
 -  A genuine animal fact with every new tier you reach
 -  Combo system that rewards fast, focused merging
 -  Three difficulties, from easy to hard
 -  Earn gems to unlock backgrounds and board tiles
 -  Plays in your browser. Mouse or touch, phone or desktop

games.title: Dragon Annihilation
games.description: These dragons from hell, under the witch's spell, are going to destroy the village you dwell! The only way to repel, is to show them the power of your shell!

games.title: Kitty Cat Merge
games.description:
It’s raining cats! 🐾
Tap, drop, and merge adorable kitties to create bigger, fluffier breeds in this addictive merge game. Simple to play, impossible to put down, and packed with nonstop kitty chaos! 😺🎉

games.title: Amigurumi: Cozy Stitches
games.description:
Welcome to your cozy amigurumi workshop! Craft adorable knitted friends with your own hands — from sweet bears and bunnies to fantastical dragons and dinosaurs.

Every toy comes to life in 4 delightful stages:
- Knit the parts by tracing spirals with your finger
- Stuff them with soft filling to perfect plumpness
- Sew on little paws, ears, and tails
- Style the face — eyes, nose, smile, and accessories

Choose your yarn color and type, fulfill customer orders, display your toys in the shop window, level up your crafter skills, and complete your full collection. New quests and bonuses await you every day!

games.title: Miscast
games.description:
Miscast is a fast 1v1 wizard duel about timing and reading your opponent. Build a loadout of 3 spells and climb an 8-mage ladder —  ach rival teaches one new trick and hands it to you when you win.

The whole game is watching the enemy's cast bar and deciding in the moment: cut a big cast with Dispel, brace with a Rune Ward or bounce it with a Mirror, or gamble that your damage lands first. Commit to a spell and you're locked in — and your foe sees it coming. Feint your own casts to bait their defenses, then punish.

Duels last 60–90 seconds. When you've beaten the ladder, take on the Daily Challenge (same seed for everyone, climb the leaderboard) or see how deep you go in Endless survival.

Features:
- 8 spells, dozens of viable loadouts (repeats allowed — three Firebolts is a real build)
- 8 distinct mage opponents, each a new tactic
- The bluff: cancel your own cast to bait a defense
- Daily Challenge with leaderboard + Endless survival mode
- Quick 60–90s duels · Mouse, keyboard, and touch · English & Portuguese

games.title: Uphill Racer2
games.description: Uphill Race2 is a fun and challenging physics-based driving game where you race across hilly terrain and rough roads. Control your car carefully, balance your speed, and climb as far as possible without flipping over. Collect coins, unlock new vehicles, and upgrade your ride to go even further. The farther you go, the harder it gets!

games.title: Exploring the Galaxy 1: Andora
games.description: Exploring the Galaxy 1: Andora — free online game. Build a planet, gather resources, craft, unlock new lands. Play in browser, no download.

games.title: Criss Cross Colors
games.description: Criss Cross Colors is a fun, addictive color-matching puzzle game that puts a vibrant twist on classic crosswords. Instead of letters, players drag and drop colorful blocks from the bottom palette to fill the grid, matching colors both horizontally and vertically to clear every square. With its simple one-tap drag controls, relaxing yet challenging gameplay, colorful cartoon style, daily rewards, hints, and timed levels, it delivers pure brain-teasing joy for all ages — the perfect mix of logic, color, and satisfaction!

games.title: Last Knight: kings throne
games.description:
This is a casual dodge arcade escape game. Play as a cute little character and keep escaping from chasing monsters on the random map. It perfectly combines fast-paced evasion gameplay, random buff items and fresh cartoon art style, bringing you relaxing and thrilling spare-time fun!

Game Highlights
Flexible free movement: Drag to control your character freely and change directions anytime to avoid incoming monsters.Random pickup buff system: Collect randomly spawned props including speed boost and monster freeze to get away from dangerous encirclement.Progressive difficulty curve: More monsters spawn and their moving speed rises continuously as your survival time extends.

Game Advantages
Easy risk avoidance tactics: Use terrain space to circle monsters and prolong your survival time for higher scores.No complicated rules: Pure casual design without tedious tutorials, instantly jump into matches after opening the game.Unlimited endless mode: Keep challenging your personal best score repeatedly for higher leaderboard rankings.

Game Features
Simple intuitive operation: Support drag control on mobile and mouse control on PC, all players can master in seconds.Compact random maps: Every round generates slightly different monster spawn positions to enrich replay experience.Lightweight instant play: Run smoothly in all browsers with zero download and installation required.

games.title: Katana Upgrade
games.description:
Upgrade your katana and create the ultimate blade!
Test your luck, strengthen your sword, and see how far you can go. One failed upgrade could destroy your progress!

games.title: Idle Magic Academy Tycoon
games.description:
Idle Magic Academy Tycoon is a charming management simulator that puts you in charge of a growing academy of sorcery. You design classrooms, recruit skilled Magisters, and gather powerful artifacts to shape each lesson. As headmaster, you guide students from simple theories to advanced combat spells, expanding your academy into a legendary center of magic.

Manage your academy wisely, constantly improve the quality of education, and transform your institution into a legendary center of arcane mastery! Develop your Academy’s infrastructure, collect Arcanum Spheres, and research magical technologies. Build your own center of magical education — step by step, classroom by classroom, artifact by artifact
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players do?
A: This is an idle tycoon game set in a magical academy. You build and upgrade various facilities, train students, and generate profits.

Q: What is the game's hook? What makes it stand out to players?
A: The game features a polished, beautiful design along with various features like daily quests, tasks, and achievements to keep players engaged.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What can be done to level up faster?
A: Success requires strategic thinking to upgrade the right functions and academy facilities. This increases your profit, which can then be reinvested into further upgrades.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Gold coins are used for upgrading academy facilities and expanding features, such as adding more student slots, increasing training speed, and improving the quality of education. Diamonds can also be purchased to speed up construction.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can players buy, and how do they affect gameplay?
A: Yes, players can purchase diamonds and an option to remove ads to speed up their progress.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to encourage player return?
A: There are daily rewards as well as free hourly chests that contain mages or in-game currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or will players face difficulties without it?
A: The sound design is high-quality, but it is not required to progress in the game.

games.title: Dark City. Multiplayer
games.description:
Dark City. Multiplayer is an online open-world horror game where players are divided into two factions: police and bandits, fighting for control over an abandoned city consumed by darkness.

The world is alive and shared among all players — every step could lead to a confrontation with an enemy... or something far worse.

The police try to restore order, protect survivors, and reclaim captured territories.

The bandits aim to establish their rule by taking over zones, setting ambushes, and hiding in the shadows.

Capture areas, hold control, fend off enemy attacks… and survive the horror slowly awakening in the depths of the city.

games.title: PathFinder
games.description: PathFinder is an engaging 2D puzzle game where players dig tunnels to guide colored balls to fit into pipes beneath the surface. Each level presents unique challenges, including obstacles like metal blocks and thorns that require strategic thinking to navigate. As you progress through the 30 levels, the puzzles become increasingly complex, demanding careful planning and problem-solving skills. For every casual gamer or a puzzle fan, PathFinder will provide hours of entertaining gameplay.

games.title: Stack Master
games.description:
Stack master is a minimalistic, endless stacking game where your goal is to build the tower as high as possible by perfectly aligning moving blocks.
The graphics are simple and clean, focusing on smooth gameplay without distractions.
You compete globally for the highest score (tower height) on leaderboards.

games.title: Hex Mine 3D
games.description:
Hex Mine 3D is a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where every move matters. Explore beautiful spherical hex worlds, clear the correct tiles, and solve carefully designed levels with logic, focus, and precision.
Each level presents a unique hex-tile pattern wrapped around a 3D globe. Your goal is simple: analyze the board, make smart choices, and complete the puzzle without mistakes. As levels progress, the layouts become more challenging with larger patterns, trickier tile placement, and deeper strategy.
Rotate, inspect, and solve each hex puzzle at your own pace. Easy to understand, satisfying to play, and challenging to master.

Features
Unique 3D hex puzzle gameplay
Beautiful globe-style puzzle boards
Carefully designed level-based progression
Simple controls and clean visual style
Increasing difficulty across many handcrafted levels
Relaxing but brain-teasing puzzle experience
Perfect for short play sessions or focused puzzle solving

games.title: Merge Emoji Arena
games.description: Merge Emoji Arena is an addictive casual idle-merge game where your favorite emojis come to life to battle! Build your ultimate army by purchasing basic emojis, merging identical ones to evolve them into stronger fighters, and deploying them to the front lines. What makes this game unique is its seamless blend of satisfying puzzle-merging with hands-free idle combat—your deployed emojis will continuously fight and farm gold for you even while you have the game running in the background!

games.title: Magic Story of Solitaire
games.description:
Welcome to the amazing and magical world of solitaire. Here you can feel at home, comfortably playing solitaire on a tavern table in the light of a fireplace or in the shade of an oak tree to the sound of a majestic waterfall.

Magic Story of Solitaire is the classic solitaire you love in an exciting new world. The card game's simple rules will help first-timers get the hang of things fast, and different challenges in the adventure ahead will keep seasoned players on their toes. But don't worry, your fairy helper will show you which magical powers to use to get out of even the toughest pinch.

What makes this game so great?
- Hundreds of fun layouts
- Beautiful and mysterious places in a magic world
- Different game challenges
- A warm, fun adventure game atmosphere
- Offline Cards Adventure

This beloved card game is perfect for everyone. We hope you enjoy your time in Magic Story of Solitaire!

games.title: DUNJUN
games.description:
Dunjun is a fast, slide-to-the-wall dungeon crawler across 60 hand-built rooms. Race the clock, dodge traps and enemies, and recover the 12 Relics of Power scattered through a cursed dungeon. 

Only the determined make it through.
Some never return.

games.title: Crazy Bob
games.description:
Ready for a crazy adventure across floating islands?

Take control of Crazy Bob, battle dangerous enemies, cause explosive chaos, and fight for survival in a world full of challenges.

Explore floating islands, overcome traps and obstacles, complete quests, and unlock new portals to unexplored lands.

games.title: Space Obby
games.description: A fun and lighthearted platformer set in outer space. Join other intrepid astronauts as you adventure to the far reaching corners of a destroyed space station, using your trusty jetpack to navigate the floating wreckage. Featuring six unlockable characters and collectable battery cells scattered across four massive levels -- do you have what it takes to reach the end?

games.title: Eco Block Puzzle
games.description: Discover the intriguing realm of Eco Block Puzzle, where strategy and environmental healing converge. Solve complex puzzles to cleanse the planet and earn eco coins, introducing new life to the restored valley. Enjoy this unique blend of traditional puzzles and eco-friendly play on your device. Join the journey of creativity and restoration!

games.title: Legions: Way of War
games.description: Dive into the exciting world of "Legions: Way of War," a real-time strategy game that tests your tactical skills. Lead your troops to success by expertly positioning them and utilizing your heroes. Enjoy this captivating blend of strategy and competition on any device!

games.title: Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter
games.description:
Immerse yourself in a dynamic voxel-style RPG shooter with a cyberpunk atmosphere. A dark futuristic city overrun by a tech corporation awaits you, along with endless battles with robots and monsters, character development, and constant action in the spirit of a shooter RPG.

Run through the streets of the metropolis, uncover a conspiracy, upgrade your weapons and equipment, mine resources, and defeat bosses. The game combines action-packed shooting, survival elements, character development, and a rich storyline about the struggle for human freedom.

Key Features:
🔫 RPG shooter with dynamic action gameplay
🧱 Unique voxel style and cuberpunk atmosphere
⚙️ Deep weapon and equipment customization
🤖 Battles with robots, monsters, and bosses
🧭 Exploration of the city, dungeons, and locations
💰 Resource collection, crafting, and base development

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?
A: It is an RPG where you fight through hordes of enemies to complete levels, unlock new skills, areas, and weapons.

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: There isn't a traditional narrative, but the objective is clear: unlock new territories and defeat bosses.

Q: What makes this game unique? Why would players be interested?
A: There are very few games like this, especially with a stylish cyberpunk archer theme. It features built-in mini-games, great graphics, varied missions, and deep character customization and progression.

Q: What are the most engaging elements of the game?
A: The internal mini-games, a wide variety of weapons, clear objectives, and simple, intuitive gameplay mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: Yes, but the bosses are relatively easy. They act as guardians stationed at the entrances to new cities.

Q: How does the progression system work? How can you level up faster?
A: You level up by defeating enemies. You can also choose bonuses and find upgrades in crates.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Money is used to unlock new territories, upgrade your character, and purchase new clothing.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game?
A: You can spend money on clothing and unlocking new firearms.

Q: Is there customization? Can you change your hero's appearance, use a map editor, or tune vehicles?
A: Yes, you can purchase various outfits and weapons for your character.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: Yes, logging in every day provides bonuses such as gear or currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or is it possible to play without it?
A: The music is a great addition to the atmosphere, but it is not required to progress through the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What kind of achievements are there and how are they earned?
A: You can earn achievements for daily logins."

games.title: Place It Right
games.description: Place It Right is a cozy organization puzzle game about putting everyday objects in their perfect spots. Sort, arrange, and align items such as frames, tools, kitchen objects, books, and keys until every scene feels neat and satisfying. Use simple drag-and-drop controls, observe the pattern, and enjoy the calm feeling of making everything fit just right.

games.title: Bucket Brigade
games.description:
Bucket Brigade
Bucket Brigade is a cozy toy-themed puzzle game where you guide a rescue convoy across a sunny beach.

Children have left toys and sandcastles behind, and the beach needs to be cleared before the summer heat melts your plastic vehicles.

games.title: On Fire Basketball Shots
games.description:
The gym is packed, and the crowd is roaring! The scoreboard's ticking down, and your team is trailing. The only way to win is to sink blazing basketball shots from the court. You're the star player, but the pressure's on—every shot counts, and the hoop's rim is red-hot, making each attempt trickier!
"Core: A highly engaging, physics-based arcade sports simulator centered on precision shooting and high-score chasing.
Loop: Players engage in skill-based shooting mechanics to accumulate points, which convert into hard currency (coins) used for continuous progression and reward loops.
Start: Features instant, intuitive accessibility, ensuring immediate player engagement and a strong hook from the first session.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Utilizes a clean, contemporary Flat Design aesthetic that ensures visual clarity and broad appeal.
Key Feature: Offers deep player customization through various unlockable ball and environment skins, underpinned by robust, authentic shot physics."

games.title: Blocky Set - 3d brick constructions
games.description:
A 3D emulator of real-life brick-building games, where you are presented with a complete model and must reproduce it by placing the pieces in the correct location.

Enjoy!

games.title: Blocks and Car
games.description: Blocks and Car is a fun and casual puzzle game that combines Tetris-style block mechanics with passenger matching gameplay. Different shaped blocks appear on the board, and you clear them just like in classic Tetris. Once blocks are removed, passengers of matching colors are generated and move to the waiting area. Your goal is to guide them to the correct

games.title: Cargo Path Puzzle
games.description:
Cargo Path Puzzle is a free puzzle-platformer that puts your logic and movement skills to the test. Navigate tricky levels filled with deadly voids, collapsing blocks, trampolines, ice slides, and directional blocks.
Your goal: collect all the keys to activate the exit portal—then reach it to win.
Each level has only one correct solution, so plan your moves carefully. One wrong step can trap you or block your progress.
If you enjoy clever puzzles, single-solution challenges, and smart platforming, Cargo Path Puzzle is made for you.

games.title: My Phone Store
games.description:
My Phone Store is a fun and casual game about creating and selling tech devices!
Build smartphones, laptops, and tablets, improve your production, and sell devices to customers. Grow your shop, earn money, and turn a small store into a successful electronics business.
Features:
Simple and addictive gameplay
Create phones, laptops, and tablets
Sell devices and earn money
Upgrade your store and expand your business
Play, earn, and build the best gadget store!

games.title: Cards in Fool
games.description: Play Cards in Fool – a strategic turn-based online card game! Outsmart opponents, make them draw cards, and climb the leaderboard. Flip cards, win matches, and earn points in this classic multiplayer challenge!

games.title: Raised Knight
games.description:
Get ready for the adventure in "Raised Knight," the endless runner where your skills will be put to the test!
Run through a world full of obstacles while trying to cover as much distance as possible. Every move counts, so make sure you master the controls!

games.title: Logic Islands
games.description: A logic puzzle game inspired by Nurikabe and Islands of Insight. Create islands with exact numbers while keeping walls connected. Navigate through 6 unique worlds with different rulesets - from Classic Nurikabe to advanced mechanics like Yin-Yang connectivity. Each world introduces new challenges with ice blocks, one-way arrows, and special orb mechanics across 240 hand-picked puzzles.

games.title: Real Parking Game
games.description:
Real Parking Game puts your driving precision to the test. Start in a garage full of cars and progress through dozens of hand-crafted levels packed with obstacles, narrow lanes, and tricky parking spots. Your goal is simple but challenging: navigate the course, avoid collisions, and reach the designated parking place to complete the level.

Features:

Large garage with many cars to unlock and collect.
Multiple levels.
Realistic driving physics and responsive controls for precision parking.
Progressive difficulty — beginner-friendly tutorials up to expert parking puzzles.
Optimized performance for smooth gameplay on mobile devices.
Whether you enjoy relaxed precision driving or intense obstacle runs, Real Parking Game delivers addictive, approachable gameplay that rewards skill and patience. Download now, pick your favorite ride, master the obstacles and park like a pro!

games.title: Cat Snack Defense
games.description:
Cat Snack Defense is a casual tower-defense strategy game where you deploy unique cats to protect precious fish crackers from waves of hungry animals. Each cat has different abilities, attack styles, and roles, so choosing the right team and placement is essential.
Your objective is to survive every enemy wave and keep the goldfish cracker alive. You win by defeating all attackers before they destroy the cracker. Collect rewards, unlock new cat cards, and build a stronger defense.

games.title: Watermelon: Falling Animals
games.description:
Merge cute animals and create new, bigger, and rarer ones! 🐾
The more animals you combine, the higher your score and the faster you climb the leaderboard.

Compete with players from all over the world for the top spot in the rankings. Plan your strategy, use powerful boosts and combos to earn even more points and outperform your rivals.

Unlock new animals, set records, and prove that you are the true master of evolution!

Download the game now and start an exciting adventure in the world of animals!
Become the best and claim the title of the ultimate Animal Master! 🏆

games.title: Draw & Save
games.description:
🚤 You're the last boat on the beach.

Someone's gone under past the buoys — and the fins are already circling. 🦈

You get one shot. Trace a route across the water with your finger, let go, and watch it happen. No steering. No brakes. No takebacks. ⚡

🦈 Sharks patrol in loops that do not wait for you.
🪨 Rocks don't move. They also don't forgive.
💥 Clip either one and the entire run is gone.

Easy to draw. Brutal to plan.

games.title: No Shorts
games.description:
🌟 Welcome to the exciting world of ragdoll physics and creative fun in the style of short videos in the game No Shorts! 📱 Quickly switch between levels with swipes, just like in your favorite social networks. ⚡️ Use various tools to interact with ragdoll stickmen and activate objects on the stage. Create your own playgrounds in the level designer! 🛠️

🎮 Fans of physics-based sandboxes and creative simulators will definitely love this new trendy game!

🎲 Game features:
👆Simple one-finger control: Click to interact with the stickmen and the environment.
🌈Simple and funny casual graphics. 
🤸‍♂️Addictive gameplay with unique ragdoll physics. 
📱💻Play online from PC or mobile phone anytime and anywhere. 
🏗️Level builder where you can create your own game stories and scenarios. 

⭐️ Hurry up and click "Play" and don't forget to leave a review to help us improve the game!

games.title: Lane Clash
games.description: Lane Hold is a casual 3D lane-defense game. Hold your fortress across five parallel lanes: tap a lane shield to spawn warriors, clash power head-on, and stop enemies before they breach the wall. Clear short waves, upgrade lanes and the base between rounds, and use Shield, Bomb, and Freeze when the pressure rises — no joystick, no chasing camera, just tense lane battles.

games.title: Square Crusher
games.description:
Get ready for a fun and satisfying cube-crushing puzzle experience in SQUARE CRUSHER!
In this game, you need to tap on unlocked fill cubes or boxes only. When you tap a cube or box, it falls into the crusher. The crusher breaks it and generates colorful balls. These balls fall onto the board and move toward the conveyor belt if there is space. Your main goal is to match the crushed balls with the correct front crates. When the balls pass near the crates, matching balls will automatically go inside the correct crate. Once a crate is full, the next crate in the queue moves forward. But be careful! Do not blindly tap on unlocked cubes or boxes. If you tap without planning, the generated balls may not match with the front crates. This can fill the conveyor belt quickly and create no space for new balls. Fill all crates, clear all boxes, and complete the level before the conveyor belt gets full!

games.title: This is Blast
games.description:
Ready to blast your way through puzzles? Welcome to This is Blast, the exciting blast game that combines colorful puzzles, explosive chain reactions, and addictive ball blast mechanics. If you’re searching for a fun, free, and challenging puzzle blast game, you’ve found it.

From the very first shot, This is Blast delivers an experience that is simple to play yet packed with depth. Aim carefully, unleash your balls, and trigger epic blasts that clear the board in a single swoop. With intuitive controls, smooth visuals, and clever puzzles, this game keeps you hooked whether you want a quick session or hours of puzzle-blasting fun.

games.title: King of pirate
games.description:
Try yourself as a brave pirate, able to repel the attack of enemy zombies! 🧟
Show dexterity and attentiveness!

games.title: Italian Brainrot: Popper Crazy
games.description:
Welcome to Italian Brainrot: Popper Crazy!💥
Join 125 thrilling levels packed with quirky characters, plan your moves, and put your skills to the test. 🎯🧩
But be careful! ⚠️ Some characters hide deadly mines that can cost you a life — every move counts! ⏳❤️

Upgrade your abilities: boost your tap power, increase your starting lives, and unleash powerful bombs to clear the screen in one go! 🚀
Each level gets tougher, keeping the fun fresh and intense. 🏆🔥

Unlock 9 mysterious achievements, grow stronger, and prove your mastery! 🎖️🔮
Enjoy the excitement in 16 supported languages from around the world. 🌍🗣️

games.title: FatBoy Dream
games.description: Join an exciting adventure in **FatBoy Dream** as a playful child hops between donuts, gathering delicious treats. This engaging online game promises a sugar-coated thrill for sweet enthusiasts, challenging you to leap higher without falling. Ideal for those seeking fun and excitement on **mobile and desktop** devices.

games.title: Art'N Ball
games.description:
Art'N Ball is a mix between classic tennis and 3D platform game. The player will travel different locations within the Art’N Ball rolling-out world, skillfully returning his Earth-ball to have it pass walls, art exhibits, photo and puzzle challenges to finally set it free from its enclosed gallery pathway into infinite Space. 

He will experience different levels of complexity as the Earth-ball takes him from countryside or mountainous territories to the inner bowels of the underground, the depths of the seas, past frantic cityscapes towards arty lush landscapes and onto a surprise finish journey in orbit…

games.title: Hoppy Stacky
games.description:
A charming and captivating infinite game, Hoppy Stacky will keep players occupied for many hours!
In this vibrant world, your mission is to help the main character build a sky-high tower out of flying logs (sliders). Think of that as straightforward? Just give it a try! The game will constantly put your reflexes to the test as the sliders appear completely at random: they vary in size, come from unexpected directions, and move at unpredictable speeds.
Just one second of distraction and your tower could collapse. Do you have the agility and sharp timing to conquer the highest peak? Jump into Hoppy Stacky and prove your skills now!

games.title: Fill The Lines
games.description: Lines to Fill is a thinking game where you draw lines to complete the given puzzle shape. Simply drag one of the colorful blocks using your finger or the left mouse button, and make sure there are no blank spots left. Since the game has no time limits and no way to lose, you can enjoy this stress-free experience complete with hundreds of unique levels on your computer or mobile device. Can you block out some time and finish every level?

games.title: Blind Box Master
games.description:
Blind Box Master is a cozy, hand-drawn blind box collection game. Open mystery boxes and discover 100 adorable collectibles across 6 rarities and 5 conditions (Broken to Mint).

Features:
• 4 box tiers, Lucky Charm upgrades & Legendary chases
• 20 cute themed series to collect
• Daily & weekly tasks, achievements, card-flip mini game
• Sell, haggle, synthesize 3 items into higher rarity
• Idle income & showcase your best finds

Tap to play. Desktop & mobile.

games.title: SUM+SUM
games.description: Match the numbers. The numerical grid awaits your solution. Your task is to retain only those numbers that add up to the desired horizontal and vertical values. Eliminate the unnecessary, maintain balance, and uncover the logic behind each move

games.title: Sweet Flip
games.description: Match delicious cakes of the same color, clear the board, and earn points! Unlock new flavors and increase the challenge as you progress. A simple yet addictive puzzle game with bright, tasty desserts.

games.title: Mage Adventure: Mighty Raid
games.description: The game is simple but addictive: just aim and throw projectiles at enemies to clear wave after wave. As you progress, you'll unlock a variety of projectiles—each with its own unique twist.

games.title: Gun and Roll
games.description: Roll your roller object, improve it to other shapes, press cards and improve your gun! Use it gun for shoot objects. Pick the correct doors to improve yourself in level, pass the levels!

games.title: Wednesday’s Battle: Monster Symphony
games.description: An endless action game that fuels the urge to try again after every defeat, keeping you hooked for ‘just one more round.’ Built around the popular Wednesday theme, it features various enemy types, gradual difficulty escalation, and smooth, satisfying animations that make each battle feel rewarding.

games.title: Hook King Runner
games.description: Hook King Runner is a physics-based runner where you tap, swing, and time your jumps to master wild obstacle courses. Use ropes and hooks with precision to dodge traps, collect coins, and outmaneuver enemies. With ragdoll physics and varied levels, your agility and timing are the keys to conquering every thrilling challenge that awaits.

games.title: Vikings: An Archer's Journey
games.description: Join the thrilling endless runner in "Vikings: An Archer's Journey," where you control Nott, a bold Valkyrie archer, navigating the Underworld to rescue her wolf, Oder. With sleek visuals, it’s available for free on mobile devices and computers, appealing to gamers everywhere.

games.title: Hit & Knock Down
games.description:
Hit & Knock Down is a casual arcade-style shooting/throwing game where you aim to hit targets using various balls. When you successfully hit a target, it will either be knocked down or explode.
The goal is to clear each stage by obtaining the required score (or meeting stage objectives) and then move on to the next challenge.

games.title: Miner Jam
games.description: Miner Jam is a fun puzzle game where you strategically use colored axes to break boxes and advance through levels. Play online for free and enjoy vibrant gameplay. Unlock rewards and enhance your skills as you challenge yourself across iOS, Android, or desktop platforms.

games.title: HEX Connect
games.description: HEX Connect is a captivating hexagonal Mahjong Connect puzzle game where players strategically link pairs of identical colored tiles on a large hex grid, with connections limited to paths of no more than two bends, challenging spatial reasoning to clear the board entirely.

games.title: Dungeon Descent
games.description: Loot. Survive. Descend deeper. A fast voxel dungeon crawler with deadly rooms, powerful gear, and bosses waiting below.

games.title: Pop Balloon
games.description: Pop Balloon is an exhilarating and fast-paced arcade game that combines precision with rapid reflexes. In this game, players are challenged to pop as many balloons as possible using a set of bouncing spikes. The objective is simple yet addictive: aim and launch the spikes in such a way that they hit and burst the balloons scattered across the screen.

games.title: Micro GT Racing
games.description:
Micro GT Racing brings high-speed action to a smaller scale with massive thrills. Take control of compact GT cars built for precision, agility, and pure adrenaline. Race through challenging circuits packed with sharp corners, tight chicanes, and fierce competition — every millisecond counts.

Customize your micro racers, master realistic handling, and push your driving skills to the limit as you climb from rookie to champion. With stunning visuals, dynamic lighting, and intense arcade-style gameplay, Micro GT Racing delivers a bite-sized racing experience with full-sized excitement.

games.title: Hi-Fi Snake: Groove-Driven Arcade Challenge
games.description:
Dive headfirst into a vibrant, isometric world where classic arcade action meets a pulsating disco atmosphere. In Hi-Fi Snake, you control a tireless robot with a single goal: power the party forward!

Inspired by the timeless game Snake, you must guide your bot to collect sequences of glittering pellets. As you do, your trail grows, demanding precision navigation. But don't dawdle—a molten-hot problem is right behind you! A tide of raging lava is steadily consuming the dance floor, giving you only seconds to act.

Once your quota is full, you must race to the exit door to unlock the next room and escape the fiery fate. Every chamber presents a new, expertly crafted challenge filled with moving obstacles, environmental hazards, and robotic enemies determined to make you crash. It’s a fast-paced game of skill, timing, and strategic movement under intense pressure. Get your groove on and escape the heat!

games.title: Marble Maze
games.description: A head-to-head 3D maze puzzle. You swipe to roll your marble through a labyrinth and paint every open tile on the board. Each maze uses one color — your job is to cover the whole board, not reach a finish line.

games.title: Driftbound: Race in the Grip of Drift!
games.description: Driftbound: Race in the Grip of Drift! is a fast-paced arcade racing game built around a unique magnetic drifting mechanic. Attach your hook to magnets near the road, swing through sharp turns, and release at the perfect moment to stay on the track. Race through procedurally generated environments filled with bridges, intersections, changing weather, and challenging turns. Set new distance records in Solo mode or compete against AI rivals, collect cash, upgrade your car, and unlock new vehicles and control modes.

games.title: Fake Ninjas
games.description: There are fake ninjas in town who have caused dishonour to your master. You have to find them all and redeem yourself to the master

games.title: Gun Baron
games.description:
Become the boss of the arms business! You're a red panda building an empire in a world ruled by raccoon bandits. Set up production: install machines, craft pistols, assault rifles, and dynamite, sell to customers, and save up for your dream.
But the road to riches is dangerous. Hostile raccoons regularly raid your base. Buy tougher weapons, upgrade your stats, and keep your paw on the trigger to protect your conveyor belts and warehouse.
Key features:
• Engaging production system
• Dynamic real-time shootouts
• Living economy: satisfy customers and defend them from raccoons
• Vibrant world with signature humor
• Clear goal: accumulate capital, build a rocket, and blast off!
• Upgrade your skills and buy better gear
Every gun sold brings you closer to that dream rocket. Every raid is a test, every dollar a step toward the sky. Run your factory, repel attacks, and become a legend. Launch Gun Baron now — your journey to the stars starts here! 🚀

games.title: Egging On
games.description:
A fragile egg begins a dangerous journey toward the sky. The world around you is unstable — steep slopes, sharp edges, and tricky obstacles that can crack your shell at any moment.

Master the physics of movement as you balance, tilt, and jump your way upward. Each level introduces new challenges, from simple inclines to complex platforms that require precision, timing, and steady control.

Unlock a variety of fun and epic egg skins as you progress and turn your climb into a unique adventure. With realistic physics, challenging gameplay, and a colorful visual style, every move matters.

Can you keep your balance, climb higher and higher, and reach the stars without cracking?

games.title: Fun Toy Pals
games.description: Step into a cozy playroom and explore a world full of charming toys! In this addictive merge game, your goal is to combine matching toys on the colorful carpet to create higher-level toys. Unlock achievements as you reach higher scores and compete with players around the world on the global leaderboard. Cute visuals, fun combinations, and endless merging challenges make this game perfect for casual gamers of all ages.

games.title: BouncePop Quest
games.description: Join the adventure of BouncePop Quest, guiding Jumpo, a colorful jelly creature, through 150+ vibrant levels. Overcome obstacles, navigate moving platforms, and face challenges while collecting stars and defeating enemies. Experience exciting new worlds in this free game available for both phone and computer, delivering hours of fun!

games.title: Slasty: Candy Tower
games.description:
Meet “Slasty: Candy Tower” - a breathtaking action-arcade where cute hungry monsters sit on the crazy-spinning platforms, and you shoot them with a candy gun to feed them up! Try to make your candy-shots precise to achieve unbelievable combos, set records and compete with other players to become the best! Feed a monster simply by tapping on the screen at the right time to make a candy shot. Complete tower-levels with various platforms, but beware, they are spinning faster and faster! Open new levels with new towers. Each tower has different mechanics, style, and platforms.

games.title: Connect: Monsters
