The main threat is the awakening swamp. The water level is constantly rising, flooding the land. If the swamp catches up with you, the character will die, but will immediately be reborn at his base. However, death is not the end, but part of the strategy. Return to flooded areas for new resources and watch as familiar trails become impassable.

Spend the collected Brainrots on leveling shelters and improving stats: increase your movement speed to escape from the water, boost your jump power to jump on high ground to escape the flood, or invest points in income to passively receive resources even in idle time.

games.title: Coffe Merge House
games.description: Coffee Merge House is a cozy merge game where you combine ingredients, prepare increasingly valuable treats, and serve customers their requested orders. Earn coins, upgrade your café, unlock new generators, and expand your collection of delicious creations. Plan your merges carefully, manage the limited board space, and keep your customers happy as your coffee house continues to grow!

games.title: Poker Clicker
games.description: Unlock upgrades and rare cards to collect, with over 60+ achievements to get in this idle clicker game about racking up chips by playing cards.

games.title: Brain Test: IQ Challenge
games.description:
Brain Training: Logic & Puzzle Games
Educational puzzle game for all ages! Improve logical thinking with pattern recognition, odd-one-out challenges, sequence puzzles. Fun learning!

games.title: Relaxing Games: 30 in 1
games.description: This collection of games is perfect for those who are looking for a relaxing and fun way to unwind. These mini-games are designed to bring a sense of peace and entertainment during short breaks or long journeys. Enjoy a variety of calming and fun games that will help you escape from the daily grind and find harmony. A great way to relax and have fun anywhere and anytime. No ratings or points, just addictive mini-games.

games.title: Bubble Shooter Island Quest
games.description: Bubble Shooter Island Quest is an enchanting bubble shooter puzzle game set in a lush jungle island paradise. Its core concept involves launching colorful bubbles from a pirate bird's cannon to match 3+ of the same color—reds, blues, yellows, and specials like eggs and coins—causing chain reactions to pop clusters and clear encroaching bubble walls before they reach the bottom. Unique elements include a charming red parrot pirate shooter, power-up barrels (rainbow, lightning, ice), gem/coin collection for upgrades, star/trophy goals per level, and tropical vibes with vines and barrels for immersive, relaxing yet addictive play.

games.title: StickerBall
games.description:
Stickerball is a fast-paced game where you collect stickers using a ball with unique abilities! Your goal is to collect 180 colorful stickers across 9 levels by completing challenges and activating triggers that change the game’s rules. Each turn, 10 stickers fly onto the field from a purchased pack, but any uncollected ones disappear—act quickly and precisely!

The game shines with 14 dynamic triggers: freeze stickers, double rewards with "x2," turn the ball into a magnet or ghost, activate "disco" mode, or control a dual ball! The more stickers you collect in one turn, the higher your combo and the more coins you earn. Holo-stickers, with their unique designs, grant double the currency!

Play across 12 vibrant, randomly changing fields. Buy sticker packs, upgrade your collection, and strategize by activating triggers at the perfect moment to maximize rewards.

games.title: Feeding A Black Hole
games.description:
A  Game About Feeding A Black Hole! 🕳️

Devour asteroids 🪨

Grow steadily 📈

And become unstoppable 💫

A  game about feeding a Black Hole 🪐🌀

What awaits you:
🌱 Deep progression & expansive skill tree
🎁 Choose 1 of 3 random rewards after each level
🔄 Prestige system with permanent progress multipliers

games.title: JUMPER
games.description:
JUMPER

Прыгай к новым высотам побивая  Рекорды, подбирая Уникальные бонусы и уворачиваясь от  Эпичных ловушек  с  
Улучшенной графикой!🌟

Коллекционируй  очаровательные Скины👔,  получая Достижения🏆

games.title: Assemble Factory Puzzle
games.description: Play Assemble Factory Puzzle, a free online game where you solve challenging assembly line puzzles. Strategically place machines to craft perfect car parts. Test your logic, speed, and problem-solving skills in every level!

games.title: A Block Too Many
games.description: Build a tower, reach the stars! In this challenging and addictive block-stacking game, you play as an alien trying to escape a mysterious planet. Strategic stacking is key: each block has unique properties, and one mistake can make your tower collapse. Unlock new levels, blocks and customizations as you play. Choose between a challange mode to unlock levels Or compete for the largest tower in endless mode. Wana chillout there is even a sandbox mode to build into the stars.

games.title: Arcuz Treasure Hunters
games.description: "Arcuz Treasure Hunters" is a Fantasy JRPG game with treasure hunting theme, where players explore underground caves, decipher maze-like machenics, challenge powerful enemies, collect rare treasures, and assemble a strong team with diverse abilities through hiring various companions.

games.title: CrashDown Voxel Destruction
games.description: Crash Down - Smash Everything is a voxel-based sandbox game. The player is given complete freedom of action. There are various locations at your disposal, filled to capacity with structures. The key feature is the possibility of their complete destruction. Using various methods, you can destroy everything you see. Have you ever dreamed of leveling a multi-storey house with your own hands? Now you have such an opportunity! The physics of destruction is close to reality. Use a variety of arsenal to destroy objects, from a hammer to a powerful bazooka.

games.title: Save The Fruit - Draw To Save
games.description:
Save the Fruit: Draw to Home puzzle game provides a delightful blend of creativity, strategy, and fun, making it a must-play interesting drawing puzzle save the fruit game. Get ready to embark on an artistic save the fruit draw to home and a heartwarming adventure to save the cutest fruits in the gaming world. In this captivating adventure game Save the Fruit, players must use their artistic skills to guide stranded save the fruits safely to their by drawing to go home while overcoming various challenges in this save the fruits draw to home game.


Draw the lines to save the fruits & and cute fruits go home safely share your achievements, and creative solutions with friends this save the fruits draw to home game. You need to Collaborate homes and avoid the villains from bumping into each other on challenging levels, if all fruits collide and the game will fail.

games.title: Meow Captcha
games.description:
Meet Meow Captcha: Virtual Cat — a cute cat puzzle game full of tricky challenges, hidden objects, funny mini games, and an adorable virtual kitty to care for. 🐱 Can you find all the cats? Look closely, spot hidden clues, choose the right answer, and discover unexpected solutions. Solve playful CAPTCHA-inspired puzzles, then spend time with your virtual cat — feed your kitty, pet it, give it a bath, dress it up, play together, and tuck it into bed. 🐾 😺 SOLVE FUN CAT PUZZLES “Select all the cats” is only the beginning! Every level is a short interactive puzzle with a new challenge. Find the right cats, search for hidden objects, spot differences, sort mischievous kitties, clean up the scene, or drag items into the correct place. Some cat puzzles test your logic and observation. Others hide the answer somewhere in the scene or ask you to find an unexpected solution. Look carefully — even the smallest detail can change everything! 🧩 🧠 THINK OUTSIDE THE BOX The obvious answer is not always the right one. Tap, choose, find, sort, and drag objects to solve tricky brain puzzles and visual challenges. Interact with different parts of the scene, experiment with objects, and discover funny solutions. The controls are simple, but these mischievous cats may surprise you. 😼 🔎 FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS & CLUES Think you have sharp eyes? Search colorful scenes for hidden objects, spot differences, discover visual clues, and find interactive items that can help you complete each challenge. Sometimes the answer is right in front of you. Sometimes you need to look at the puzzle in a completely different way. 👀 🐱 TAKE CARE OF YOUR VIRTUAL CAT Puzzles are only part of the adventure. You also have your own adorable virtual kitty! Feed your cat when it gets hungry, pet it, give it a bath, play together, and help your little pet rest. Take care of your virtual cat and enjoy its cute reactions as you spend more time together. ❤️ 👗 DRESS UP YOUR KITTY Give your virtual cat a style of its own. Choose cute clothes and accessories, try different outfits, mix your favorite items, and create adorable looks for your kitty. 🎮 PLAY CUTE CAT MINI GAMES Enjoy quick cat games and mini games made for short, relaxing play sessions. Test your logic, attention, and observation. Find objects, sort cats, clean up scenes, drag items, and solve playful challenges with surprising answers. Every new task brings something different to discover. 😻 PUZZLES, CATS & CUTE SURPRISES Meow Captcha combines funny cat puzzles, brain challenges, hidden-object gameplay, virtual pet care, dress-up, and relaxing mini games in one cute cat game. If you enjoy cat games, puzzle games, virtual pet games, hidden-object games, brain teasers, or casual mini games, there is always another Meow Captcha challenge waiting for you. 👉 GAME FEATURES Funny CAPTCHA-inspired cat puzzles Tricky puzzles with unexpected solutions Hidden objects and seek-and-find challenges Logic, attention, and observation mini games Tap, choose, sort, and drag gameplay Your own adorable virtual cat Feed, pet, bathe, play, and sleep Virtual pet and cat care Cute kitty clothes and dress-up Quick casual levels Cozy scenes and adorable cats Lots of playful challenges to discover 🐈 Can you solve every cat puzzle and keep your virtual kitty happy? Play Meow Captcha and find out!
How to play

games.title: Dream Supermarket: 3D Shop
games.description: Welcome to Dream Supermarket: 3D Shop, an engaging simulation game where players can experience managing their very own supermarket. Enter the captivating world of Hypermarket 3D - Store 3D and strive to become a top-notch store manager. Assist customers, restock shelves, and ensure a lively shopping environment in the dynamic Grocery Store - 3D Cashier gameplay.

games.title: Mystery Digger
games.description: Join the exciting journey of **Mystery Digger**, an addictive idle clicker game. Explore underground for treasures and stories. Upgrade your drill with each click to uncover fascinating finds. Enjoy this calming game on any device and satisfy your curiosity with every discovery.

games.title: Seven Down
games.description:
Seven Down is a rolling-die puzzle game with a rule you can hold in one sentence: the face touching the ground is your number, and opposite faces always add up to seven — so the number you cannot see is always the one you can work out.

Three games share that die. Puzzle is 60 hand-checked boards plus a daily one that is the same for everybody: reaching the pad is easy, arriving on the face it asks for is the puzzle, and your number is decided entirely by the route you took. Action is 120 stages across six places with something hunting you — gaps, spikes, crumbling tiles, sweeping arms, conveyor belts and turrets, with powers you pick up by landing on the number they ask for. Maze is 60 dark labyrinths where you see only what is near you, and everything you have walked stays uncovered.

Par is never guessed. Every level is proved by a solver before it ships, so the shortest route is always reachable and matching it always means something. Every texture, every piece of music and every board is generated as the game runs, so it works offline and always will.

games.title: Kitten Never Dies
games.description: Join an interdimensional adventure to help a lost kitten find its way home! Solve unique challenges in each dimension. Cute, clever, and full of surprises—are you up for the challenge? Play now and test your puzzle-solving skills!

games.title: Domino Legend
games.description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Domino Legend. Ideal for both veterans and nostalgic players, this online game offers an exciting challenge. Enjoy the beloved Block and Draw formats, and experience the joy of a fast-paced match on your device.

games.title: Pixel Conquest
games.description:
Pixel Conquest is a fast-paced, addictive strategy game where you compete against AI opponents to conquer the most territory. Draw trails to enclose land and claim it as your own, all while your city automatically grows within your borders.

Use clever tactics to cut off and eliminate your rivals. Grab powerful-ups like Speed, Shields, and Bombs to gain an edge and become the last tracer standing!

games.title: Solitaire Picture Puzzles
games.description:
Solitaire Picture Puzzles is a game where you match cards with pictures instead of pieces. Understand the game in seconds and play for hours.  Start with simple 3x3 puzzles and play harder levels as your skills improve. If the game seems too easy, you can unlock extra difficult challenges after completing level 9. 

Match pieces to reveal beautiful image. Each image used in this game is from a professional photographer. There are no AI generated images in this game. From nature to food to architecture, looking at each image is like exploring the world from the comfort of your device.

games.title: Solitaire: The Eternal Deck
games.description:
Solitaire: The Eternal Deck — a classic card solitaire game with a modern design and intuitive controls. Think through each move, turn over cards, and find the best solutions by combining logic, attention to detail, and strategy.

♠️ Familiar rules in a user-friendly format—easy to get started and fun to hone your skills.
♠️ A calm atmosphere and intuitive interface let you focus entirely on the game.

Features:
🔹 Move cards with a single tap—the correct move is executed automatically.
🔹 Auto-complete the game after all hidden cards are revealed.
🔹 Unlimited undo to find the best strategy.
🔹 An improved deal generation system with a higher probability of success without losing interest.

Collect the entire deck, test your skills, and enjoy one of the most popular card games. “Solitaire: The Eternal Deck” is perfect for both a few minutes of relaxation and extended gaming sessions.

games.title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
games.description:
Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire

Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

Be the hero the world needs!

Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.
Colorful locations, numerous card combos, helpful companions, and many hours of journeying—all of this awaits you in Emerland Solitaire: Endless Journey.

Wisk away to a land filled with wonder and danger. As a new adventurer, you must learn about all the dangers that face you while traversing enchanted forests, majestic bluffs, and more!

Play Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire for:
MYSTICAL CARD PUZZLES!
FANTASTIC WILD CARDS!
EARN STARS FOR SKILL!

games.title: Inner City Drive
games.description:
Weave through neon traffic at 390 km/h, one mistake and it's over!

Inner City Drive drops you into a rain-soaked neon city at night, behind the wheel of a car built for one thing: surviving the storm at impossible speed. Dense oncoming and same-direction traffic floods every lane — thread the gaps, launch off ramps over gridlock, and blast through tunnels while lightning cracks across wet, reflective streets.
The hook is the near-miss combo: shave past traffic as close as you dare and your combo climbs, stacking speed and score multipliers the longer you hold your nerve. Play it safe and the combo bleeds away, every run is a gamble between going faster and staying alive.
Every day brings a brand-new procedurally-generated drive, the same route for every player worldwide, reset at UTC midnight, so you're racing the whole planet on a level playing field on the daily global leaderboard. Grind XP and coins to unlock all 14 cars, each with its own speed and grip feel, knock out daily missions, and build your day streak. Instantly playable on desktop or mobile.

games.title: Basketball Tap
games.description:
Basketball Tap is a fast-paced casual sports game.
Time your taps perfectly, launch the ball into the air, and score epic slam dunks!

games.title: Racing: Online!
games.description:
Experience real online racing right in your browser.
  Compete against players from around the world and climb to the top of the leaderboards.

  🏎️ What's Inside:
  • Drift mechanics for skill-based driving
  • Unique cars to collect
  • Limited-time events with exclusive vehicles
  • Daily quests to keep you progressing
  • Create a lobby, chat, and race with friends — or challenge someone on the same device in local co-op

  Race. Win. Dominate.

games.title: Tower Necromancer's
games.description: You are a necromancer living in a tower, but the local kingdom sees you as a threat. They continuously attack, trying to destroy your tower. Defend against relentless waves of enemies, master dark magic to summon skeletons and zombies, upgrade and expand your tower, and develop strategies to counter different enemy types.

games.title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
games.description: Explore the intriguing realm of Flag Puzzle Jam, where puzzle-solving and flag collection unite. This engaging and free online game offers both relaxation and an opportunity to discover national symbols. Enjoy a colorful and seamless experience on any device as you embark on this worldwide quest.

games.title: Night Order: Pick & Pack
games.description: Choose the requested items from the shelf, collect them on a tray, and carefully pack each night order.

games.title: EdgeFire 2
games.description:
EdgeFire 2 is a large—scale and multifaceted game universe offering a deep reinterpretation of the classic formulas of the genre.

If you are familiar with the unique atmosphere of the iconic Counter-Strike 1.6, have you followed the constant evolution of the gameplay in CS:GO and its successor CS 2, enjoy the intense and mobile battles in Standoff 2 or immerse yourself in any other of the numerous cult projects of the genre — you will find in this game the magic of the classics, recognizable at first glance.

EdgeFire 2 offers its players a unique and balanced fusion of nostalgic "old school" and bold new ideas, where genuine tactical depth and the need for team synergy are seamlessly combined with an exciting, dynamic and visually spectacular action game.

This combination creates an ideal, carefully calibrated space for infinitely diverse competitive battles, where each match becomes a new story.

games.title: Road Crosser
games.description: Road Crosser is a high-quality 3D HTML5 game built with Three.js, featuring endless city-crossing game play like Crossy Road — but with a modern twist. Players must navigate through busy roads, forests, and city lanes while dodging vehicles and obstacles. With realistic lighting, animated environments, touch and keyboard support, and clean responsive design, this game delivers an immersive experience across desktop and mobile browsers.

games.title: Sticker Jam: Peel Off & Match
games.description: Dive into the lively experience of Sticker Jam, a free online puzzle game that merges sticker collecting with engaging challenges. Whether on your phone or computer, it's an enjoyable way to relax and stimulate your mind after a busy day.

games.title: Mahjong Chef
games.description: A tile-matching puzzle game inspired by Mahjong Solitaire. Tap two free tiles of the same type to clear them from the board. Complete each stage by removing all tiles.

games.title: Patagonians
games.description: Explore horror and mystery in Patagonians! Search for your missing daughter, battle monsters, solve puzzles, and survive deadly traps in eerie caves and mansions. Dare to face the darkness? Play now!

games.title: Neon Ball Slope
games.description:
If you love fast-paced runner-type endless games, then you'll definitely love Neon Ball Slope!
It combines fast reactions with physics-based ball maneuvering. It'll start easy, but as you roll down the slope, it only gets steeper from there! Avoid obstacles, and collect coins and gems to invest into upgrade packs for cards to become more powerful and earn higher scores. Gain XP on runs to level up and the increase card amounts gained from packs and unlock content. Complete missions to get gems and equipment chests. Participate in the daily leaderboards and gain coins by getting the highest score out of your division!

games.title: Dot and Dot
games.description:
Dot and Dot is a vibrant puzzle game where players connect matching dots without crossing paths.Challenge yourself across three exciting game modes:

Normal Mode: 5000 classic puzzles to master
Loops Mode: 1500 puzzles to connect dots back to their starting point
Bridges Mode: 1500 puzzles to cross paths strategically on special bridge tiles

Features designed to enhance your experience:

Daily Login Rewards: Earn hints for consecutive daily logins
Smart Auto-Complete: Double-tap to automatically complete the last remaining connection
U-Turn Detection: Visual warnings prevent invalid patterns
Colorblind Support: Toggle color labels (A-Z) for better accessibility
Hint System: Get help when you're stuck
Quick Reset: Restart any stage instantly

Test your logic and spatial skills with intuitive controls, right-click line removal, and progressively challenging puzzles!

games.title: Sudoku - Number Games
games.description:
Увлекательная логическая игра-головоломка с числами! Тренируйте внимание, развивайте память и логику, да и просто получайте удовольствие!

По мере повышения уровня игра усложняется, но всегда можно вернутся к прошлым уровням и играть на более легком уровне сложности.

games.title: Planet Destroy Idle
games.description:
Planet Destroy Idle - Smash planets to pieces!

Craft powerful tools like pickaxes, swords, axes, and arrows to strike and destroy planets while collecting valuable resources. Complete quests, unlock achievements, and upgrade your tools to maximize destruction.

Use the prestige system with unique perks to come back stronger and smash even bigger planets. Every hit brings progress, and every new planet opens up new opportunities for chaos.

Become the ultimate destroyer and show the planets who’s in charge!

games.title: Space Cleaner
games.description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

With simple controls, satisfying destruction mechanics, and progressive upgrades, Space Cleaner delivers relaxing but addictive gameplay for fans of arcade and idle-style space games.

games.title: Cute Shapes
games.description: "Cute Shapes" is an adorable casual observation puzzle for the whole family. Spot the differences among cute shapes with eyes, solve fun little challenges, and train your powers of observation!

games.title: My Dogy Virtual Pet
games.description: Meet Dogy, your adorable virtual pet who needs your love and care! My Dogy Virtual Pet is a fun and engaging pet simulation game where you take care of an adorable puppy. Feed him when he's hungry, give him a bath to keep him clean, and play fun games together to keep him happy. When he's tired, tuck him in for a good rest. Dogy will react to how well you take care of him, so make sure he always feels loved! Whether you're a pet lover or just looking for a cute and relaxing game, My Dogy Virtual Pet is the perfect companion for you. Explore the joy of having a virtual pet without any mess!

games.title: Miner Builder
games.description:
You'll become a skyscraper builder!
Operate construction equipment and build the tallest skyscraper in the world.
Collect blocks using a bulldozer.

games.title: Farmers vs. Aliens
games.description: Lead the animals to their enclosures, identified by green arrows and matching images. Keep them inside the green zone to prevent alien abductions! As the game progresses, it slows down at a certain point. If you don't gather the animals in time, aliens will arrive to take them. Leaving the green zone—whether it's you or the animals—will trigger a UFO to appear and abduct them. If aliens take more than two animals or capture you, it's game over. Stay fast and remain in the green zone to survive!

games.title: Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami
games.description:
Welcome to Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami!

A fast-paced escape game that blends tsunami runner, idle game, and idle tycoon mechanics into one addictive experience. Run, jump, and survive while escaping giant waves, collecting brainrots, and building your Brainrot empire.

This is more than just a runner. Escape Brainrots Tsunami Obby is a true survival runner with long-term progression, idle systems, and satisfying upgrades.

Escape the Tsunami

A massive tsunami is coming and you must escape before it reaches you. Every second matters.

🌊 Classic tsunami obby and tsunami runner gameplay

🏃 Run fast, jump obstacles, and survive dangerous zones

⚡ Reflex-based escape game mechanics

Collect Brainrots and Progress

Brainrots are the main resource in this game. The more you collect, the faster your empire grows.

🧠 Collect brainrots during runs

💸 Turn brainrots into money

📈 Grow into a powerful idle tycoon

games.title: Crush Hour
games.description: Crush Hour is an endless arcade runner set in a zombie rush hour. Your truck drives itself — swipe to change lanes, hop the sidewalk, and smash the undead for combos and score. Weave through traffic, ram cars and trucks for extra points, grab fuel before the tank runs dry, and snag Rampage pickups for a smash frenzy. Near-misses reward clean driving. Survive the jam, beat your best, and own the highway.

games.title: Playground Ragdoll Sandbox
games.description:
In the game world, you can do everything: ride cars, blow up buildings, fight enemies and complete exciting missions. Use a variety of weapons, build objects with a tulgan and experiment with destruction.

The main goal of the game is to destroy the city using a nuclear bomb. How will you achieve this? It's up to you to decide. Move towards your goal through story missions or immerse yourself in a limitless sandbox of possibilities.

games.title: Balls: Pixel Art
games.description:
Balls: Pixel Art is a game about knocking out pictures with balloons. More precisely, you
have to disassemble the drawn picture into pixels by breaking it up with balloons.
This is a very interesting, exciting process. In which you need to show ingenuity,
and accurate calculation. The game has to offer:
- Exciting gameplay.
- Multiple images for you to smash
- Nice graphics
- Lots of levels to complete
Ready to be the Anti-Artist? Cracking the works of art? Then onward to new
victories!Balls: Pixel Art

games.title: Mahjong Tower: Puzzles
games.description:
Mahjong Tower: Puzzles are a mix of "puzzle" and "three-in-a-row" genres in a mahjong setting.
An exciting puzzle game for MAHJONG and THREE-IN-A-ROW fans! More than 60 levels of varying difficulty. SOLVE THEM ALL!

Combine mahjong tiles to remove them from the board or create special tiles that will help you clear the board even more effectively.

Solve fascinating puzzles in the "Puzzles" game mode.
Clear the board from mahjong tiles in the "Board Clearing" game mode.
Score as many points as you can in the endless "Arcade" game mode.

games.title: Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge
games.description:
Tap the arrows and remove the blocks! A logical puzzle game for adults! Can you beat all levels?

Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge is a relaxing puzzle game where you need to remove blocks by tapping the arrows. Clear the field, solve puzzles, and complete levels at your own pace.

This is a casual logic game that combines puzzle gameplay, an anti-stress experience, and thinking challenges. Simple controls make it accessible for everyone, while gradually increasing difficulty keeps it engaging.

The game is perfect for relaxing: easy gameplay, pleasant visual style and engaging levels help you unwind and take your mind off things. Sometimes you’ll need to think a bit to remove all the blocks and avoid getting stuck.

Features:

Casual puzzle game
Logic and thinking games
Puzzles with blocks and arrows
Many levels
Relaxing anti-stress gameplay
Boosters for help

If you enjoy puzzles, logic games, and casual games, try Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge.

games.title: Shadow Stick Ninja
games.description:
Shadowstick Ninja is a physics puzzle game with a dark, minimalist style. In this game, precision is more important than speed.

You play as a silent shadow ninja with only a few arrows. In each level, enemy ninjas hide behind obstacles and structures, waiting for you to take them out. Your goal is to eliminate every enemy. 

The way you do it is up to you!

Pull back, aim, and release to shoot arrows with the right trajectory. Pick from different arrow types and solve each level your own way:

- Regular arrows for clean, direct hits
- Bomb arrows to cause explosive area damage and break through obstacles
- Balloon arrows that attach to enemies and lift them into the air, exposing them for easier shots

There isn’t just one right answer. You can play smart and efficient, or try out new ideas and experiment as much as you want.

Lift an enemy into the air with balloons. Use lots of bombs just to see what happens. Try odd angles, mix up different moves, or come up with wild solutions.

Every arrow counts. If you run out of ammo, you’ll need to rethink your strategy and give it another shot.

Plan your moves, try bold ideas, and enjoy every physics-based takedown.

games.title: Emoji Sort
games.description: Emoji Sort is a pattern recognition puzzle game where players must fill in empty cells with the correct emojis. Each puzzle presents a grid with missing emojis that follow specific patterns - such as categories, sequences, or associations. Players analyze the existing emojis to identify the pattern (animals, food chains, transportation types, etc.) and select the appropriate emojis to complete the grid. The game features 80 increasingly challenging levels with various pattern types, and includes a hint system to help when players get stuck. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts who enjoy discovering logical connections between visual elements!

games.title: Make the glass happy
games.description: Draw lines to guide the water and fill the glass! Use logic and creativity to solve each level and make the glass happy.

games.title: DEAD FREQUENCY
games.description: Defend the Signal Tower! A fast-paced tower defense game set in a vibrant red wasteland. Protect your crystal-powered signal tower from waves of enemies using upgradeable stats like damage, speed, bounce, and diamond yield. Level up your defenses, manage resources, and survive as long as you can!

games.title: Flip 8
games.description:
Flip 8 is a press-your-luck card game about knowing when to stop.
Every card you flip joins your hand and adds its value to your round score. Flip a number you already hold and you BUST, the entire round is wiped. A live bust meter shows you the exact odds before every flip, so every card is your call not the game's. Cash in to bank your points safely, or keep going for the Flip 8: eight different cards in a single round banks automatically with a +20 bonus. First player to the target score wins.

Play solo against three AI opponents, or take it online — quick match with random players, or create a private room and send friends the code. Rooms hold 2 to 7 players. Pick your target (100, 150 or 200), switch on Blitz mode for fast timed turns, chase the daily goal, unlock extra themes, and climb the global leaderboards for best score, wins and Flip 8s.

One Peek Token per match lets you look at the next card before you commit. Use it well.

games.title: Bouncy Ball
games.description:
Bouncy Ball is a fun and addictive arcade platformer where timing is everything ⚡️
Guide a happy bouncing ball across floating platforms, avoid deadly spikes, and survive tricky jumps that get harder every level 😱

Each bounce matters 🟠✨
Tap at the right moment to control the ball’s movement, master precision jumps, and keep your ball alive as long as possible. Simple controls, smooth animations, and vibrant neon visuals make every run exciting and satisfying 🎨🔥

Can you keep bouncing and beat your high score? 🚀🏆

games.title: Happy Coloring Book
games.description: Color your world with our interactive web coloring book game! Choose from a variety of fun drawings to bring your imagination to life.

games.title: Draw The Snake
games.description:
Draw The Snake is a fun and colorful puzzle game where players guide snakes through grid-based levels by choosing the correct path. Your goal is to move the snake smartly, collect apples, clear obstacles, and complete each puzzle without getting stuck.

Each level becomes more challenging with tricky paths, ice blocks, and clever puzzle layouts. The game is easy to understand but needs good planning and strategy to master. With simple controls, bright visuals, and relaxing puzzle gameplay, Draw The Snake is perfect for players who enjoy brain-training games.

games.title: Lucky Clash
games.description: Lucky Clash is a fast-paced 3D tactical Tower Defense game where players summon powerful monsters, merge units, and defend their kingdom against relentless enemy waves. The game combines quick, easy-to-learn battles with strategic depth, letting players create strong teams, discover powerful relics, and use clever combinations to survive each challenge. Its unique mix of monster merging, elemental synergies, and dynamic battles makes every run feel different.

games.title: Cruel Fable
games.description:
Cruel Fable is a dark storybook-inspired action roguelike where you survive waves of twisted creatures, collect gold, build powerful weapon combinations, and shape your character through upgrades and items.

Choose your weapons, strengthen your build between waves, defeat unique bosses, unlock Hard Mode, complete achievements, and compete on the global ranking.

games.title: Arkanoid For Painters
games.description: Arkanoid For Painters is a thrilling online game where players create barriers to control a ball, clearing blocks and foes. It blends classic gameplay with artistic elements, catering to creative strategists. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it guarantees entertaining challenges on the go.

games.title: PopCats: Merge the cats!
games.description: PopCats: Merge the cats! is a fun online puzzle game where you combine matching cats to form bigger, cuter ones. Enjoy the playful feline stories while aiming for the top of the leaderboard. No downloads or sign-ups needed, perfect for all cat enthusiasts on any device!

games.title: Cryptograms: Secret Text
games.description:
Cryptograms: Secret Text -  is a puzzle game where you decipher encrypted phrases, gradually uncovering letters and piecing together the full meaning.

Choose a theme to match your mood: love and relationships, wisdom and philosophy, movies and TV shows, motivation and literature – and progress through levels one by one.

Progress and Rewards:

Earn coins for completing levels, which can be used to access hints.

games.title: Mad Day Special
games.description:
Mad Day Special throws you straight into an all-out alien invasion of Earth, where only speed, firepower, and sheer madness stand between you and total destruction. Race across hills, smash through walls, and blast alien enemies as you fight to rescue your beloved pet octopus, Fluffy. Part racing game, part shooter, this is an action racing experience that won’t let you down.

This is a streamlined web version of the popular Mad Day game. With quick loading, simple controls, and addictive progression, it’s built for both short sessions and long, high-score-chasing runs.

With its blend of racing and shooting, Mad Day Special delivers chaotic fun and that irresistible “one more run” feeling. Drive hard, shoot fast, and don’t let the aliens take Fluffy.

games.title: Picture Shift
games.description:
One board. A pile of mismatched blocks. A picture hiding inside them.

Somewhere in that mess is a cute little cow. Or a rocket. Or a slice of pizza. It's been torn into pieces and scattered across the grid — and the only way to see it again is to slide those blocks back into place.

Sounds easy. It isn't. 😏

The board is packed. Blocks come as squares, lines, L-bends, T-shapes, zigzags, crosses — and they only slide through gaps big enough to take them. Move the wrong one first and you've boxed yourself in. The real puzzle isn't where things go. It's what order you move them in.

And the timer? Already running.

It stops playing fair fast ❄️ — Ice freezes blocks solid until you clear other pictures. Chains lock them until you deliver a key. Pinned blocks go nowhere. One-way blocks move on one axis only. And bombs 💣 put a live countdown on your board.

Stuck? Spend your way out 🔨 — Freeze Timer (10s), Hammer (knock off a 1×1 chunk), Merge (slam a picture together instantly), Free Movement (slide through everything).

The part that gets you 🔁 — 100 handcrafted levels. Then it just… keeps going. Endless mode shuffles the whole deck and deals forever.

games.title: Footchinko
games.description: Challenge your rivals in the most famous soccer international tournaments. Are you skillful enough to fulfil your trophy case through the +90 levels of the game?

games.title: Tangram Puzzle 2
games.description: Tangram Puzzle 2 is a classic tangram-style logic puzzle game in which players use a fixed set of colorful geometric pieces (tans) to exactly recreate a given target shape. The core idea revolves around spatial reasoning, rotation, and precise placement of pieces without overlaps or gaps. Its unique appeal lies in the vibrant, multi-colored pieces and targets (unlike traditional monochrome silhouettes), a progressive leveling system with star ratings based on efficiency (fewer moves earn more stars), and UI elements like move counters or hints that add strategic depth.

games.title: Sort It Out: Category Sort
games.description:
A fast-paced, head-to-head card sorting game. Cards are stacked on a wooden tabletop grid, each showing an emoji or icon (animals, food, tech, sports, and more). You race a rival to sort cards into the right category slots before the clock runs out.
Each match is a 90-second duel. You and your opponent share the same kind of puzzle: stacks of mixed cards and gold goal slots labeled with categories like Animals, Food, or Tech. Whoever completes the most full categories when time expires wins.

games.title: Frost Land - Snow Survival
games.description: Frost Land - Snow Survival is a strategic base-building game where you battle the harsh cold to stay alive. You’ll wield a flamethrower to melt snow, uncover hidden resources, and expand your shelter. Every choice matters—manage supplies wisely and decide which frozen zones to explore as you carve out survival in a relentless winter.In the strategic realm of a winter survival game, a devastating catastrophe has plunged the world into an endless winter. Embodying the last surviving hero, you venture forth, armed with a formidable flamethrower. Battle against relentless winter weather, confront fearsome beasts, and forge alliances with fellow survivors you rescue.With immersive exploration, strategic resource management, and a thrilling quest for survival, Frost Land – Snow Survival offers an addictive and adrenaline-pumping gameplay experience that will keep you hooked in the snow game for hours on end.Features🗺️ Epic Exploration: Brace yourself for an immersive winter survival journey through a visually stunning snowy world, where uncovering hidden resources with your badass flamethrower will keep you on the edge of your seat.⚔️ Strategy Resource Mastery: It's all about strategic thinking and resource management in a base-building game. Carefully decide when and where to melt that icy snow to unveil precious resources. It ensures your winter survival and dominance in this unforgiving realm.🏰 Base-Building Awesomeness: Customize and upgrade your base. Show off your creativity and build a base that strikes fear into the hearts of your rivals.❄️ Weather Challenges and Beast Battles: Brace yourself for intense weather conditions like blizzards and freezing winds that will test your winter survival skills.🎯 Quests and Triumphs: Embark on thrilling quests and conquer objectives that shower you with epic rewards and unlock new adventures. Prove yourself as a true hero of the winter survival game and make your mark in this frozen game.

games.title: Hook Pin Jam
games.description:
Master the art of hooking in this addictive puzzle game! Solve intricate puzzles by untie the hooks to accumulate wealth
In Hook Jam, players are tasked with solving intricate puzzles by untying hooks to accumulate wealth. The game offers a variety of challenges that test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. As you progress, the puzzles become more complex, keeping you engaged and motivated.

games.title: Connect Puzzle Image
games.description:
Were you one of those children who could spend hours with their puzzles, whiling away a rainy afternoon or cold winter’s day putting together a 500-piece jigsaw of the Eifel Tower or London Bridge? Well, now you can revisit your childhood on your smartphone or tablet from anywhere in the world.

Melt away from reality with this captivating puzzle game that challenges you to use your thinking skills to connect virtual pieces in real time and create unique images of increasing complexity. Arrange a variety of items to produce a pretty picture right on your screen, while developing your abilities as you progress through the levels. You’ll never be bored again!

games.title: Turbo Stunt Racing
games.description: Experience high-speed thrills in Turbo Stunt Racing! Perform epic stunts, race fierce rivals, and upgrade unique cars in this 3D arcade racer packed with action, traps, and ramps. Master precision driving and dominate every level!

games.title: Escape From The Crypt
games.description: Escape from the crypt, one room after another, before the necromancers get you! They move faster than you do, but they won't avoid obstacles: trick them into dead ends!

games.title: Container Auction
games.description:
"Container Auction" — an exciting auction simulator! Bid on mysterious containers, competing against rivals. Peek inside through the door gap, assess the contents, and place your bid!

Open containers and discover items — from old books to gold watches and diamond brooches. Every item has its own rarity: common, uncommon, rare, epic, or legendary!

games.title: Skebob Gun
games.description:
Welcome to a frantic open-world shooter where you decide who to be: a hero, a villain, or just have fun! Fight with friends, run, jump, shoot, and explore huge maps full of secrets, weapons, and surprises.

Game Features:

- Online multiplayer: play against other players in real time
- Wide selection of weapons: from blasters to rocket launchers
- Open world: explore maps, drive cars, and cause chaos
- Various modes: duels, survival, fun minigames
- Lots of skins and customization: stand out from the crowd
- Physics and tricks: jump, flip, and make the most of the environment

games.title: Hair Salon 3D
games.description:
Hair Salon 3D — a vibrant 3D hair salon simulator! Clients come to you with all kinds of requests: bob cuts, mohawks, undercuts, long layers, and much more. Pick up scissors, clippers, a razor, and a color brush — cut, style, and dye hair, trying to recreate the requested hairstyle as accurately as possible.

The better the result — the more stars and tips you earn! Collect in-game currency, buy new tools and dyes, unlock complex haircuts, and serve VIP clients. 23 unique hairstyles, 5 tools, a rating system, and daily challenges — you'll never get bored!

games.title: Car Dealership
games.description: Start from small car dealership by purchasing affordable vehicles, carefully inspecting them, and determining their market value from neighborhood and car market in car dealership game. Earn profits to reinvest in expanding your car inventory and improving your car showroom.

games.title: Animal Basketball
games.description:
Basketball games: The Power of Moe! Ultra-healing hand-painted physical shooting party

[Moe Animal Troupe Gathering] 
Manipulation will be serious kittens, cute chicks, naughty crocodiles! The cute characters come with their own exclusive shooting action, each action can trigger the screen heartbeat warning! 

[Visual Feast Blitz sports games]
● Hoop game  with 100+ kinds of magical basketballs and special effects: pizza ball, fishbowl ball, baseball, etc. 
● 4 healing courts: beach by the sea, countryside at sunset, deep forest, and dangerous cliffs - every basket will play tricks!

[Triple Pleasure Mode] 
Arcade Rampage: 60-second adrenaline challenge! Combo effects are stacked, full-screen blow-up effects are cool!
Road to the Championship: Challenge how many throws without missing it.
Achievement Mission: 200 missions! Unlock outrageous medals such as “Board Wipe King” and “God Pitcher” 

[Physics Ghostly Moments] 
Real Physics Engine x Moe's Magic Modification! The wall clock can also be used to shoot baskets!

Call your friends and have a healing and addictive fingertip hoop party!

games.title: Baker City: Family Bakery
games.description:
Open a family bakery and turn it into the city’s favorite spot. In the kitchen, merge matching ingredients and treats to create higher-level dishes. Serve customers, complete orders, and grow your reputation.
Unlock the city map: earn the trust of different neighborhoods, send out delivery vans, and open new branches. Decorate your bakery, collect recipes, complete daily goals, and compete in the weekly bakers’ leaderboard.

games.title: Lost Adventure
games.description:
"Survivors of a mid-air crash find themselves in a mysterious land. The pilot, amidst crafting, mining, and solving puzzles, works tirelessly to save passengers stranded on separate islands in the wild grass. Can they conquer the challenges, reunite, and escape the enigmatic realm before the unknown dangers lurking in the wilderness engulf them all?"

Embark on a thrilling adventure after a plane crash strands you in a mysterious, wild land. As the pilot, you must gather resources from wreckage, craft tools, and navigate through the wild grass to rescue scattered passengers on small islands.

Explore ancient ruins, solve puzzles, and mine resources to unlock the secrets of this enigmatic realm. Encounter friendly and hostile creatures, and use your crafted weapons to survive. Communicate with other survivors, separated by streams and dense vegetation, through makeshift signals.

Your journey is a test of resilience and camaraderie. Each crafted item brings you closer to reuniting with your fellow survivors and discovering the way back home. Will you conquer the challenges of the wild grass and unveil the mysteries hidden within, or succumb to the unknown dangers that lurk in the shadows? The choice is yours in this gripping and immersive adventure!

games.title: Purrfect Match
games.description:
Purrfect Match is a cozy match‑three puzzle about taking cats from a shelter home with you.

Every level is a roomful of kittens hoping to be picked. Swap neighbours to line them up: three of a kind and they're yours, four folds into a rocket, a bent five into a bomb, and five in a row into a Paw that sweeps every cat of one colour into your arms. Line up six and the Paw comes out glowing — double points and a wider sweep.

Sixty hand‑drawn levels ask for different things: gather cats of one kind, crack open crates, thaw kittens out of ice cages, or chip away at stones that only blasts can break. Each chapter adds one new thing to think about, so the board never plays the same way twice.

Spend milk bottles on boosters before a hard level, pick up daily tasks, collect achievements, and climb the leaderboard.

No timers on most levels, no pressure — just a warm board, a soft soundtrack, and one more cat coming home with you. 12 languages, phone or desktop.

games.title: Color Dots Challenge
games.description:
Color Dots is a simple yet addictive puzzle game where you'll
Place each dot into its matching slot aim for precision
Enjoy an experience that’s both easy to learn and fun to play, making it ideal for quick breaks or longer sessions.

games.title: Build My Brainrot
games.description: Build My Brainrot is a casual puzzle–simulation game where players collect and place colored blocks on a grid to complete quirky “brainrot” characters. Blending light resource management with creative pattern-building, the game’s core idea revolves around filling shapes efficiently while upgrading abilities like speed and inventory. Its charm comes from its simple controls, humorous character designs, and the satisfying progression of turning scattered resources into complete, animated figures.

games.title: Hard Puzzle
games.description: A fascinating puzzle for everyone. A huge number of different levels will not let you get bored. Come every day and train your brain.

games.title: Grill Match: Sort Food
games.description:
🔥 Welcome to Grill Match: Sort Food - the most mouth-watering sorting puzzle on a sizzling BBQ grill!

Sort juicy steaks, tasty burgers, shrimp, fresh veggies, and tons of other delicious foods right on a hot grill. Match 3 identical items, clear the grill, and complete relaxing yet challenging levels packed with tasty chaos!

Put your logic and reflexes to the test as you organize grilled food in the perfect order. Every level brings new ingredients, tricky combinations, and oh-so-satisfying match moments. Easy to learn - hard to master!

✨ Game Features:

🔥 Fun and addictive food sorting gameplay
🥩 Match 3 grilled foods to clear the board
🌽 Juicy BBQ visuals and a relaxing atmosphere
🍤 Hundreds of satisfying puzzle levels
⚡ Easy controls and smooth gameplay
🏆 Perfect for fans of cozy sorting & puzzle games
🍖 New foods, new challenges in every level

🍔 Can you become the ultimate Grill Master and sort every dish to perfection? Fire up the grill, sharpen your senses, and start matching now!

games.title: Tile Match
games.description:
Welcome to Tile Match! Get ready for a fun and exciting game where you need to keep matching tiles before they reach the bottom. It's a perfect game for anyone who loves puzzles and quick thinking!

How It Works:
Tiles keep coming from the top and move down. Your job is to make sure none of the tiles touch the bottom border. If they do, oops, the level is over and you have to start again!

games.title: Escape the Monster
games.description:
You wake up at the bottom of a monster's lair. Fifty floors of maze stand between you and the way out.

Each floor has one exit. Find it before the monster finds you, and don't take too long, because the longer you stay the faster it moves.

Four different monsters live down here and each one hunts a different way. Some chase you, some wait for you, and one walks straight through walls. On the dark floors you can't see any of them coming. You just hear the music change.

Grab gems on your way out. Some doors stay locked until you find the crown. If you're carrying a mask, the next monster to touch you is stunned instead of taking a life.

Clear all fifty floors to escape. Then try Endless mode, where the floors keep going and all that matters is how deep you get.

Gems buy new cloaks, lanterns and masks. Nine of them can't be bought at all, and must be earned.

games.title: Pool 8
games.description:
Pool 8 is a brain-teasing puzzle game based on a Pool board. 
Pot the balls in the correct order to move through a series of increasingly difficult challenges!

There's a multitude of difficulty levels that you naturally progress through, starting with the easiest "rookie" level. At the end of each difficulty level, you get a chance to win extra retries in the "smash the candies" bonus round. You can also earn these by watching a short video ad.
Yes, but it starts out easy. As you progress, you reach higher difficulty levels.

games.title: Jelly Links
games.description: A jelly-bright take on Sudoku. Every row, every column and every connected line must hold each number exactly once. 1000 puzzles from gentle 4x4 warm-ups to 12x12 boards that really make you think, plus a 500-stage Sandbox. No timer, no lives — just you and the logic.

games.title: Moto Traffic Rider
games.description:
Moto Traffic Rider puts you behind the handlebars of a powerful motorcycle and delivers a whole new level of realism while keeping the old-school spirit and simple gameplay.

Jump into the saddle, switch to the first-person view, and race through busy highways, weaving between streams of cars. The game features a full career mode, enhanced graphics, detailed environments, and realistic motorcycle sounds recorded from real bikes. Complete missions, earn money, and unlock new motorcycles to become a true highway legend.

Moto Traffic Rider combines fast-paced arcade racing with the atmosphere of a real biker adventure. Ride day and night on highways and city streets, pushing your skills to the limit.

Features:
• First-person camera view for full immersion
• 13 unique motorcycles with realistic engine sounds
• Detailed roads and dynamic day/night cycle
• Full career mode with no fuel or time limits
• Motorcycle upgrade and purchase system

games.title: Wheelchair parkour: No limits
games.description:
Race across the city rooftops in a wheelchair, build up speed, jump across huge gaps, and overcome dangerous obstacles. Perform tricks in the air, collect coins, and try to travel as far as possible to set a new record.

The farther you go, the more challenging the obstacles become. One wrong move — and the run is over.

Collect coins, unlock new looks for your character, and head back out to conquer the rooftops again.

games.title: Color Sorting
games.description:
Color Sort is a puzzle made entirely of colour — not a water sort, and nothing is poured. Each board is one continuous gradient cut into tiles and shuffled. The pinned tiles never move and the corners are what fix the gradient, so every other tile has exactly one place it belongs — you are reading the board, not guessing at it.

Drag a tile onto another to trade them, or tap one tile and then a second. Par is the fewest swaps that can finish the board, and it is computed rather than estimated, so it is a target you can actually beat instead of a grade. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard for 5×4, 7×5, and 9×6 boards, take a hint that is always an optimal swap, and keep personal best and average times for every difficulty.

Colours are generated in OKLab, so an equal step in the gradient looks like an equal step. No board is ever shown unless it stays readable with red and green removed, and a colour-blind palette option in Settings raises that floor further.

games.title: Draw To Goal - Soccer Game
games.description:
Draw to Goal is a fun and creative soccer puzzle game where your drawing skills decide every match! Instead of kicking the ball directly, you draw lines to guide the soccer ball into the goal. Each level challenges your logic, timing, and creativity as you find the perfect path to score.

In this unique draw-to-goal soccer game, every line matters. Use smart angles, avoid obstacles, and create clever paths to help the ball reach the goal. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Soccer is easy to play but hard to master, making it perfect for both casual players and puzzle lovers.

Enjoy hundreds of handcrafted soccer puzzle levels filled with traps, moving objects, and tricky goal positions. As you progress, the challenges become more complex, pushing you to think outside the box and draw smarter lines. Whether you’re a football fan or a brain-teasing puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers endless fun.

games.title: Draw Action Freestyle Fight
games.description: Unleash your creativity and power in Draw Action Freestyle Fight, a super fun draw-to-fight action game! Draw lines and shapes with your finger to command powerful punches, kicks, and combos against tough opponents in intense battles. Complete freedom to draw any attack you want, hilarious ragdoll physics when enemies get slapped or punched into the water, satisfying one-tap drawing mechanics, and addictive battles across different arenas!

games.title: Cool Tuning - Paint the Car
games.description:
"Cool Tuning: Paint the Car" is an exciting game for all fans of auto tuning and creativity! Our game resembles such hits as "Car Mechanic Simulator" and "Need for Speed", but offers a unique experience of creating and selling unique cars. Perfect for those who love customization and creativity.

Game features include: buying cars, spray painting, gluing films and stickers, and selling your masterpieces at auction. You can discover new colors, films and stickers in the store for even more variety.

games.title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
games.description:
You start with a small gas station in the middle of the highway, where everything depends on you. Service cars, fill up with gas, earn coins, and build even bigger! Over time, your gas station will grow into a true empire: with a store, restroom, cafe, and even a hot dog delivery service. The more customers, the more profit, upgrades, and fun!

Oversee your business, upgrade your stations, and hire employees to keep everything running smoothly. Even when you're offline, your gas station continues to earn! This isn't just a simulator—it's your path to success and the fun of managing your own mini-empire.

Game Features:
⛽ Upgrade your gas station and service more cars
🍔 Cook hot dogs and open a cozy cafe
🛒 Add a store and restroom for customers
💸 Earn money even when you're not playing
🏆 Become the ultimate gas station boss!

games.title: Solve the maze
games.description:
The game will appeal to fans of puzzles. There are 100 unique levels in the game. The difficulty of the levels gradually increases. If the level is too difficult for you, you can skip it by watching a video advertisement. For each level you complete, you are given crystals that can be spent on unlocking new items. Collect the entire collection!
You will definitely like:
- Smooth ball movement
- Lots of beautiful and vibrant paint colors
- Simple one touch control
- Great way to kill time

games.title: Monster Slayer. Idle Clicker
games.description: Monster Slayer is an action-packed game where you battle quirky monsters and gather valuable resources. Strengthen your hero by unlocking powerful skills and spells, capture monster souls to expand your collection, and trade Flame Shards for rare relics. Enhance your abilities with Inlay Stones and potions as you take on ever-stronger foes in your quest for victory!

games.title: Tile Stack
games.description:
This game is perfect for players who enjoy puzzle and strategy games. Its simple mechanics and increasing difficulty levels make it both accessible and addictive.
You will not realize how time passes by playing fun levels by putting tiles together

games.title: Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test
games.description: Welcome to Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test! 🧠✨ – the ultimate game where intelligence is key! Test your brainpower by completing fun mini-games 🕹️, taking on exciting challenges 🏆, and engaging in PvP duels 🤺 to earn IQ points and level up. Collect IQ scattered across the map, win mini-games for extra boosts, or spin the wheel of fortune for random IQ rewards. The more IQ you gain, the higher your status in the game, with trophies 🏆 that can be exchanged for cool pets 🐾. Prove you''''''''''''''''re the smartest player and rise to the top of the leaderboard. Ready to show off your genius? Play now and take your IQ to the next level!

games.title: Tilt & Tumble
games.description: Tilt & Tumble challenges players to master fast-paced action without needing extensive tutorials. Control the game using joystick or accelerometer to guide the paddle with precision, keeping the ball in play and scoring points. Enjoy dynamic music, unlock various paddles. Tilt & Tumble delivers an exhilarating gaming experience that keeps you coming back for more.

games.title: Doodle Halloween Momo Cat : Academy
games.description:
I, English:

Magic Cat Academy is a fun and adorable adventure game where you play as Momo the magic cat, a brave little student with big powers! One spooky night, silly ghosts sneak into her school and steal the magic book. Now it’s up to Momo to save the day!

To help Momo, players draw simple shapes on the screen to cast magic spells and pop the ghosts away. Each level takes you to a new part of the school, like the classroom, cafeteria, and even the rooftop. The ghosts get quicker and trickier, but with fast hands and sharp eyes, you can beat them all!

With cute characters, colorful animations, and easy touch controls, Magic Cat Academy is a safe, exciting, and kid-friendly game that’s perfect for players of all ages.

Help the lovely Momo Magic Cat cast out mischievous spirits by swiping in the shape of the symbols above the ghosts’ heads. And you’d better pounce fast—the ghost that stole the Arcane Magic spellbook is getting away! The school and all arcane magic are depended on your actions.

PURR-ify Ghost and Ghouls with your Arcane Magic. Swipe your magic wand to cast magic and save the Halloween.

II, Russian:

Magic Cat Academy — это весёлая и очаровательная приключенческая игра, в которой вы играете за Момо, волшебную кошечку, отважную маленькую ученицу с огромными способностями! Однажды жуткой ночью глупые призраки пробираются в её школу и крадут волшебную книгу. Теперь Момо предстоит спасти положение!

Чтобы помочь Момо, игроки рисуют на экране простые фигуры, чтобы колдовать и прогонять призраков. Каждый уровень переносит вас в новую часть школы, например, в класс, столовую и даже на крышу. Призраки становятся всё быстрее и хитрее, но с быстрыми руками и острым зрением вы сможете победить их всех!

С милыми персонажами, красочной анимацией и простым сенсорным управлением Magic Cat Academy — безопасная, увлекательная и дружелюбная для детей игра, идеально подходящая для игроков всех возрастов.

Помогите очаровательной волшебной кошечке Момо изгнать злых духов, проводя по символам над головами призраков. И поторопитесь — призрак, укравший книгу заклинаний «Тайная магия», убегает! Школа и вся тайная магия зависят от ваших действий.

Замурлыкайте призраков и упырей своей тайной магией. Взмахните волшебной палочкой, чтобы наложить магию и спасти Хэллоуин.

games.title: OUTSIDE
games.description:
OUTSIDE is a minimalist puzzle game where every move counts. Guide your one-eyed character across a grid to collect the key and unlock the door to the next level — but there’s a twist: once you start moving in a direction, you can’t stop until you hit a wall.

Plan your path carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. Simple to play, but tricky to master, OUTSIDE challenges your logic and spatial thinking with each new level.

games.title: Box Tap Sort
games.description: A head-to-head 3D color-sort puzzle. Dismantle candy-colored cube stacks by tapping cubes that match your active color orders. Wrong taps fill a limited holding bin — overflow resets the puzzle. Clear more structures than your rival before time runs out.

games.title: Hex Block Puzzle Master
games.description:
Engage your mind 🧠 and enjoy satisfying puzzle moments with Hex Block Puzzle Master 🟣⬡ – a relaxing yet challenging hex puzzle experience! Place colorful hex blocks 🎨 into the grid, solve clever layouts, and watch the board come alive ✨ as you complete each puzzle.

Designed for both casual fun 🎮 and deep thinking, Hex Block Puzzle Master offers endless entertainment without stress or pressure 😌.

Why You’ll Love Hex Block Puzzle Master ❤️

• Sharpen Your Mind 🧠
Challenge your logic and spatial thinking with carefully designed hex puzzles that get smarter as you progress 🔥.

• Relax & Enjoy 🌿
No timers, no rush ⏳❌. Play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, stress-free puzzle experience 😴✨.

• Beautiful & Colorful 🎨
Bright hex blocks, smooth animations, and clean visuals make every puzzle satisfying to complete 💎.

How to Play 🕹️

• Drag hexagonal blocks ⬡ and place them into the grid.
• Blocks cannot be rotated 🔄❌, so plan your moves wisely 🤔.
• Fill the available spaces perfectly to complete the puzzle ✅.

Features You’ll Enjoy ⭐

Easy to start, hard to master – perfect for all ages 👶➡️🧓.

Great for short breaks or long, relaxing play sessions 😌.

Train your mind 🧠, relax your thoughts 🌿, and become a true puzzle master 👑 with Hex Block Puzzle Master ✨🎮

games.title: Swap The Pictures
games.description:
Looks like a crossword. Feels like a brain workout.
In Swap The Pictures, you don’t spell words you connect ideas.
Match images to categories, solve overlaps, and watch the grid come together.

games.title: Sprunki: Collect All Characters!
games.description:
Sprunki: Collect All Characters! — a dynamic platformer where dangerous levels, skillful jumps, and the hunt for rare heroes await you! Complete challenging stages, collect items, and unlock more and more characters from the world of Sprunki. Can you become number one in the rankings? 🔥

🏃‍♂️ What awaits you:
• Exciting platformer gameplay — run, jump, and survive on dangerous levels ⚡
• Moving platforms and traps — test your reaction and skills 😈
• Ropes, gaps, and obstacles — every level brings a new challenge 🎭
• Character collection — unlock unique heroes from the Sprunki world ✨
• Tough moments — only the most skilled will reach the end 💪
• Player rankings — compete with others and become the best 🏆
• Fun boosters — move faster, jump higher, and play even cooler 🚀

Collect all characters, overcome every challenge, and prove that you are the true hero of the Sprunki world! 👑
[Core Gameplay & Story\]
Q: What is the game about and what do you do?
A: It is a 2D platformer where you jump across various platforms to find and collect all the Sprunkis for your collection. You must navigate obstacles and plan your moves to reach specific platforms and collect special items. Each item belongs to a specific Sprunki; you need to collect 10 items of the same type to find and unlock that Sprunki for your collection.

Q: What is the game's standout feature and why will it appeal to players?
A: The game features high-quality polish, beautiful graphics, and a wide variety of features that keep the gameplay feeling fresh and diverse.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: The Sprunkis themselves are the main draw.

\[Economy & Customization\]
Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game? Does spending money speed up progress?
A: Yes, you can purchase an ad-free experience as well as unlimited boosts, such as the magnet, double jump, and increased movement speed.

\[Retention & Engagement\]
Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are available?
A: Yes, there are leaderboards. Your score and ranking are determined by how many Sprunki unlock items you have collected.

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: There are rewards granted for every 5 minutes of play that refresh when you restart the game. these consist of boosts like the magnet, double jump, and movement speed.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without it make the game difficult?
A: It is not required, but the sound design is high quality and enhances the experience.

games.title: Doodle Boba Bubble Tea.
games.description:
Tangy and fruity or sweet and milky? The combinations are endless!

games.title: Picture Jam Factory

games.title: Mahjong Sweet Connection Easter
games.description: Indulge in a sweet Easter treat with Mahjong-Sweet-Connection-Easter, a delightful match-3 & mahjong hybrid puzzle game! games.title: Mirrors and Rays
games.description:
Turn the mirrors, light up the whole field and relax in the peaceful world of lasers.

Reboot your mind — one perfect ray of light at a time! This is your digital zen garden, where every solved puzzle is a step towards inner peace.

games.title: Stickman in space
games.description: Join Stickman in Space for a thrilling journey as a lost astronaut on the moon. Overcome space obstacles and discover your route back to Earth. games.title: Stack the Blocks
games.description: Dive into the captivating world of Stack the Blocks, a strategic online puzzle game on a 10x10 grid. Challenge your logic by placing blocks to clear lines and earn points. Accessible yet complex, it guarantees addictive entertainment on both mobile and desktop platforms.

games.title: Bunny Escape
games.description: In Bunny Escape you play as a bunny that gets trapped in different situations. The game works with just one button. Escape from those situations by running, attacking and jumping across the different worlds.

games.title: Grow a Garden 3D
games.description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! 🌳

games.title: Rotate Cups
games.description:
This is a rotation physics puzzle game where you control the angle of cups to try to get the balls to roll into specific cups.
Rotate cups clockwise or counterclockwise as needed to turn the clear cups into ramps guiding the ball down the level.
Place at least one ball in each of the blue cups.
In this game you have to get all the balls into the blue cups lower down the screen.
Larger blue cups can hold more than one ball in them.
If there are multiple smaller blue cups you must get a ball into each of them.
Levels are not timed & you can both rotate as many times as you like & pause as many times as you like.

You can skip intermediary cups. On most levels you typically want to use all the cups on the way down, but if you are struggling to do so you can bump a ball off the outside of a cup or skip a cup entirely & it won’t harm you in the least provided your balls eventually get into the blue cups.
Some levels have a long reach you have to make the ball roll. On those levels sometimes a somewhat rapid cup spin toward the destination is enough, but in some cases you have to do that rapid spin as the starting point & then slightly spin back quickly right as the ball is leaving to give the ball a bit more lift.

Zombie Raid is a fast-paced survival action game where you must fight off hordes of zombies, complete dangerous missions, and upgrade your gear. The city has been overrun by monsters, and only you can clear the streets and stop the growing threat.

A: While the music complements the game well, it is not necessary for gameplay.
