If you're into puzzle games like hexa sort, card sort, wood puzzles, and a factory theme, this game is perfect for you.
"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: In the game, you need to sort wooden hexes into trays at a factory.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no strict storyline, but the goal is clear: you must sort the hexes into trays while managing your workspace.

Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? How can it appeal to players?
A: Appealing graphics, good sound design, and the satisfying feeling of completing a task.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to popular franchises, etc.)?
A: Appealing graphics and increasingly complex mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does progression work? What should players do to level up faster?
A: Complete levels and expand your arsenal of upgrades.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (e.g., standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on unlocking new slots and upgrades.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without sound make the game difficult?
A: The music complements the game well, but it is not essential for completing the levels."

games.title: Mini Chess
games.description: Mini Chess brings 25 chess variants to boards from 4×4 to 6×6 — classics like Gardner, Los Alamos and Petty Chess alongside original layouts. Every game is a sharp, tactical duel that fits in a few minutes: beat the AI to unlock the next board, earn a star for each difficulty you clear, and climb the leaderboard by collecting the most stars. Each board comes with a short note on its history, and an in-game rules card tells you exactly what applies. Four difficulty levels, undo, Korean and English.

games.title: The long way home
games.description:
Your ship is gone. You are a very long way from Earth, with a suit, a tank of fuel, and the air in your lungs.

The Long Way Home is a game about thrust being precious and drift being free. Every burn spends fuel you may never replace, so the fastest route is rarely the straight one. Swing past a planet and let its gravity throw you onward for nothing, and keep the fuel for the moment you actually need it.

Between you and home: abandoned supply stations, each holding one decisive resupply. Sealed containers you can crack open if you have the patience. Debris fields that will shred you at speed and let you pass at a crawl.

VESTA, the assistance unit strapped to your chest, talks you through it. She is a machine and says so, and she will tell you when your heading is wrong.

Get to Earth before the oxygen runs out. Then do it again, carrying cargo.

games.title: Chainsaw 3D
games.description: Chainsaw 3D is an exciting online arcade game where you cut logs using a chainsaw. Available for free on multiple platforms, this engaging woodcutting challenge blends skill and puzzle elements, requiring concentration to succeed at each new level. Aim to become the top woodcutter!

games.title: Survival Sandbox for 99 Nights
games.description:
Four children have gone missing in the forest. You have 99 nights to find them before the woods claim them forever.

🔦 Life-Risking Search:
Explore a vast, living forest that changes with every sunset.
The children are scattered across different, most dangerous zones of the forest. You must find and lead each one to safety.

⚔️ Survival and Defense:
Gather weapons, avoid traps, and seek shelter.
Fend off packs of hungry wolves, rogue bears, and other dangers.
Manage your basic needs: health and hunger.

🦌 The Main Antagonist — The Deer:
The Deer guards the forest's secrets and considers the children its property.
It cannot be killed with ordinary weapons. You can only drive it away, deceive it, or temporarily restrain it.

🌙 The Day-Night Cycle — Key to Survival:
Day: A relatively safe time for exploration, gathering resources, and crafting.
Night: Time of the hunt. Darkness awakens the forest's horrors. It is at night that you will encounter the Deer.

games.title: Tom and Angela Insta Fashion
games.description: Help Tom & Angela to become Instagram famous. Buy and choose clothes, hairstyles, or accessories by following their moods. Make them look stunning on every occasion, take beautiful pictures to post on Instagram and receive lots of likes. Get their insta-ready outfits and have fun!

games.title: Logo Quiz Master
games.description: Test your knowledge and challenge your brain with Logo Quiz Master, the ultimate trivia game for logo enthusiasts! Dive into a world of iconic brands, famous companies, and unforgettable symbols as you guess the logos from various categories. Whether you're a casual gamer or a trivia master, this game will keep you entertained for hours!

games.title: Dice Merge
games.description: Roll, merge, and race against time in this fast-paced dice puzzle game. Each roll resets a 10-second timer, and your score is multiplied by the time you have left. Drag and merge matching dice to build higher numbers, use special X dice to destroy others for extra points, and strategize before the clock runs out. Reach higher combos, manage your limited dice count, and aim for the best score before time hits zero.

games.title: Pixel Tetris
games.description: Pixel Blocks is a compact arcade puzzle about clean lines, fast restarts, and readable pixel effects. Play classic score attack, try physical falling cells, build sand bridges, escape the rising hazard, defuse hot bombs, unlock visual skins, and challenge a bot in Bot Duel. Choose Easy, Normal, or Hard and earn 15, 30, or 45 bonus coins when the bot tops out first.

games.title: Void Shot
games.description: Void Shot is a one-hand neon arcade shooter set in the glowing depths of space. Slide your turret along the bottom of the screen — it fires on its own — and pop endless waves of pulsing rings before they reach you. Every fifth wave ends in a boss fight, and each boss plays differently: some teleport, some split, some spawn minions. Random wave modifiers — crosswind, low gravity, turbo drift, extra bounce — reshuffle the rules so no two runs feel the same. Catch power-ups (frost, double damage, rapid fire, shield), bank coins and permanently upgrade your turret between runs. How deep into the void can you go?

games.title: Scratch Raw Stone: Gem Master
games.description:
Buy rough stones and scratch them open slowly—every rock hides rich color, hairline cracks, or nothing at all.

Take the dealer's cash offer mid-scratch, or hold out to craft rare gems into jewelry for bigger profits, and grow your gem workshop!

games.title: Wobble Run
games.description:
Wobble Run is a 13+ arcade balance runner. You auto-run a leaning stack of wet-ink cans across Sky Docks, Slice Street, and Hive Yard. Catch more to grow taller. Tip is the only fail.

• Three worlds, 16 levels each
• Touch or mouse to steer into the lean
• Cosmetics unlock from play — no accounts, no IAP
• Stack wet. Don’t tip.

Height is easy. Balance is the game.

games.title: Ashfall Industries
games.description:
Ashfall Industries is a comic atompunk idle management game about turning a battered wasteland into a thriving industrial frontier.
Start with a humble Rustwater Pump, collect Scrap, and build a network of increasingly ambitious operations: greenhouses, salvage yards, radio stations, caravan routes, drone workshops, refineries, and more.
Every operation can be upgraded for bigger payouts and faster cycles. Hire distinctive Crew Chiefs to automate production, then invest in Retrofits that improve output, speed, costs, and Lucky Find rewards. When your industry is ready for a fresh start, trigger Reclamation to earn Reactor Cores and unlock permanent Recovery Protocols that make every rebuild stronger.

Core Features
- Build 15 original wasteland operations, from clean-water pumps to the Horizon Reactor.
- Collect Scrap, level up production, and hit new Benchmarks for bigger rewards.
- Hire Crew Chiefs to automate your best operations while you expand the business.
- Buy Retrofits to improve output, cycle speed, salvage efficiency, and Lucky Finds.
- Catch Lucky Finds for boosted payouts and satisfying bursts of progress.
- Use Reclamation to reset strategically, earn Reactor Cores, and purchase permanent upgrades.
- Grow a colorful rust-and-turquoise industrial empire at your own pace.

games.title: Number Merge 10
games.description: Number Merge 10 is a very innovative math puzzle game.Select a rectangular area, and if the sum of the numbers within that area equals 10, all the numbers in that area will be eliminated!

games.title: Loopvival
games.description:
Loopvival is an atmospheric survival game with elements of roguelite, built around the mechanics of cycles.
You find yourself in a world consumed by Darkness, where the only source of light is a bonfire in the center of the map. Collect resources, boost your fire, unlock new territories, and rebuild ruined ruins to learn the story of a lost world.
Each cycle brings the world back to the beginning, but the campfire's progress and key improvements persist, gradually allowing you to move further into the Darkness. The simple action game, meditative gameplay, and gradual opening of the lore make Loopvival a short but seamless gaming experience.

games.title: Dungeon Master - Cult & Craft
games.description:
Become a dungeon keeper, control stickmen, mine ore, develop a Cult and hold power in this exciting 3D simulator! Develop the Cult, manage resources and expand the boundaries of your underground Universe!

⛏ Resource extraction - send followers for ore and minerals.
🏛 Cult development - maintain loyalty at a high level.
👀 Captivating 3D graphics - fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of darkness.
⚒ Dungeon upgrade - build, improve and strengthen your base.
💰 Economic strategy – distribute the spoils and increase wealth.

games.title: Obby: Build an ASMR Keyboard Tycoon
games.description:
Obby: Build an ASMR Keyboard Tycoon is a fun Roblox-style simulator where you build your own ASMR keyboard and turn it into a massive money-making machine. Every key press earns cash, and your goal is to create the most profitable and satisfying keyboard possible!

Build, Upgrade, Earn!

Upgrade your typing speed, increase the money earned from every key press, and unlock new keyboard colors, designs, and effects. Hire workers to generate income automatically, even while you're busy exploring.

Compete against other players on the global leaderboard and become the richest ASMR keyboard owner. The better your upgrades, the faster your income grows—and the closer you get to the top!

Features
🎹 Build and customize your ASMR keyboard
💰 Upgrade typing speed and earnings
👷 Hire workers for automatic income
🏆 Compete on the global leaderboard
✨ Relaxing ASMR atmosphere with satisfying visuals
🚀 Become the ultimate keyboard tycoon!

games.title: Idle Tower Defense
games.description: Build your ultimate idle tower defense! Merge strategy, upgrades, and epic battles in this thrilling idle defense game. Protect your tower from endless waves of enemies in the best incremental game experience online!

games.title: Match Story : Animals
games.description: Match Story Animals is a fun and addictive 3D puzzle game where players must match cute animal objects to clear the board. With smooth gameplay, colorful graphics, and hundreds of levels, it offers hours of entertainment for puzzle lovers. Use power-ups, boosters, and smart strategies to progress through challenging stages. Perfect for casual gamers of all ages!

games.title: Squishy Sheep
games.description:
Your mission is to help an adorable cat friend collect every balloon in each level. All it takes is removing the right platform at just the right moment and letting physics do the magic.

Every level is carefully designed to be solved with just a few clicks, while the sheep bounces across ledges and gathers balloons in delightful, unexpected ways. With fluid animations and a cute, inviting art style, Squishy Sheep keeps you coming back for more until every level is complete.

games.title: Clawler Fight
games.description:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling blend of addictive gameplay of Clawler fight! In this action-packed game, you step into the shoes of an ordinary guy on a mission to survive the zombie apocalypse while tackling challenging levels. Maneuver a crane equipped with a claw to pick up objects and launch them at zombies! As you advance, you will collect valuable resources and currency, unlocking powerful upgrades for your character through a card-based skill progression system.

Prepare for fierce battles against a variety of terrifying zombies, each possessing unique abilities and strengths. Your ultimate objective is to survive.

Are you ready to face the ultimate challenge of skill and strategy? Gather your courage, sharpen your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable adventure in this ARPG masterpiece!

games.title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
games.description: Jixora is a relaxing jigsaw solitaire puzzle game where you piece together beautiful artwork. Journey through 100 unique levels with increasing difficulty, or unlock Free Play mode to replay your favorites with custom grid sizes. Race against the clock to earn stars, use strategic power-ups like Hints and Time Freezes, and immerse yourself in a cinematic atmosphere with soothing music.

games.title: Bottle Color Match Challenge
games.description:
Your task is simple but thrillingly challenging: arrange the bottles so that the colors match! Move, combine, and find matches to complete the level.

✨ Why will you love it?
✔ Simple yet addictive – easy to start, hard to stop!
✔ Vibrant graphics – pleasing colors and smooth animations.
✔ Relax or challenge yourself – play for fun or race against the clock.
✔ Perfect for all ages – fun for the whole family!

Can you beat all the levels? Test your wits and become a true Bottle Master! 🏆

👉 Start playing right now! 👈

games.title: Animal Transform Race
games.description: Animal Transform Race is a fun game based on reaction where different types of animals compete. Each animal is fast in some areas and very slow in some tracks according to their abilities. Try to lead the race by making the right choices. The faster you make animal choices, the more advantages you gain. You can unlock new animals from the market section with the coins you earn from the races.

games.title: Color Blast Puzzle
games.description:
Get ready for a colorful and satisfying puzzle adventure with Color Blast Puzzle! Tap and clear groups of matching colored blocks, create powerful chain reactions, and complete challenging objectives across exciting levels.

Every level gives you a limited number of moves, so plan your actions carefully and think ahead. The bigger the group you clear, the more rewarding your moves become. Use strategic clicks to create impressive combos and unlock powerful boosters that can clear multiple blocks at once.

With bright colorful graphics, satisfying popping effects, unique level objectives, and increasingly challenging layouts, Color Blast Puzzle is easy to learn but challenging to master.

Challenge your brain, improve your strategy, and blast your way through every level. Can you complete them all and become the ultimate Color Blast Puzzle master?

games.title: Deorbit - Space Survivors
games.description:
Deorbit is a fast-paced top-down space survivor shooter. You command a lone starship stranded in hostile sectors, and wave after wave of enemy swarms close in from every direction. Your weapons fire automatically — your job is to fly, dodge, and stay alive as the horde grows.
Vacuum up glowing XP orbs to level up mid-run, then choose from a hand of upgrade cards to shape your build on the fly — more firepower, drones, shields, and devastating new abilities. Crack open chests that drop into the battlefield for extra loot, push through 10 escalating phases per sector, and brace for massive boss encounters that can turn the tide.
Every run earns gold. Spend it back at your hangar to permanently upgrade your ship, unlock new vessels, and gear up before diving back in. Claim daily rewards, chase new records, and see how deep into the sectors you can survive. No two runs play the same.
Think you can beat your best score? Suit up, Commander.
Tips
Grab XP orbs to level up, then pick the upgrade cards that fit your build.
Open chests for bonus drones, cells, and items during a run.
Spend gold in the hangar between runs to make your ship permanently stronger.
Survive to face the sector boss — beating it pushes you deeper.

games.title: Blocky Guns
games.description: Collect colored blocks, build powerful weapons, and fight your way through waves of enemies in this blocky first-person shooter. Unlock and use different weapon types, including pistols, machine guns, rocket launchers, and grenades. Choose the right gun for each battle, upgrade your firepower, and survive intense combat across dangerous levels.

games.title: Troll Rider
games.description:
Troll Rider is an endless downhill X-bike adventure where the road cannot be trusted.
Ride deeper and deeper down the mountain, jump across gaps, perform backflips, collect Golden Gears, and survive a world full of unexpected troll traps. Trees may fall, ramps can disappear, bridges can break, signs may lie, and even a harmless-looking Gear trail might lead to trouble.
Crash? You still have a chance. Use your hearts, retry the same troll instantly, learn its trick, and come back for REVENGE.
The farther you ride, the stranger the mountain becomes—with new biomes, new traps, helpful surprises, massive set pieces, and trolls that start changing the rules you thought you already understood.
How far can you ride before the mountain finally gets you?

games.title: Mushroom Runners
games.description: Run endlessly in Mushroom Runners! Dodge obstacles, crush enemies, and collect mushrooms to grow HUGE! Ride the Happy Flying Cloud in this fun, fast-paced endless runner with a unique platforming twist.

games.title: Dig & Flow - Save Water
games.description:
Dig through the sand and guide flowing elements through level labyrinths to collect all the stars. Use element physics, plan the route carefully, and control the streams to activate mechanisms and open new paths. Simple controls make the game easy to understand from the first seconds, but each level requires more logic and precision.

Different elements appear throughout the levels — water, lava, and hot steam. Each behaves differently and opens new ways to solve puzzles.

games.title: A deadly car crash
games.description:
Try this deadly descent—only 1% of people have ever made it.

Immerse yourself in a thrilling world of destruction and speed!
This game lets you control cars that crash with stunning realism. Doors, hoods, and wheels can fly off with a powerful impact!

Create unique cars by changing the body color, parts, and adjusting the size and placement of the wheels. Meet other cars racing along the roads and compete in spectacular crashes. Enjoy crazy jumps, collisions, and complete freedom of action!

Realistic car destruction
Customization: color, wheels, and style
Vast open world
Unique crash test areas
Destroy, build, and race—create your own chaos on the road!

games.title: Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive
games.description: Experience the excitement of Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive, a dynamic game where you merge items to craft powerful tools and potions. Test your strategy as you navigate dungeons. Play for free online on both mobile and desktop. Embrace your heroic side!

games.title: Syntagma
games.description:
A puzzle adventure with platformer elements.

A suddenly arrived package contains a mysterious artifact, similar to a compass, and an ancient map pointing the way to five mysterious locations with abandoned temples.

To activate the compass and reveal the secrets of the temples, the hero must find unique crystals, symbolizing the five elements, scattered around the world.

To obtain a crystal, you can solve the puzzle only by jumping on active platforms. The correct sequence of stepping on the platforms and collecting all the keys on them opens the vault and grants access to the crystal. There are restrictions on moving across the platforms.

Moving backward and diagonally is prohibited.

Movement is only allowed forward, left, and right.

The start of movement activates defense mechanisms and obstacles that cause damage.

There are 2 difficulty levels, which can be changed in the main menu settings. After completing Level 0, the game will automatically suggest trying Level 1.

games.title: Merge Furry Monsters
games.description:
The game 'Merge Monsters - Fluffy Frenzy' is an entertaining game with incredibly cute and charismatic little monsters.

Each monster is not just a cute colorful furball, but also an incredibly charismatic personality, with its own name, emotions, and feelings.

Who knows, maybe behind each monster's emotion lies a story - happy or sad.

Maybe someday we will find out...

games.title: Insect Exploration
games.description: There will be snails, spider ,grasshoppers, and other insects. Thrive by hopping, flying, and bouncing your way to victory in this bugs simulator game! . It's simple to unblock yet difficult to master. Are you ready to go? Now is the time to download!

games.title: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight!
games.description: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight! — is a fast-paced voxel multiplayer shooter with fully destructible, physics-driven maps — buildings collapse and debris change the battlefield. Build bases and fortifications, carve tactical paths, and turn the environment into a weapon. Core modes: Sandbox (creative freedom), Capture the Flag (team tactics), and Team Deathmatch (intense PvP). Quick matchmaking, custom rooms, localized UI and optimization for web/mobile platforms. Join the fights — build, destroy, win!

games.title: Capybara-HexaSort
games.description: Capybara Hexa Sort is a relaxing color-sorting puzzle game with a cheerful capybara theme. Place stacks of colorful hexagonal tiles on the board and watch matching top colors merge automatically. Plan every move, complete increasingly challenging level goals, collect rewards, and enjoy a satisfying blend of strategy and cozy visuals.

games.title: Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots
games.description:
Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots! Escape the tsunami, upgrade your base, rescue, and steal Brainrots. Can you catch all the legendary Brainrots?

Are you ready for the wildest race of your life? This exciting game offers an incredible mix of action and collecting! Your main goal is to escape the giant tsunami that's relentlessly pursuing you.

How to play? 🎮
Control your character, accelerate, and collect funny creatures along the way—Brainrots. The more you catch, the more you earn! But be careful: hesitate, and the wave will completely overwhelm you.

Development and leveling up 💪
Earn coins and invest them in upgrades! Level up your Brainrots to make them more profitable. Expand your base by unlocking new slots.

Legendary Goal ✨
Rumors of legendary creatures circulate among the many Brainrots... Will you be the lucky one to solve this mystery? Only the fastest and luckiest will reach the final!

Join the chase, dodge the waves, complete your collection, and become the world champion of "Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots"! 🏆

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: You must survive a tsunami, rescue brainrots, and upgrade your base.

Q: Is there a storyline?

A: There isn't a formal story, but the objective is clear: escape the tsunami, save brainrots, and improve your base.

Q: What is the game's hook or unique feature?

A: The game features obbies and rare brainrots.

Q: Are there any particularly engaging elements?

A: The game includes rare and funny brainrots.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work?

A: You earn coins from brainrots and invest them to increase your running speed. You can also level up your brainrots to make them more profitable and expand your base by unlocking new slots.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and how are they spent?

A: There are two currencies: money and diamonds. They can be spent on speed boosts, packs, and the battle pass.

Q: Are there in-game purchases?

A: Yes, you can purchase diamonds and a battle pass.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards to keep players coming back?

A: Yes, logging in every day grants you diamonds, money, or a brainrot.

Q: Is it better to play with sound?

A: The music complements the experience well, but it isn't required to progress through the game.

games.title: Construction Set - 3D Builder
games.description:
Construction Set - 3D Builder is a creative building puzzle game that lets you step into the role of a master builder. You’ll design and assemble intricate 3D structures, piece by piece, turning simple parts into impressive creations. Challenge your skills, unleash your imagination, and watch your architectural masterpieces come to life. Let your creativity flow as you construct and unwind. 
Construction Set - 3D Builder is more than just a puzzle game; 
its a canvas for your imagination. 
Whether you are a budding architect or simply love the satisfaction of seeing your creations come to life, this building game will provide hours of enjoyable and challenging gameplay.
🌟 Build Your World, Brick by Brick! 
🌟Features Variety of Themes: Explore a wide range of themes and environments, from lush forests to bustling cities, each with its own unique set of structures to construct. 
Whether you are building a towering skyscraper or a cozy cabin, there is always something exciting to create.
Realistic Physics: Construction Set - 3D Builder game features realistic physics, ensuring that your structures are not only visually stunning but also stable. 
Relaxing Gameplay: With its soothing music and relaxing gameplay, Construction Set - 3D Builder game offers a tranquil escape from the everyday hustle and bustle.

games.title: Plants vs Brainrots 2D
games.description:
🌱 Plants vs Brainrots 2D is a fast-paced action game inspired by the classic “Plants vs Zombies”, but with a completely different and chaotic twist.

Brainrots appear in waves and fly across the screen. They don’t attack plants directly - their main threat is their huge amount of health. Your goal is to place plants wisely, upgrade them, and deal maximum damage to take down the toughest enemies.

🧠 The game features common, rare, and legendary Brainrots.
🎯 Your main objective is to defeat 3 legendary Brainrots with massive health pools.
🌿 Plants attack automatically, each with unique damage types and characteristics.
⚡ Simple controls, colorful visuals, and dynamic gameplay make the game perfect for both short and long sessions.

💻 Playable on PC, with smooth controls and optimized performance.

🔥 Plants vs Brainrots 2D combines strategy, action, and meme-style chaos. Jump in and see if you can defeat the legendary Brainrots!

games.title: Match Challenge
games.description: A simple but engaging matching challenge! Look at the variety of items at the bottom of the screen, and tap four that belong to the same category whether it's fruits, tools, animals, or household objects. Think fast, but choose wisely!

games.title: Police Drift Escape
games.description:
Police Drift Escape is a fast, simple, and addictive top-down drift survival game.

You are the getaway driver. Police cars are coming from every direction. Drift, dodge, collect cash, and make the police crash into each other before they catch you.

There is no road. No traffic. No complicated rules. Just pure arcade chasing on a clean open surface.

Drift to Survive

Your car keeps moving. Use smooth control to turn, slide, and escape at the last second. The police cars are faster, but they cannot turn as sharply as you. Use that advantage to make them miss.

A perfect drift can save you.
A wrong move can end the chase.

Make Police Crash

You do not need weapons. Your best weapon is your driving skill.

Bait police cars into following you, turn at the right moment, and watch them crash into each other. Every police crash gives you more score and makes the escape more satisfying.

Grab the Cash

Cash bundles appear during the chase. Collect them for extra rewards, but be careful. Some cash is placed in risky spots, and chasing it too greedily can get you caught.

Normal cash gives quick rewards.
Golden cash gives bigger rewards.
But survival always comes first.

games.title: Playful Cup
games.description:
The glass is sad because it's empty. Your job is to make the glass filled up with liquid and smile again!

Try to find the best way to complete each level. You can come up with your own solution so be creative and don't be afraid to think out of the box!

There are 3 game modes to play!

games.title: King of Mahjong: Connecting Tiles
games.description:
"King of Mahjong: Connecting Tiles" - an exciting, colorful, and straightforward puzzle game in the Mahjong genre, where you need to match identical character tiles. In the game, you will find:

- Familiar characters
- A simplified version of the Mahjong game, where anyone can understand the rules
- Numerous levels with adjustable difficulty (board size) based on your preferences
- Simple controls, colorful graphics, and pleasant background music make this game an excellent time-killer.

games.title: Air Assault: Ship Defense
games.description:
Man a twin AA gun on a WW2 destroyer and shoot down waves of diving planes before they sink your ship. Air Assault puts you in the splinter tub of a wartime destroyer — twin barrels, open ocean, and enemy aircraft diving straight at your deck. Aim with the crosshair, manage gun heat, and cut down fighters before they reach the hull.

Stages ramp up fast: denser swarms, faster dives, bombers and armored blimps on high flyovers, and kamikazes that don’t turn away. Planes shoot back. Bombs fall. One bad miss and the ship goes down.

Upgrade your mount between runs, climb the stages, and hold the line as the sky fills with incoming fire. Simple controls, sharp 3D action — pure anti-aircraft mayhem in the middle of the Pacific.

games.title: SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies
games.description: Engage in SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies, a thrilling strategy game where you defend humanity from a zombie apocalypse. Enjoy online gameplay without downloads, equip over 50 unique weapons, and face endless undead waves. Test your skills in various modes and strive for victory in PvP battles.

games.title: 3D Triple Match
games.description:
Dive into 3D Triple Match, an addictive and relaxing 3D puzzle matching game designed to test your observation and sorting skills. Find, match, and clear vibrant 3D objects from a messy pile before the timer runs out. Featuring smooth animations, satisfying physics, and hundreds of challenging levels, it is the perfect brain trainer for players of all ages.
Key Features
- Stunning 3D Visuals: High-quality 3D items ranging from toys, food, and animals to everyday household objects.
- Brain-Training Gameplay: Sharpen your memory, focus, and visual recognition with every puzzle.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: Enjoy seamless offline gameplay whenever you need a quick mental break.

games.title: Home Run Infinity
games.description: Time your swing and launch the ball as far as possible in an endless arcade baseball challenge. Earn coins from every hit, unlock 25 increasingly powerful bats, discover 10 distinctive fields, and compete for the longest hit on the Playgama leaderboard.

games.title: Santa Gift Delivery Christmas Game
games.description:
Fly Santa’s sleigh and deliver gifts across wintry cityscapes.

Become Santa Claus and zoom across a snowy winter wonderland in this festive season!

• Festive missions — Fly Santa’s sleigh, deliver presents to every house before Christmas Eve, dodge snowstorms and traffic.
• Magic holiday visuals — Sparkling snow, glowing lights, reindeer powered sleigh, cheerful children — made for couch-play with family and friends.
• Easy to pick up, hours of fun - Perfect for kids, casual gamers and family gatherings.
• Unlockable & extras — Upgrade your sleigh, collect coins, choose new reindeer partners, decorate your route.
• Seasonal treat — A cheerful Christmas game that spreads joy!

Download now and make this holiday season unforgettable. Santa's waiting and adventure is about to begin!

games.title: Stack Swipe
games.description:
Welcome to Stack Swipe, a colorful puzzle game where every swipe brings you closer to satisfying chain reactions!
Swipe to shift entire rows or columns and stack same colored plates.
Match at least 5 plates in one stack to trigger a blast and work your way toward the level’s target!

games.title: Squid Game Ultimate Challenge!
games.description: You must pass the squid trials and reach the red line to discover all the secrets! Be careful when the red light is on or when the doll stops talking, you must never move!

games.title: Soccer Strike
games.description: Experience casual soccer at its finest with intuitive pull-back and strike controls. Form your striking lineup, aim for the goal, and enjoy Soccer Strike—the perfect mix of fun and competitive play in an instant game tribute to the world's favorite sport.

games.title: Only Up Obby: Tower Climb
games.description:
Only Up Obby: Tower Climb is a 3D obby parkour platformer: run, jump and climb a huge tower made of 30 hand-built levels. Every level brings new traps: moving and vanishing platforms, spinning blades, crushers, conveyors, springs, wind zones and swinging hammers. Fall and you lose height, so every jump counts.

Collect coins and diamonds on the way, unlock 30+ skins (frog, spider, cat, dog, capybara, stickman and their color variants), compete for the best height in the online leaderboard and skip a level if it gets too hard. A training hall teaches every obstacle before the real climb.

Works on desktop and mobile: keyboard and mouse, or a floating joystick with auto-run and one big jump button on touch screens. English and Russian.

games.title: Animal Merge
games.description:
Objective: Merge animal bubbles to create upgraded animals and ultimately achieve the final objective by collecting fully developed animals.
Gameplay Instructions:
Launching the Animal Bubbles:
Tap on an animal bubble to select it.
Drag the bubble backward to aim.
Release to launch the bubble in the opposite direction.
Merging Animal Bubbles:
When two identical animal bubbles collide, they merge to create an upgraded version.
Continue merging bubbles of the same type to progress.
Achieving the Objective:
Merge two basic-level animal bubbles to form an intermediate-level animal.
Merge intermediate-level animal bubbles to create the final full-fledged animal.
Once the final animal is created, it is automatically collected as part of the level objective.
Winning the Level:
The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.

games.title: Tiny Sports Empire Idle
games.description: Tiny Sports Empire Idle is a sports management idle game where you build a growing multi-sport franchise across basketball, hockey, soccer, rugby, volleyball, and baseball. Earn cash, upgrade your training plans, improve your win chance, unlock new sports, recruit players, equip gear, and boost your team power. Matches are simulated automatically, so every upgrade and strategic choice helps your club grow faster. Keep expanding your sports empire with idle income, offline rewards, special events, skills, and season progress as you turn a small hoops team into a full sports dynasty.

games.title: Numbers Match 2448
games.description: Numbers Match 2448 is a relaxing and addictive number puzzle game where you match, merge, and build bigger numbers with every move. Place number blocks carefully, create smart combinations, and complete each level’s goal before the board fills up. Easy to start and satisfying to master, it is a great brain teaser for players who enjoy number games, merge puzzles, and 2048-style challenges.

games.title: Sky Blocks Falling
games.description:
Sky Blocks Falling is an idle Arkanoid-style game where you catch falling blocks to fill platforms and earn money.

Features
Upgrade your speed for faster block-catching
Add more platforms to increase your capacity
Unlock critical hits for bonus rewards
Boost your income with progressive upgrades
Prestige to accelerate future progress
Complete a variety of achievements
Customize your experience with block skins and atmospheric themes
Can you build the ultimate sky-falling machine?

games.title: Obby, but you're on a motorcycle
games.description:
Have you ever wondered what would happen if you tried to race a track… on a motorcycle? Get ready for total chaos, crazy stunts, and nonstop fun as you speed, crash, and fly your way to the finish line!

- A ton of awesome worlds! Conquer one crazy track after another to unlock brand-new maps filled with ramps, loops, and tricky surprises.
- Crazy challenges on every level! From slippery roads and slanted ramps to crazy stunts and unexpected turns—no two tracks are alike.
- Motorcycle madness! Accelerate to the limit, race through obstacles, and perform fun gravity-defying maneuvers. The faster you go, the more fun it gets!

Jump on, hit the gas, and get ready for total chaos in “Obby, but you're on a motorcycle”. It’s fast, fun, and absolutely ridiculous—in the best possible way!

games.title: Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie
games.description:
Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie - Your Camp, Your Rules! 

You are the leader of a survivor group in the heart of a zombie apocalypse. This is a thrilling idle tycoon strategy where your goal is to protect the barrier, gather resources, and survive! A true survival simulator for those who love camp management and crushing hordes of enemies.
What awaits you:

✅ Trap Defense: Protect your barrier! Research and install deadly gear - from deadly spikes to massive decoy bombs!
✅  Relocation & Progress: Don't stay still! Move between motels and farms, upgrade your camp, and unlock new zones.
✅  Scavenging Runs: Send your team for fuel. It’s a classic survival strategy - every drop of gas counts!
✅  Camp Evolution: Develop your facilities, automate your income, and become the ultimate master of the wasteland!

Strengthen the barrier, gear up your scouts, and hit the gas. Become a survival legend right now!

games.title: Furious GT Drift
games.description:
Feel the roar of the engine and the thrill of burning rubber in Furious GT Drift! Take control of high-performance GT cars and master the art of drifting through neon streets, mountain passes, and blazing sunset highways. Every corner tests your precision, timing, and style as you push your ride to the limit.

Customize your car, upgrade your handling, and chase new records with each drift combo you land. Earn rewards, unlock faster machines, and dominate every track with smooth slides and perfect angles.

games.title: BorderClash
games.description:

games.title: Road Fury - Racing
games.description:
Dive into dynamic 3D racing where your main goal is to reach the finish line first. The track is full of rivals, dangerous obstacles, traps, ramps, and sharp turns that will test your reaction speed and driving skills.

Every collision damages your car: the body breaks, wheels can fly off, and handling becomes harder. Use nitro, avoid hazards, upgrade your vehicle, and buy new cars to become the race leader.

- Dynamic 3D racing with rivals
- Lots of obstacles, traps, and ramps
- Realistic car damage
- Nitro for powerful speed boosts
- Car upgrades and new vehicles
- Goal — finish first

games.title: Assault on Squid Island
games.description:
Government troops are storming the island!

Assault on Squid Island is an action-packed action game in which you have to survive a deadly battle on a mysterious island. Your main goal is to destroy all the enemies and find a way to escape from this sinister place.

What makes the game special:

Thrilling battles with realistic combat system

Unique locations with a unique atmosphere

A fascinating story that will keep you in suspense until the very end.

Immerse yourself in a world where every step can be lost, and every decision is crucial in the struggle for survival.

games.title: Tile Farm Story
games.description:
The game "Tile Farm Story" is an exciting and challenging adventure that you won't be able to put down!
This chip collecting game will allow you to take a fresh look at the traditional rules of mahjong and test your Puzzle Master skills!

Hundreds of exciting levels, a rich history of the Stone sisters and colorful places that you will visit will help you relax and at the same time train your brain by solving many puzzles presented in the game. You won't notice how time flies!

Game Features:
- diverse and colorful locations in the most amazing corners of the world
- hundreds of exciting levels based on the mechanics of collecting chips
- many useful boosters to help you progress
- a rich plot with surprising twists and turns
- many unique animals with bright characters and funny animations
- an opportunity to train your thinking skills and relax in the company of an exciting game that combines mahjong traditions and new mechanics

games.title: Sausage Life
games.description:
Avoid obstacles and become the last sausage standing.
A parkour and survival game where you, as a sausage, must compete for survival.
As you progress through the game, you'll unlock various unique skins.

Core Gameplay & Story

Retention & Engagement

games.title: Farm: Nubik Vs Zombies
games.description:
Nubik has to get out! To do this, upgrade the base, upgrade him and his weapons. Use the mercenaries to help you. Find a portal that will get you out of here.
Meditative gameplay.

games.title: Unstack Tower
games.description: Unstack Tower is an addictive puzzle game available on Android that challenges players to dismantle a tower of colored cubes in a specific sequence. This game combines the mechanics of a traditional board game with modern gameplay, providing hours of fun. Players must carefully unstack the cubes without causing the tower to collapse, which requires strategy and quick reflexes. The game features various materials, including glass and wood, adding an extra layer of complexity to each level.

games.title: Ragdoll Fighter
games.description:
Ragdoll Fighter is a fast, funny 2D physics fighting game where every punch, swing, and stumble is driven by ragdoll physics. Drag your fighter around the arena, build up momentum, and slam into your enemies with fists or weapons until their health hits zero — with satisfying slow-motion on every big hit.

Battle through a campaign of hand-crafted levels, take on multiple foes at once, or test your survival skills in Endless Mode against never-ending waves. Earn coins from powerful hits and combos, then unlock a roster of wild characters — a robot, a ninja, a boxer, a spartan, a pirate, an alien, and more — each with its own attack, defense, and control stats. Collect daily rewards, chase 3-star level clears, and become the last ragdoll standing.

Progression & extras:

Unlock characters in the Character Select screen using coins earned in battle — each has different Attack / Defense / Complexity ratings.
Earn coins from weapon hits, combos, daily login rewards, and optional reward videos.
Daily rewards grow bigger the more days you play in a row.
Options: toggle music and sound, and set your preferred control side.

Features:

Hilarious, unpredictable ragdoll physics combat
Campaign levels with a 3-star rating system
Endless survival mode with escalating difficulty
8 unlockable fighters, each with unique stats and weapons
Intuitive one-finger drag controls — easy to learn, tricky to master
Satisfying slow-motion impacts and combo rewards
Plays great in portrait on desktop and mobile browsers

Win the fight:

Level mode: Defeat every opponent to clear the level. Finish fast and keep your health high to earn up to 3 stars. Clear levels to unlock the next ones.

Endless mode: Survive as long as you can — each kill restores a little health and enemies keep getting tougher. Your score is your kill count.

Don't give up: If you fall, you can watch a short video to revive and jump right back into the fight (once per run).
Manage your health: Keep an eye on the HP bar. When it empties, the round is over.

games.title: Spill & Knock Down
games.description: In Spill It!, you drop balls in order to knock over glasses and spill everything inside them. It combines simple mechanics with physics-based puzzles—to achieve the goal you must carefully aim, drop, and use gravity / momentum to spill from glasses.

games.title: Cat Box Merge
games.description:
Cat Box Merge is a cozy casual game about cats, boxes, and merging. Open boxes, discover adorable cats, and combine identical ones to get new, rarer pets. Place cats on beds: they will help you and gradually bring new boxes for further progress.

Collect cats, unlock new stages of progression, and move through different cozy worlds, each with its own mood, design, and unique characters. The further you progress, the more opportunities appear: new cats, pleasant rewards, boosts, and a constant feeling of growth.

The game is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing clickers, merge mechanics, collecting, and a cute atmosphere. Play at your own pace, upgrade your collection, and unlock more and more fluffy heroes.

games.title: City Chase: Escape Police
games.description: Race through the city and survive the police chase for as long as you can! Dodge cops, collect coins, grab HP boosts, and pick up the Ram Bar to smash police cars and send them flying. Unlock new cars with unique traits, survive rising Wanted Levels, and keep beating your best time before the cops finally bust you.

games.title: Hipsters vs Rockers
games.description: Gaia, Ero and Ai are best friends forever. They like to try the latest fashion and compare with one another that suits them. This time they tried the style of rockers and hipsters. Wonder which fashion is suitable for them?

games.title: Shape Jam
games.description:
Get ready to jam with shapes in this playful physics puzzle game!
In Shape Jam, your goal is simple: collect 3 matching shapes to clear the board. 
But every move counts  the pick zone is limited, the shapes tumble with physics, and the order you choose decides your success.

games.title: Draw The Road
games.description:
Draw The Road: The Ultimate Physics Puzzle Game
Get ready for a unique blend of creative drawing and challenging physics puzzles! In Draw The Road, your finger acts as architect, engineer, and driver. Your mission is simple: draw the road, set up the layout, and get your vehicle safely to the finish line.

games.title: Cut It All 3D
games.description:
The player will have to cut objects into pieces, following certain rules. The player needs to use his logical and spatial thought process to solve each task that is presented to him.

The game includes various difficulty levels, ranging from easy and simple to more complex and advanced levels that require a high level of skill. The player is given the opportunity to choose different types of objects that he will slice, and different ways of slicing, such as slicing, slicing in a line, etc.

games.title: Cooking Letters - Word Search
games.description:
- Start Your Culinary Adventure. When you enter the kitchen you will see a variety of tasty letters scattered across the game board. Each letter is an ingredient for creating words.  
- Find All the Hidden Words. Your goal is to find all the words from the list hidden on the game board. The faster you complete the task the more points you earn.  
- Unlock New Levels. As you progress you will unlock new levels where the words get longer and the challenges become more exciting. Cook up increasingly complex dishes made of letters.  
- Earn Rewards. For every word you find you earn points. Use them to unlock additional bonuses or new kitchen themes.  
- Train Your Brain. This game is not only fun but also helps improve focus vocabulary and quick thinking.

games.title: Supercar Battle Arena
games.description: Supercar Battle Arena is an action-packed 3D bumper car game where you fight to survive in a ruthless arena with modified battle cars. Use your driving skills to push your opponents out of the arena or blow them up with your rockets. Earn coins in every match to unlock new, more powerful vehicles from your garage. What makes this game unique is the perfect blend of smooth vehicle physics with explosive combat mechanics and special abilities (jumping, dashing in mid-air). Can you become the true champion of the arena?

games.title: Cat Puzzle: Draw To Kitten
Tornado-67

Become the hungriest tornado in the world!

Start your journey as a small whirlwind capable of absorbing only tiny objects, and gradually grow into a massive destructive force of nature.

Explore 3 unique locations: a sunny beach, a bustling city, and a suburban neighborhood. Absorb everything in your path — from flip-flops and beach umbrellas to cars and entire buildings.

The more objects you collect, the stronger your tornado becomes, allowing you to absorb even larger and heavier objects.

Destroy, grow, and unleash a true tornado apocalypse!

games.title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo Games
games.description: 🎨 Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo offers a unique and creative experience where you not only create stunning ink tattoos but also dress up characters in trending outfits! Dive into the world of fashion and tattoos, where your artistic talents can shine in more ways than one.

games.title: Cowboys Duel
games.description: Enter the rugged world of the Wild West in *Cowboys Duel*, where sharp aim and quick reflexes are crucial. Compete in solo missions or face off against friends in thrilling duels. Customize your character, enjoy various game modes, and hone your skills to become the top cowboy.

games.title: Fluffy Jump
games.description:
The objective is to jump from platform to platform while continuously moving forward. Missing any platform results in failure, and the player’s speed gradually increases as the game progresses. The challenge lies in surviving as long as possible to achieve the highest time-based score.
Key Features:
Simple controls: Intuitive and quick controls.
Dynamic difficulty increase: The game becomes more challenging as you progress.

games.title: Stickman Archer Kick
games.description:
Stickman Archer Kick is an engaging and highly addictive action shooting game where precision meets captivating Ragdoll physics. Take up your bow and arrows and embark on a critical mission: utilize expert archery skills to kick and save the lives of numerous Stickmen caught in dangerous traps.

Master the art of shooting and apply strategic thinking to complete challenging Puzzle stages. Success relies on your ability to judge angles and trajectory accurately, making this a top-tier Shooter experience. Collect Stars across all Levels to unlock new character skins and enhance your gameplay.

Optimized as a Mobile Ready title, this game offers immediate action and seamless controls on any device. Download Stickman Archer Kick now and become the ultimate hero in this frantic Stickman rescue adventure.

games.title: Merge 13
games.description: Merge 13 is a thrilling online puzzle game where players combine numbered cells for higher scores. Accessible on various devices without downloads, it provides a captivating mix of logic and math, perfect for puzzle enthusiasts. Jump right in and challenge your strategic thinking to reach 13!

games.title: Parkour Run - 3D Runner
games.description:
🏃‍♂️ Parkour Run — Runner 3D!

⚡ A dynamic, minimalist 3D runner where every second counts. Test your reaction skills in hazardous challenges of the future!

✨ Run, adapt, and find the perfect line.

🡺 Parkour Mastery: Combine wall-running, slides, jumps, and ledge grabs.

🡺 Minimalist Style: Clean level geometry keeps you focused on what matters most — your speed and route.

🡺 Exciting Mechanics & Traps: Gain momentum, dodge lasers, use dash pads, and launch off trampolines.

🡺 High-Speed Tactics: Each level is a fast-paced puzzle requiring instant reactions and smart routing.

🡺 Time-Attack: Complete levels with a 3-star rating, break time records, and unlock new runs.

🏁 Ready to test your limits? Hit start and dash in!

games.title: Happy jelly
games.description: Dive into a delightful realm of sugary fun with Happy Jelly, a captivating online puzzle game. Align jelly candies to score points and relieve stress, all while enjoying vibrant visuals and lively tunes. It’s an engaging experience for everyone, available on both smartphones and computers. Enjoy the sweetness!

games.title: Devil Die
games.description:
Devil Die looks like a simple, cute 2D platformer until the floor suddenly disappears, spikes pop out of nowhere, and the “safe” door turns into a trap.

You play as a tiny pixel hero trying to reach the exit door in each stage. The controls are super easy, but the levels are full of hidden tricks: falling platforms, surprise buzzsaws, moving walls, reversed controls, fake safe zones, and more. The game starts simple and then slowly turns into a rage-game where every step can be a trap.

games.title: Geometry Vibes Monster
games.description:
Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you must dodge incoming obstacles, spikes, and battle against a variety of unique monsters. Each monster features distinct attack patterns that you must skillfully avoid. Your main goal is to navigate your spaceship as far as possible while surviving the onslaught of attacks.

Geometry Vibes Monster Features:
8 Unique Monsters: Each with their own unique attack patterns, adding variety and depth to the game. Learning these attacks is the key to mastery.
Dynamic Gameplay: Fast paced courses and increasing difficulty levels invite you to challenge at any time.
Multiplayer Fun: Enjoy the competition by competing with your friends on the same device.
Mobile Compatibility: Playable on phones and tablets with touch controls.
Visual and Sound Design: Vivid graphics and impressive music enhance the atmosphere of the game.

games.title: Duck Hunter
games.description: In this game, your task is to shoot ducks. To pass each round of 10 ducks, you must shoot at least 6. Then you will go to the next round!

games.title: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures
games.description: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures offers a thrilling 2D arcade experience filled with action. Combat zombies and drones, enhance your weapons, and complete missions to save friends. Explore for secrets while playing seamlessly across devices without downloads or registrations directly in your browser. Enjoy the adventure anytime, anywhere!

games.title: Pulse Of Fear
games.description:
Trapped in an abandoned place where something unspeakable lives, your survival depends on two things: light and silence.

Fuel your flashlight with batteries to shed light on the eerie secrets of the place. Repair generators to restore power and find a way to escape. Search for items: fuses for electrical panels, first aid kits for healing, and keys to locked doors.

Light the way. Fix the system. Start the elevator. Most importantly, stay in the shadows.

games.title: Roll Rush
games.description: A fast-paced ball run game where you evade obstacles and collect coins to further upgrade your ball, try to roll as far as possible!

games.title: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter
games.description: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter is an action-packed arcade game that immerses players in intense space combat. Become a skilled pilot and protect planets from alien threats. Enjoy thrilling battles for free online, with no need for registration or downloads. Join the cosmic adventure and unleash your skills!

games.title: BuildCraft
games.description:
BuildCraft is a creative 3D block-building game where you can explore a colorful voxel world and turn construction plans into finished builds. Choose a project, follow its transparent block outline, and place each block to bring houses, wells, windmills, and other structures to life.

Move freely, jump or fly around your world, select materials from the creative inventory, and place or remove blocks whenever you want. Complete guided builds at your own pace, then keep experimenting by shaping the terrain and creating your own designs. Play directly in your browser on desktop or mobile.

games.title: 3D Dots
games.description:
3D Dots is a relaxing connect-the-dots puzzle that happens in real 3D space. Every level starts as a cloud of numbered dots floating in the air — link them with the right lines and a hidden object comes to life.

The number on each dot tells you how many lines it needs, so there is no guessing, only clean logic. Unlike flat dot-to-dot games, the puzzle has depth: orbit the camera to look at the figure from any side and find connections you could not see before.

games.title: Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker
games.description: Join Sigma Boy in a beat-driven journey through diverse landscapes from deserts to space in this free online clicker game. Each tap earns points for upgrades, enhancing his skills as you tackle various challenges across devices. Embrace the rhythm and guide Sigma Boy to success!

games.title: Break a Lucky Block!
games.description:
Break lucky blocks, unlock rare rewards, collect brainrots, escape the guards, and bring everything back to your plot in this simulator just like in Roblox!

What's inside the Lucky Blocks? 🧊

Break lucky blocks before you get caught! ⛏️

Grab the brainrots that spawn! ✨

Bring them back to your plot!

games.title: Funny Rescue Pet
games.description: Lica and Purry had an accident! Lica's house is on fire, and Purry is soak wet when she played inside the wall. How can it happen? Rescue them immediately and also give them some makeover!

games.title: Go Up
games.description:
Welcome to Go Up, the exciting free mobile game that challenges you to protect the balloon as it rises higher and higher into the sky. Get ready to put your skills to the ultimate test with this amazing balloon game that'll keep you on your toes and your eyes glued to the screen.

Picture this. You have a tiny balloon you need to protect. You need to push away all the pointy and heavy things that get in the way of your balloon going up. But it's not that easy. The sky is full of all kinds of strange things like blocks, beams, and triangles. If your balloon even touches one of these, it's all over. Exciting, right?

But it gets even better! The higher your balloon goes, the harder the game gets. The obstacles become trickier and more difficult to avoid. You can push everything out of the way, but watch out! If you send blocks flying everywhere, you will find it difficult to protect the balloon.

games.title: Ultimate Billiard 3D Game
games.description:
Step into the world of Ultimate Billiard 3D Games: Snooker Pool Game, the ultimate 3D billiards simulator that brings realistic pool physics, smooth cue controls, and exciting snooker challenges to your mobile device. Whether you are a beginner learning the basics or a professional aiming for perfect shots, this pool game offers an immersive experience with beautiful graphics, realistic ball movement, and addictive gameplay. Enjoy classic 8 Ball Pool, strategic 9 Ball Pool, professional Snooker Mode, and exciting billiards tournaments that test your cue skills in every match.

Experience authentic billiards gameplay with advanced physics that make every shot feel natural and satisfying. Aim carefully, control your cue power, apply spin, and pocket every ball with precision. Every table is designed with stunning 3D environments, smooth animations, and realistic sound effects that create the feeling of playing in a real pool club. Challenge yourself with increasingly difficult levels while mastering trick shots, bank shots, combo shots, and accurate cue control.

games.title: Planet 404. Episode 1
games.description:
In this exciting puzzle platformer players embark on an amazing journey with Alice, a brave and curious explorer who finds herself stranded on a mysterious planet filled with secrets. Surrounded by enigmatic landscapes, this world is filled with puzzles that must be solved to uncover its mysteries.

 Each solution and obstacle overcome not only propels the player forward, but also reveals new chapters of Alice's adventure. The game's graphics are designed in a vibrant and colorful style, and the musical accompaniment creates an atmosphere of magic and mystery, immersing the player in an exciting world full of wonders and surprises.

games.title: Funny Hair Salon

50+ different levels

High detailed graphics

games.title: Car Cargo Ship Simulator Game
games.description: Welcome to the car transport ship simulator game. Become a professional car transporter, load cars onto massive cargo ships, sail through deep ocean ports, and deliver vehicles across exotic islands and modern ports. If you have ever dreamed of managing a high-tech transport fleet with jeeps, ships and cars, this game is made for you! Test your parking skills, ship handling, and time management in this action-packed cargo simulator game.

games.title: Crossy Rails
games.description:
Build the perfect railway and guide the train safely to its destination! Move and arrange the rail blocks in the correct direction to create a complete track. Think ahead, solve each puzzle, and make sure every rail piece connects properly. Once the track is complete, the train will automatically travel across it and complete the level.

With simple controls and increasingly challenging puzzles, Crossy Rails is a fun and relaxing logic game that tests your planning and problem-solving skills.

games.title: Fantasy Fish World Mahjong
games.description: Fantasy Fish World Mahjong is a delightful Mahjong Solitaire puzzle game immersed in a vibrant underwater fantasy realm. Its core concept revolves around matching and removing identical fish-themed tiles—featuring colorful clownfish, angelfish, and other sea creatures—to clear intricate layouts against a pirate shipwreck backdrop with corals and seaweed. Unique elements include adorable aquatic tile designs, intuitive UI with hints, shuffles, and color swaps, plus timed levels for relaxed yet engaging play.

piloting a cubic ship that can be infinitely expanded with modules.

Bring the crying poor kids back to their loving families. Help mom and dad find their child and get home. The controls are very simple - draw a line from the parent to the baby. Careful avoidance of obstacles and choosing the optimal route will allow you to get to the baby and save him.

If you have any comments on the game, you can leave a review. Thank you so much for your participation, dear player!

This brain puzzle Game helps improve concentration, memory, and logical thinking through relaxing challenges. Enjoy a collection of offline puzzle games that you can play anytime without an internet connection. games.title: Happy Swing
games.description: Embark on a captivating adventure in Happy Swing, a free online game where timing is your best ally. In this thrilling journey, your mission is to find a lost soul by swinging and jumping with impeccable precision. Every move you make must be calculated, as a single mistake can send you spiraling back. Will you conquer the rhythm and complete your quest? Dive into the gameplay on both your phone and computer for an exhilarating experience!

games.title: Cars Challenge
games.description:
Welcome to the game about cars, in which you can play in different modes compete with bots, perform tasks and tuning your new cars!

Modes in the game:

- Arena:
Clash with other cars and survive in the arena!

- Spinning Wheel:
The obstacle wheel is spinning, your task is to get to the finish line faster than other cars and not fall into the abyss!


- Hexagons:
Hexagons fall down as soon as a car passes over them.
Show your dexterity in steering and jumping to stay last in the arena and win.

- Insane Track:
On the crazy track you will have to go through a bunch of challenges and obstacles to get to the end of the crazy track faster than the other cars and win!

And much more!

games.description:
Get ready for nonstop action in a high-speed driving game built around giant ramps, massive jumps, and extreme stunts. Take control of powerful cars, launch into the air, perform daring tricks, and push your driving skills to the limit across a variety of exciting levels.

Enjoy realistic physics and sound effects, a wide selection of vehicles, and plenty of missions designed to keep every run fun and challenging. Unlock new cars, complete events, and prove yourself in bigger and more intense races.

games.title: Crashy Chasy
games.description: Get ready for a high-octane, drift-and-destroy experience that's all about chaotic car-chasing madness. As a fearless driver, you'll drift through city streets, smashing into rival cars, dodging traffic, and causing mayhem wherever you go, all while avoiding cops, taxis, and other opponents. With easy controls and fast gameplay, this arcade-style game delivers nonstop action and endless fun, allowing you to drift for thrill or crash for chaos. Buckle up and let the chase begin, where destruction and survival are the ultimate goals.

games.title: Sheepdoku
games.description:
Welcome to Sheepdoku, a calm and clever puzzle game made for players who love logic, strategy, and relaxing brain challenges.

In Sheepdoku, your goal is simple: place one sheep in every colored area without breaking the rules. It looks easy at first, but every level needs smart thinking, careful moves, and perfect placement.

Each puzzle board is divided into different colored fields. Every field needs exactly one sheep. But sheep need their own space, so they cannot be placed in the same row, same column, or next to each other, even diagonally.

Think carefully before every move. Use your brain, find the safe spots, and complete the board without mistakes. The more you play, the better your logic skills become.

Sheepdoku is perfect for quick relaxing sessions, daily brain training, and puzzle lovers who enjoy simple rules with deep strategy.

games.title: Spinner Clicker 2D

games.title: Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars!
games.description:
Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars — your epic adventure starts now! 🎈 Rescue the balloon from sneaky traps and become its fearless hero 🛡️! Control the speedy defender, smash obstacles, and catch stars ⭐ to soar to the top!

- Tons of fun and thrilling challenges

games.title: Spellbound Orbs

Easy to pick up, endlessly engaging, and perfectly optimized for both mobile and desktop browser play!

games.title: Echolocation Shooter

Shoot to see in the dark!

Eliminate all the neon enemies, in the horroristic level!

Survive endless waves of the wide variety of neon monster enemies, where the only way to see is to shoot.

games.title: Idle Pong
games.description: Idle Pong is a fun and satisfying idle clicker game where every tap launches a high-speed pong ball to smash through colorful obstacles! Watch the chaos unfold as your pong bounces, breaks, and earns you XP even while you're idle.

games.title: Pocket Tyrant
games.description: Pocket Tyrant is a charming one-joystick action-strategy conquest game where you lead a tiny goblin warlord and his growing horde across seven islands. Gather resources, recruit goblins, upgrade your tools and weapons, then raid 27 kingdoms on the road to the Black Citadel. Combat is instantly readable—your army is a number, theirs is a number, and every clash is visible subtraction. There are no menus or attack buttons: simply walk into the world to harvest, build, fight, and turn cheerful pastel villages into crooked goblin strongholds. The choice is always yours: attack now, or grow stronger first.

games.title: Grow Empire
games.description:
Strategically upgrade your walls, towers, and warriors. Defend your city from the attacks of elephants, siege guns and waves of enemy troops, covering the sky with arrows and fire.

Defeat your enemies by clashing with Egyptian, Italian, Gallic, Iberian and Carthaginian warriors, and expand your empire across Europe and Africa. Conquer their cities and get chests with gems, gold, potions and maps! Defend your colonies and replenish your bank with gold. Become the leader that Rome claims to be.

games.title: Falling Dummy
games.description:
Push the dummy off the roof of the tallest building on the construction site and watch it break all its bones. Control the body of the little man as he falls and break as many limbs as possible!

Do you want to relax after a hard day? Then this game is made for you! In this anti-stress game, your main goal is to make the dummy break as many limbs as possible when falling from tall buildings!

Control the flight of the dummy, direct its body to the floor level, concrete structures, construction cranes and other construction objects to break even more bones of the dummy!

Game features:

- Relaxing gameplay
- Bright stylized 3D graphics
- Interesting levels
- Cool skins

games.title: Path Control
games.description:
Pave the ball way into the target in this robust physics based puzzle game.

Control each platform simultaneously and lead the ball into the basket to complete each level.
Watch out for the ball's bounce and keep in mind that this is a frictionless environment so the ball will keep rolling it might just take an extra second.

games.title: Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines
games.description: Discover the exciting world of Robbie: TikTak Slot Machines, where online arcade fun meets thrilling challenges. Engage in various mini-games, collect tickets for rare pets, and unlock new machines. Spin the Wheel of Fortune for prizes and explore unique machines for exclusive rewards. Start your gaming adventure now!

games.title: Shopping Simulator
games.description: Earn game money by tapping the hamster, raise the customer's level and buy everything from the store shelves. Anime, horror, food, pets, household goods, hundreds of heroes in one place! Buy anything you want! More than 500 unique items, 200 leveling levels, lots of mini-games and lots of emotions are waiting for you!

games.title: Parkour World
games.description:
Welcome to Parkour World, an exhilarating Minecraft-inspired parkour game with thrilling challenges and delightful gameplay. 
-Each level in this game boasts its own distinct and features, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience every time you play. 
-While the initial levels may seem relatively simple, as you progress through the game. By the time you conquer the first ten levels, you'll find yourself facing increasingly demanding obstacles.
-Get ready to run, and conquer in Parkour World!

games.title: Screw Puzzle
games.description:
Embark on a captivating journey into the world of Wood Screw Puzzle, the ultimate wood nuts and bolts puzzle game that will challenge your mind and delight your senses. This isn't just another screw sort game; it's an immersive experience where you'll unravel intricate arrangements of wood screws, nuts and bolts, and other fascinating fasteners, proving your screw master skills along the way.

Unscrew, Unwind, and Unleash Your Inner Puzzle Master:

Each level of Wood Screw Puzzle presents a unique challenge, a mesmerizing tapestry of wood screws and nuts and bolts intertwined in a complex dance. Your task is to carefully analyze the arrangement, strategize your moves, and skillfully manipulate the screw pins and fasteners to screw out each piece and free them from their wooden embrace. It's a test of your logic, spatial reasoning, and dexterity, all wrapped up in a visually stunning and tactilely satisfying wood nuts and bolts puzzle game.

games.title: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle
games.description: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle is a thrilling pirate-themed bubble shooter puzzle game where players fire numbered cannonballs from a mega cannon at the bottom to match and sink clusters of enemy hex-shaped pirate boats bearing the same numbers floating above the water, conquering challenging levels in an epic sea battle.

games.title: Find Visitors - 99 Nights
games.description:
Find Visitors - 99 Nights -  is an atmospheric game where you take on the role of the manager of a forest refuge. Let the forest creatures in and drive away the visitors.

Check for signs and identify hidden monsters – the visitors!

games.title: Time Puzzle
games.description: Enjoy relaxing picture puzzles and put every piece in the right place. Complete beautiful photos, unlock new puzzles, and take on gradually more challenging levels at your own pace.

games.title: Ants Io
games.description: Ants Io is a fast-paced and highly competitive multiplayer arena (.io) game. In this microscopic world, you embody a hungry ant striving to grow your colony by collecting food scattered across the map. The core philosophy is "Survive and Expand"—you must evade predators larger than yourself while seeking opportunities to outmaneuver and eliminate smaller rivals. What sets it apart is the fluid colony-following mechanics and dynamic gameplay where every bite brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Ant King.

games.title: Car Parking Simulator
games.description: Car Parking Simulator is a unique blend of driving games and puzzle challenges. The game resembles classic driving simulators but with a distinctive focus on the art of parking. It is perfectly suited for both car game enthusiasts and those who want to improve their parking skills in a safe and enjoyable environment. The game features a wide variety of vehicles, from city sedans to trucks with trailers, each offering its own unique challenge. With 39 levels—each of which can be replayed to improve your results — Car Parking Simulator  promises hours of engaging gameplay.

games.title: Voxel Master
games.description:
A 3D puzzle and builder in one! Assemble volumetric models from colored blocks using hints, or create your own masterpieces in sandbox mode.


Two game modes:
- Puzzle mode — hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty. You're shown a model and must recreate it block by block.
- Sandbox — free 3D modeling on grids of various sizes. Save your creations and share them with friends.

games.title: Block Sculptor
games.description:
Block Sculptor is a 3D puzzle game where you become the sculptor. Inside every block hides a colorful shape — your goal is to carefully remove all the extra gray cubes without touching the shape itself.
The challenge grows steadily: shapes get bigger, and the margin for error gets smaller. Rotate the block, study it from every angle, and think through every move!

games.title: Golf Invaders
games.description: Welcome to Golf Invaders, the ultimate arcade golf shooter! Your golf course has been invaded by punks, bums, and other troublemakers. Your goal? Aim, shoot, and eliminate all invaders using precision golf shots!

games.title: Obby: Battle Arena
games.description: Exciting third-person shooter with beautiful graphics, where exciting battles, cool guns, and a real battle arena await you!

games.title: Money cutter idle
games.description: Money Maker Idle is a satisfying idle game where you grow your cash flow by merging money, unlocking higher bills, and expanding your earnings row by row. Start small, combine bills, and watch your money maker evolve into a fast-moving wealth machine. Every merge brings stronger value, every upgrade pushes your income further, and every tap helps speed up your path from basic cash to massive fortune.

games.title: Ride a Bike for Brainrots
games.description:
Welcome to Obby Ride a Bike For Brainrots! 🚴
Speed through obstacle courses while keeping your balance! ⚡
Jump across crazy obby stages filled with tricky challenges! 🤾‍♂️
Be careful — one mistake and you’ll fall into the void! 💀
Collect Brainrots to boost your income and progress faster! 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and grow stronger! 🏗️
Keep riding, improving, and conquer every obby stage! 🚀

games.title: Moving Balls - Going Sphere
games.description:
⚡ Go Ball – Race Balls 🎮🏐

Welcome to the exciting world of Go Ball – Race Balls, a thrilling 3D rolling and balancing game where precision meets adrenaline! 🌪️
Guide your ball through dynamic ramps, tricky platforms, and sky-high jumps in this addictive adventure of skill and control! 🚀

🎯 Game Features:

🌈 Beautiful 3D graphics with immersive, dynamic environments!

🌀 Smooth ball physics that feel real and satisfying!

🧩 Dozens of challenging levels with unique ramp puzzles!

⚙️ Easy controls — swipe left or right to balance and move!

💎 Collect power-ups and discover hidden shortcuts!

🌍 Explore diverse worlds — from forest trails to futuristic sky cities!



💫 Why You’ll Love It:
Experience the perfect mix of puzzle-solving and racing action — every level tests your reflexes, timing, and precision. Whether you love relaxing physics games or intense arcade challenges, Go Ball – Race Balls will keep you hooked for hours!

🏐 Download now and roll your way to victory! 🚀✨

games.title: Merge Mushroom
games.description:
🍄 Throw mushrooms on mushrooms to get new ones
🍄 Collect all possible mushrooms
🍄 Compete with other mushroom pickers around the world!

games.title: Imposter 3D
games.description: Imposter 3D offers an exciting arcade adventure where you can choose to be either a "Killer" or a "Hero." Develop strategies to win as you face various challenges. Play for free online on multiple devices without registration, making it accessible for all gamers. Enjoy a thrilling, dynamic experience!

games.title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
games.description: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner is a dynamic HTML5 browser game that delivers an engaging arcade challenge. As a talented sword fighter, you'll cut through numerous foes, perfect for both ninja enthusiasts and action game lovers.

games.title: Emoji Guess
games.description: Show off your skills as an emoji interpreter in this supremely fun and frenetic puzzle game where you have to pick the right set of emojis to express the phrase, saying or movie title that’s written or illustrated above. Solve endless emoji puzzles by matching the right emojis in the right order and sharpen your logic, word association and visual perception skills with hundreds of short, colorful and often hilarious levels of brain-teasing entertainment. Emoji Guess Puzzle is a simple-in-concept but endlessly challenging and amusing puzzle game for smart players of all ages.

games.title: Kuromi Maker
games.description: Design your very own Kuromi-style character with a vast array of customization options and a diverse color palette. With just one click, you can generate a randomly created hero—sometimes with hilarious results! If you''re not happy with the outcome, you can reset everything at any moment. Once you''re satisfied with your creation, save it as a PNG image.

games.title: Gun Bounce Idle
games.description:
