Gun Bounce Idle throws you into a wild chain reaction of bullets, bounces, and nonstop destruction. Drop your weapons into the arena and watch them ricochet across the field, spraying fire in every direction while stacking up cash with every hit.

Build your ultimate damage machine by upgrading power, attack speed, crit chance, and special modifiers. Unlock new guns with unique behaviors and turn simple shots into explosive chaos. The more you optimize, the more the screen fills with satisfying destruction.

Level up to unlock stronger targets, complete achievements, and push your build to its limits. When progress slows, activate Prestige to reset and return stronger than ever — multiplying your power and accelerating your climb to insane damage numbers.

Simple to start. Impossible to stop.
How far can your bouncing arsenal go?

games.title: The Adventures of Big Joe
games.description:
Join the pirate Big Joe on an adventure!

Sandy beaches, an old shovel, and treasure chests await you!

Dig! Dig!! Dig!!!

Deep beneath the sand, someone has buried untold treasures and incredible artifacts. Retrieve them all in this humorous adventure!

games.title: ENDLESS Z SURVIVOR
games.description:
Fight through endless waves of hungry zombies, unleash your arsenal of weapons, survive!
Each time you perish, you only get stronger. Kill zombies, get gold, buy new weapons, kill more zombies!!

games.title: TCG Shop: Dino Adventure
games.description: A prehistoric trading-card shop game. Battle league rivals in 3v3 fights where a card’s power is both its attack and its health. Win to earn coins and climb the league ladder, then spend coins on packs and tap to open them. After each pull, swipe left to sell for coins or right to sleeve the card into your binder. Repeat the loop to grow your deck, rise through the leagues, and complete your collection.

games.title: Cookie Match
games.description:
Cookie Match is a sliding puzzle game where you must match each cookie to its corresponding cutter.

If you move the cookies off the edge of the board or into knives, they’ll be destroyed. Use the tubs of butter as barriers to keep the cookies in one piece.

games.title: Fruit Slicer
games.description:
Get ready to become a fruit-slicing master in the most exciting fruit cutting game ever! It's simple: slice fruits to master the art of fruit cutting. The best part? It’s absolutely free to play and packed with fun!

Game Modes:
- Classic: Just relax and slice.
- Time: Race against the clock!
- Arcade: Plan your slices without time limit!

Fruit Slicer offers simple yet addictive gameplay that will keep you entertained for hours. With cool challenges and the chance to compete against friends, there's never a dull moment. 🎯

games.title: Tile Match Puzzle
games.description:
Are you a fan of match 3 and combination zen match games? 
Tile Match Puzzle fulfills your desire for puzzle fun with new puzzle challenges every day! Simply match three tiles to reveal even more tiles underneath. Find more combinations until you've cleared everything. But beware: If you select too many tiles without at least three matching each other, you will have to start your journey from the beginning.

Each level presents you with a new addictive puzzle challenge. Take a fun and relaxing getaway as you enter beautiful new landscapes to test your brain. 

Game features
 
Unique Tile Puzzles:
With tiles in over 20 styles, there's no limit to the number of combinations you can make. 

Flex your brain muscles
Test and improve your memory and pattern recognition skills with this fun and relaxing puzzle game!

games.title: Summer Fashion Makeover
games.description: Lily has been neglected her look for a long time in pandemic time. When the summer come and things get better, she wants to go to the beach again. But look at her! What a scary look she has now! Let's help makeover her to be pretty and neat again!

games.title: Bomb Royale Online
games.description: Enter an explosive online battle royale inspired by classic bomber-style arcade games. Fight inside dangerous maze arenas where players compete in fast-paced multiplayer battles filled with traps, strategy, and nonstop action. Place bombs, destroy obstacles, outsmart your opponents, and survive chaotic chain reactions to become the last player standing. With unique bear characters and dynamic PvP combat, every match is a test of timing, positioning, and smart tactics.

games.title: Street Racer 2D
games.description: Street Racer 2 is a driving drag-racing game where your goal is to win races, upgrade, and buy new cars. This game offers an exhilarating mix of play modes, including drag racing, off-road challenges, and arcade-style fun. Each mode delivers a distinct experience, whether chasing high-speed thrills, conquering rugged terrain, or enjoying adrenaline-packed track action.

games.title: Brain Line Connect
games.description:
Brain Line Connect is a simple-but-challenging brain puzzle where you draw one continuous line to connect all dots on the screen. 
It looks easy at first, but each level is designed to make you think ahead especially when obstacle lines block your path. 
Play anytime with no time pressure, enjoy clean visuals, and solve your way through a huge collection of levels made to train focus and logic.

games.title: Don't Open That Door...Seriosly!
games.description:
You are a plush teddy bear — soft, cute… and completely unprepared for what lies ahead. Arriving at a mysterious hotel in the middle of Nowhere with your little suitcase, you quickly realize — something here is… off.

Behind every door awaits a new absurdity: a chemistry lab with sudden explosions, a boxing ring with no rules, a noisy party full of rubber ducks, and at the end of the corridor — a mysterious door leading into a dark underground…

Explore the rooms, interact with this bizarre world, and watch as the strange hotel slowly descends into madness — along with you.

This is a game of cheerful nonsense, where logic has long since checked out, and common sense never checked in.

games.title: Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!
games.description:
A fun action-packed sword game where all you need is to chop and slice enemies into pieces!

Sharpen your blade, sword master! It's time to embark on a real ninja warrior adventure! Play the exciting "Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!", defeat hordes of sword masters and become the greatest samurai of all time!

FEATURES OF THE GAME

- Unique mechanics of slicing enemies
- Variety of enemies and levels
- Epic gaming experience
- Action-packed missions
- Hordes of ninja assassins

If you like cool ninja games or knife throwing games like Hit Master 3D, Clumsy Ninja, Draw Saber, Sword Hunter, Stealth Master, Sword Play and other samurai games, you will definitely enjoy playing "Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!". What are you waiting for? Prove that you are the greatest sword master of all time!

games.title: Bridge Dash
games.description: Draw it. Drive it. Don’t fall!  Bridge Dash is a fun and challenging physics puzzle game where you need to draw a bridge and help your car safely reach the finish line. Every level is a new challenge – avoid obstacles and use your creativity to find the perfect path! Draw the Bridge – draw your way to victory!

games.title: Air Warfare
games.description: Fly into excitement with **Air Warfare**, an endless game where you take charge of a combat plane. Shoot down foes, gather ammo, avoid attacks, and strive for survival. Compete for high scores while enjoying smooth gameplay on both mobile and desktop devices.

games.title: Slide Blocks 3D
games.description: Slide Blocks 3D is a relaxing yet brain-teasing sliding puzzle. Colorful pictures are cut into blocks and scrambled across the board — slide the pieces to put every picture back together before the timer runs out. Levels grow bigger and trickier as you progress. Earn coins, claim daily rewards, and climb the leaderboard!

games.title: Moscow Metro Simulator
Zombies ate my Castle
games.description: Zombies Ate My Castle is a tower defense game where you command an army of zombies to protect your fortress. Strategically deploy your undead allies, summon zombie carriers to revive fallen foes, and unleash powerful spells to turn the tide in battle. Collect coins from victories to upgrade your skills and boost your army. Can you save the zombie princess?

games.title: Mellow Escape
games.description: Mellow Escape is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you move blocks, clear the path, and help a curious little character reach the exit. Solve handcrafted puzzles, earn stars and coins, unlock new themes and character skins, and progress through increasingly challenging levels — all at your own pace, with no timers or pressure.

games.title: Formula Apex Rush
games.description:
Formula Apex Rush is a high-speed open-wheel racing game where every second counts. Compete against aggressive AI rivals across a variety of circuits, including technical Grand Prix tracks, fast sprint races, challenging street events, and dramatic night races.
Master precise steering, control your speed through difficult corners, use ERS at the right moment, and fight your way through the field to reach the podium. Upgrade your racing machine in the garage, improve performance, earn credits, and unlock stronger setups as the championship becomes increasingly competitive.
With responsive controls, dynamic race positions, cinematic racing visuals, multiple event types, and fast arcade-style gameplay, Formula Apex Rush delivers an exciting motorsport experience for both desktop and mobile players.

games.title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
games.description:
Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck.

But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks! The game sends you on a journey to a magical world and tells the story of an adventure across an enchanted land. Forests, mountains, seas and snowy peaks: get ready for a wild ride in Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire!

What makes our solitaire special:
Players can use different boosters on levels to give the game a special twist. Put any card from the board on a Joker. The Combo booster helps you get a five-card combo at the very start of a level, and Eye shows you what card is hiding at the top of the deck.
Start a new level and use the Sword to switch out a card from the deck with one you need. The Bow lets you remove any card from the board, the Fan shuffles cards and brings what you need to the top, and the Hammer flips over a portion of the hidden cards!

Features
♣️️ Hundreds of levels with new ones added all the time!
♦️ Different locations with fun original game mechanics!
♠️ Exciting battles against golems of different elements!
♥ Just lay out your cards in ascending or descending order!
♦️ Tons of different rewards and bonuses!
♣️ A fun game to boost your mood!

games.title: Slow Time Ninja
games.description: Master time and precision in this stealth ninja game! Swipe to throw your weapon, freeze time to plan, and strike with deadly accuracy. Outsmart enemies, use your surroundings, and defeat all foes with true ninja elegance.

games.title: Backslash Slash
games.description:
Backslash Slash is a keyboard-first blade clicker that turns simple key presses into satisfying combo chains. Instead of tapping, press /, \, P or K to strike a human-shaped training dummy using knives, daggers, machetes and more. Each key corresponds to different attack timing and combo opportunities — master the rhythm to unlock special multi-hit moves and new weapons as you level up.

Key features:

Keyboard controls: intuitive use of /, \, P, K for fast-paced slashing.
Weapon variety: each blade (knife, dagger, machete) has unique speed and combo patterns.
Combo progression: build and maintain combo chains to multiply damage and unlock advanced techniques.
Level-based unlocks: reach higher levels to gain access to new combos, weapons and passive upgrades.
Upgrade system: improve attack speed, combo window, crit chance and weapon power.
Focused, stylized visuals emphasizing skill and progression.
Whether you want quick, rhythmic keyboard action or deep upgrade planning, Backslash Slash delivers addictive feedback and meaningful progression. Learn key timings, discover the best combo sequences, and climb the ranks as you unlock ever-more lethal blades

games.title: Sand Tetris Pro
games.description:
Sand Tetris Pro is a fresh take on the classic Tetris formula with realistic sand physics. When tetrominoes land, they crumble into hundreds of sand particles that behave like real sand, filling the level in dynamic and unpredictable ways. Instead of simply clearing rows, you must think about the flow of sand and how piles form and collapse.

The game features two main modes: Endless Mode and Campaign Mode, which includes hundreds of levels with objectives and up to three stars to earn for completing challenges.

Key features include dynamic sand physics, unique power-ups (bomb — destroys a large area; vacuum — removes accumulated sand; slow motion — gives you extra time to place pieces precisely), in-game currency, a booster shop, and a progression system.

games.title: Zombie Merge
games.description:
A top-down survival duel. You’re pinned at the center of the arena while a horde of zombies pours in from the edges. Your rival survivor is doing the same on their side of the match — you’re racing to outscore them before the 90-second clock runs out.

The twist is the merge mechanic: killing a zombie doesn’t always remove it from the field. Below max tier, it fuses into another zombie of the same type, upgrading it into something bigger, slower, tankier, and worth more points. Only the top-tier Colossus (Lv 5) dies for good. The better you play, the more dangerous the horde becomes — but also the more points you can farm.

games.title: Pop Puzzle
games.description:
Welcome to the colorful world of Pop Puzzle!
Pop Puzzle is here to test your skills with challenging levels.

Pop Puzzle is a block matching puzzle game with colorful visuals and simple gameplay. Its key appeal is in how easily you can pick it up and play but with increasingly challenging levels that test your pattern-spotting skills.

games.title: Loot Island - Treasure Digger
games.description:
Embark on an exciting treasure hunt! Immerse yourself in fascinating landscapes, look for crosses, and dig up precious items. Collect the loot in your backpack and stack it in a mesmerizing Tetris-style puzzle. Get ready for a game that combines strategic excavation and exciting loot stacking!

🗺️ Focus on the map
💎 Dig deeper into the fascinating landscapes to find precious items
🎒 Collect the loot in your backpack
⚡️ Stack them in a mesmerizing Tetris-style puzzle
🧩 Stack gems, coins, and more to maximize your treasure profit
🛠️ Upgrade your tools and unlock new maps as you delve deeper into the adventure
🌟 Test your skill, strategy, and luck in this addictive game!

games.title: Flag Coloring Puzzle
games.description: A fun and educational flag coloring puzzle game. Test your memory and geography knowledge to correctly color hundreds of national flags in a clean, vibrant cartoon-style interface.

games.title: Kitten's Way Home: Word Associations
games.description:
Looking for a game for the evening? A puzzle that brings people together! Play against a friend on one screen or against artificial intelligence. The rules are simple, the adrenaline is high.
A fun and simple word duel: guess words associated with the theme. Perfect brain training, an excellent educational game, and fun time well spent.
Test yourself and your erudition. Can you guess all the associations?

games.title: OIL RIG Driller
games.description: Drill Tycoon is a top-down idle tycoon set in a sun-baked desert oil field. Sink your rigs, haul the crude to the refinery, stack the barrels in your yard and sell them to the trucks rolling in on the loading road. Reinvest every dollar: faster rigs, a bigger depot, and a hired crew that keeps drilling while you are offline. Unlock gas, gold and finally diamonds, each with its own rig, plant and price. What sets it apart from the usual idle game: your crew works to real demand instead of just the nearest target, and your rigs wear down and need maintenance, so the field never quite runs itself.

games.title: Truck Slam
games.description: Two monster trucks. Two spinning maces. One survives. Smash enemies in single-player or duel a friend in 2-player mode on the same screen. Win battles, collect cogs, upgrade your wheels, body and mace — and keep slamming.

games.title: Drift Idle Drift Earn Upgrade
games.description: Drift Idle is a chill arcade drift game where your car drives itself — you just lean into the corners. Slide sideways to rack up combos up to 10× and turn drift into a money printer, then sink the cash into three upgrade lanes: Income, Speed, and Drift. Earn enough and you'll trade your starter for sleeker rides — Boss, Blacklist, Fallout, Cairo, and the elusive Midnight — each one drifting harder and paying out fatter than the last. Customise your paint, your smoke colour, and your skid trails until the track behind you looks exactly the way you want.

games.title: Cooking in the City of Winds
games.description: Welcome to the City of Winds. The culinary festival starts here today! Participants came from all over the magical land to prepare their favorite dishes and delight the citizens. Try your hand at making smooth pudding, tapioca bubble tea and the famous Hocus-Pocus marmalade dessert. This is simply heaven for those with a sweet tooth. Don’t forget that the dish should not only be tasty, but also beautiful. Use your cooking skills to decorate the dish as elegantly as possible. And victory will be yours!

games.title: Good and Evil DressUp
games.description: Dive into the enchanting world of a sorceress at a magical academy in "Good and Evil DressUp." Experiment with striking outfits that blend good and evil, featuring everything from shiny leather to elegant satin. Enjoy this free online game on your phone or computer, unleashing your creativity in limitless fashion.

games.title: Stack Up
games.description:
Stack Em Up! is a casual single-player puzzle game where your goal is to connect stacks of the same color to combine them. By chaining same-colored stacks, you build longer stacks; you try to reach stacks of length 10 or more.
It’s stylised and simple in controls.
There are many levels that get progressively more challenging.

games.title: Toilet Dash Run
games.description: Toilet Dash Run is a lighthearted path-drawing puzzle game. Guide each character to the matching restroom by drawing safe routes around fences, hazards, and moving enemies. Plan every line before the rush begins: once the routes are ready, everyone moves at the same time. Handcrafted levels, unlockable character looks, and quick mouse-or-touch play make every escape a fresh challenge.

games.title: Car Stunts Driving
games.description:
Drive a realistic car, drive along tracks with obstacles. Lots of different tracks for car stunts.
You have to drive the car along the tracks in the sky, overcome interesting obstacles and try not to fall off the track into the abyss!
The game has many different levels and realistic car physics.

games.title: Mega Sweet Fruits - Popper
games.description:
Welcome to Mega Sweet Fruits - Popper! 🍉💥
Take on 125 exciting levels filled with colorful fruits, plan your moves, and test your skills. 🎯🧩
But be careful! ⚠️🍒 Some fruits hide bombs that can cost you a life. Every move matters! ⏳❤️
Upgrade your abilities: increase your tap power, boost your starting lives, and use powerful pomegranates to clear the screen in one strike! 🍊🚀
Each level gets more challenging, keeping the fun fresh and intense. 🏆🔥
Unlock 9 mysterious achievements, grow stronger, and prove your mastery! 🎖️🔮
With 8 supported languages (English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese), you can share the same thrill with players worldwide. 🌍🗣️

games.title: Sky Golf
games.description: Sky Golf is a physics-based puzzle game where your objective is to guide a golf ball from a starting point to the hole. The golf ball rests on a complex structure made entirely of flat, interconnected platforms. Your primary mechanism for moving the ball is to rotate the entire platform structure either clockwise or anti-clockwise by set increments. When you rotate the platforms, gravity acts on the ball, causing it to roll across the flat surfaces. You must strategically time and execute these rotations to change the angle of the platforms, build momentum, and perfectly direct the ball across gaps and around obstacles until it safely drops into the goal. Each level challenges your spatial reasoning to find the precise sequence of rotations required for success.

games.title: Funny Bone Surgery
games.description: Leah went to play stakeboard on the street. But she was distracted and hit a car! She got a nasty broken arm and foot. Help fix her injuries and broken bones!

games.title: Nitro Ball
games.description:
Nitro Ball is a fast-paced car soccer game played entirely in your browser. Drive a boost-powered car, launch off the walls, and smash a giant ball into your opponent's goal. Jump, flip, and fly through the air to pull off saves and score from anywhere on the pitch.

Pick your mode: play a quick match against AI opponents in 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3, fight through a knockout tournament, or switch to Hockey mode where the ball is swapped for a heavy puck that slides across the ice. For a different kind of challenge, take on the Challenge Maps — timed obstacle courses that test your aerial control and precision driving, with your best times saved for every course.

Customise your ride with a garage full of cars, wheels, decals, boost trails, toppers and over 250 antenna flags. Free Play mode lets you practice in an arena solo with no opponents.

games.title: Vacation Overload
games.description:
Your summer vacation is finally here. The car is ready, the trunk is open, and your wife has decided that “packing light” means launching an endless parade of suitcases, beach bags, souvenirs, and suspiciously box-shaped travel essentials straight at you.

In Vacation Overload, your job is simple: fit everything into the trunk before the luggage pile turns into a total vacation disaster.

Rotate, stack, shuffle, and squeeze each piece into place across a 3D grid. Plan ahead, keep the queue under control, and prove that yes, somehow, all of this absolutely necessary vacation stuff can fit.

Can you survive the packing chaos and still make it to summer break?

games.title: Paint Race
games.description: Dive into the dynamic realm of Paint Race, an online game that tests your speed and accuracy. Navigate through vibrant circles while evading dark barriers across 50 thrilling levels. Available on both mobile and desktop, this free game provides an engaging mix of excitement and challenge.

games.title: Merge Guns
games.description: Merge Guns is a tower-defense and merge hybrid built on a single grid. Buy guns with gold, drag identical tiers together to merge them into stronger weapons, and defend against alien waves crawling in from the right. Eight gun tiers, persistent upgrades, boss waves, achievements, English and Russian localization, and run-to-run progression make every defense a new layout puzzle.

games.title: Alpha Balls
games.description: Alpha Balls is a stimulating word puzzle game that sharpens your mind and vocabulary. Enjoy it online for free on any device. Solve puzzles to earn coins for hints, making it an entertaining and educational challenge for all.

games.title: Mine Obby 3D: Car Wash Tycoon
games.description:
🚗 “Mine Obby 3D: Car Wash Tycoon” lets you build a small car wash and turn it into a huge automotive complex!

💦 Develop your car wash
Unlock foam, brushes, rinsing, drying, polishing, and other services.

💰 Earn money
Serve cars, wait for them to reach the cash register, and collect your earnings.

🏗️ Expand your business
Build a gas station, café, and repair shop. Upgrade every facility to increase your income.

🚦 Manage the traffic
Add more cars, improve their speed, and unlock gold, emerald, and diamond roads.

🐾 Collect pets
Equip pets to increase your character’s running speed.

⭐ Unlock every upgrade and become the ultimate car wash tycoon!

games.title: Space Rolling Balls Race
games.description:
Game Title: 🌌 Space Rolling Balls Race 🌠
Product Description:
Get ready for an exciting 3D adventure in Space Rolling Balls Race, a fun, addictive, and fast-paced rolling ball game set in outer space! 🌍✨
Control your rolling ball through thrilling cosmic tracks filled with obstacles, traps, jumps, and moving platforms. With simple fingertip controls, smooth physics-based gameplay, and catchy background music, every level will test your reflexes, timing, and focus!
🚀 Features:


🎯 Easy to play, hard to master rolling ball gameplay


🌠 Challenging 3D levels with cool space environments


⚡ Smooth controls and realistic physics


🎵 Addictive sound effects and rhythm-based fun


🪐 Suitable for all ages — perfect casual game for everyone


💫 If you love ball games, rolling games, parkour challenges, or reflex-based runners, Space Rolling Balls Race is the ultimate game for you!
Roll, dodge, and race your way through space to become the ultimate ball racing master! 🏆

games.title: Pirates Tiles Challenge
games.description: Pirates Tiles Challenge is a delightful tile-matching puzzle game with a vibrant pirate adventure theme. The core gameplay revolves around scanning a grid of pirate icons (flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, etc.) to find identical pairs and connect them using at most 3 straight lines without the path being blocked by other tiles — a classic “Mahjong Solitaire-style” matching rule that demands spatial awareness and quick thinking. As you clear the board, a treasure-hunt atmosphere unfolds with colorful pirate graphics, progressive difficulty, stars-based scoring, and fun power-ups, making it easy to pick up yet endlessly challenging for players of all ages.

games.title: Madness Online
games.description: Madness Online is a brutal 2D top-down multiplayer survival shooter set in a procedurally generated infinite world. Players must navigate a hostile, apocalyptic environment by fighting off relentless waves of zombies and enemy entities. The game blends intense, fast-paced gunplay with deep survival mechanics, allowing players to gather resources, craft essential gear, and construct fortified bases. Featuring dynamic combat with dodge mechanics and an expansive inventory system, players can team up with friends to build and survive together, or face the unforgiving world solo.

games.title: Highway Car Shooting 3D  Action Game 2025
games.description:
Race and shoot on the highway! Take down enemy cars in this fast-paced 3D car shooting action game.

Get ready for the ultimate mix of driving and shooting in Highway Fury – Car Shooting Action Game 3D 2025. Take the backseat, grab your gun, and unleash chaos as enemy cars chase you on endless highways. With explosive action, powerful weapons, and thrilling 3D graphics, this is the craziest car shooter of 2025 

If you love car shooting games, highway chases, and explosive battles, this is your chance to prove your skills. Take control, aim fast, and dominate the road in Highway Fury – Car Shooting Action Game 3D 2025!

games.title: Stickman Gun Rush
games.description:
Build the ultimate stickman weapon and blast your way to victory in Stickman Gun Rush!

Run through exciting tracks, collect stickmen, and assemble them into massive, powerful guns. Merge your growing weapon, avoid dangerous obstacles, collect cash, and upgrade your firepower as you race toward the finish line.

Every level brings new challenges, stronger enemies, and bigger rewards. Can you build the biggest gun and defeat the final boss?

Features

🔫 Build gigantic weapons from stickmen
🏃 Fast-paced runner gameplay
💰 Collect cash and unlock upgrades
🚀 Merge parts to create stronger guns
🎯 Face challenging enemies and bosses
🌆 Bright, colorful 3D environments
🎮 Easy controls, satisfying gameplay

games.title: Big Boom! Building Smash!
games.description:
💣 Ready to dive into a world of chaos and mayhem? If you’ve enjoyed games like Captain TNT and Noob Demolisher, then our game is about to become your new favorite! Blast buildings, smash through obstacles, and create total havoc on every level! You’ll face hundreds of crazy missions where every move could lead to epic explosions and complete destruction! 🧨

⚙️ What’s in Store:
- Thrilling levels with unique challenges and missions
- Realistic 3D graphics and dynamic effects
- Play online on any device – from your phone to your PC
- Leaderboards where you can compete with others and prove you’re the ultimate demolisher

🚀 Play solo or with friends, blow up everything in sight, and have a blast with all the destruction!

games.title: Fat Hedgehog Boris
games.description: Fat Hedgehog Boris is a funny platformer where every hit makes Boris fatter and changes how he moves. Run, jump, defeat enemies, collect coins, avoid dangerous traps, fight bosses, and reach the finish while trying to keep Boris in good shape.

games.title: Stickman Jump
games.description: Stickman Jump is a fast-paced platformer in which you have to jump and run across platforms with a little stickman. You control a small character who sprints at full speed and needs precise timing to jump over obstacles and complete each level. The further you get, the greater the challenges that will test your reflexes and concentration.

games.title: Hooked! Panya
games.description: A tap-timing fishing game where you match a moving tension zone to reel in fish before they escape. Ten fish species each behave differently — calm, aggressive, erratic — reach Endless Mode for rarer species and rising difficulty.

games.title: Snowball Dash
games.description: Control a lively red ball as it bounces its way down a snowy mountain! Avoid trees, rocks, and tricky obstacles to stay in the game as long as possible. The deeper you go, the faster it gets — and the tougher the ride! Grab glowing crystals along the path to boost your score and test your reflexes. How long can you survive the snowy descent?

games.title: Brainrot Mixup
games.description:
Brainrot Puzzle takes the viral brainrot animal aesthetic and turns it into an actually playable, satisfying, and replayable puzzle game — perfect for mobile, casual web, or PC.

If you love quirky puzzle games, if you’ve laughed at “banana chimpanzee” memes, or if you just want to rot your brain a little in between serious games — this one’s for you.

games.title: Bump Bandit
games.description: Bump Bandit is a clever top-down puzzle game wrapped in a retro jazzy atmosphere. You play as a quirky little thief determined to snatch every diamond in the city—and by the time the heist is over, he might just steal your heart too. Follow this charming rogue to the end of his adventure and uncover the unexpected twist in his story.

games.title: PopSortica
games.description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! 

Join the underwater SORTING voyage! 

Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.

The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.

Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

games.title: BreakBlock
games.description: Break Block is a colorful arcade brick-breaker with satisfying multi-ball action. Aim each shot, smash numbered blocks before they reach the bottom, build huge combos, and unlock playful ball skins.

games.title: Car Battle
games.description: Car Battle is an adrenaline-fueled driving brawler where your war vehicle doubles as both weapon and armor. Take on foes in solo campaigns or challenge friends in intense two-player duels, with each fight spanning five action-packed stages. Upgrade your car, refine your tactics, and unlock unique avatars to personalize your fighter as the battles grow more challenging.

games.title: Mine Block Party: World of Minigames
games.description:
In this game you will plunge into the exciting world of mini-games!

- Competitive spirit: for every victory you receive cups and coins, which you can spend on buying new skins or improving your character. Fight for the championship and become the most skilled player!

- Variety of skins: the ability to choose any skin, which includes characters from popular games, cartoons, as well as famous YouTubers. Let your character look the way you want!

- Variety of modes: the possibility to choose one of three modes, in one of which you will have to try your luck and choose the right path, and in the other you will have to show your dexterity and wit!

- Character upgrade: upgrade your character’s skills, making him faster and more agile in battles. Each victory brings not only pleasure, but also the opportunity to improve your hero.

Can you become the best in this game? Embark on an exciting adventure with your favorite characters!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?

A: Mini-games with block-style gameplay similar to Minecraft.

Q: What is the game's unique feature? How can it hook players?

A: The game offers a variety of games, unique skins, character progression, and rewards like cups and coins for each victory.

Q: Are there any currencies and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game features coins and diamonds as currencies, which can be spent on skins and character upgrades.

Q: What is the leveling up process like? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, players need to earn more money for purchasing upgrades by playing more and winning!

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game makes references to the world of Minecraft.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the hero's appearance, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers various skins for customization.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game, but it is not necessary for progression.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.

A: The entire game is a collection of mini-games.

games.title: Slither Snake 2048
games.description:
Players begin their journey as small snakes and eat colorful dots to grow.

However, the bigger you get, the more challenges you face.
You will have to avoid colliding with other snakes while you try to eat them. Your strategy and snake control will be key factors in your survival. Be careful, because if your head touches another snake, you will explode and the game will end.

But don't worry, you can always start over and try to beat your previous record. Slither Snake 2048 is a game that tests your skills, reactions and strategic thinking. Are you ready to become the biggest snake? Try it now!

games.title: Shoot & Sprint: Warfare
games.description: In the game, you will find yourself in the role of a brave fighter who rushes forward without stopping. Your task is to shoot the enemies and survive in this fast—paced action game.

games.title: Bubble Tower
games.description:
Bubble Tower 3D is a relaxing 3D bubble-pop / color-match puzzle game.
You rotate a tower (or cylinder) loaded with colored bubbles around its vertical axis.
Your goal is to shoot bubbles, matching colors to connect groups of the same color. When matched, those bubbles pop/drop off the tower.
There are many levels; difficulty increases as you go. More bubble colors, trickier arrangements, limited shots, etc.
Also there are diamonds or special gems you can collect in certain levels. These may unlock “shiny shapes” or cosmetic things.
The graphics are clean, simple, and meant for relaxing casual play. It mixes mental challenge (where to shoot, color matching) with a soothing visual.

games.title: Funny Ear Surgery
games.description: You are acting a professional ear doctor here to help people get rid of their ear problems. Now you must help our another cute patient with her ear problems. Be patience and enjoy it!

games.title: Mad Day 2 Special
games.description:
Mad Day 2 Special throws you back into explosive action as ex-Marine Bob takes on a full-scale alien invasion. Ride, shoot, jump, and smash your way through hostile worlds as you battle evil aliens and fight to rescue Bob’s kidnapped pet octopus. Packed with speed, firepower, and attitude, this is an action runner that never slows down.

This is a streamlined web version of the popular Mad Day 2 game. With fast loading, simple controls, and nonstop progression, it’s perfect for quick play sessions and long score-chasing runs alike.

Customize Bob’s truck with powerful weapons, armor, and boosters, then unleash chaos on waves of enemies and epic boss fights. Collect coins to upgrade your gear, unlock stylish outfits, and improve your chances of going further each run.

games.title: Nitro Racing Gear
games.description:
Hit the road in Nitro Racing Gear, a high-speed arcade racing game by BREYMANTECH! Take on 40 stages across eight worlds, from coastal highways and neon cities to snowy mountains and volcanic roads.
Compete in races, sprints, drift challenges, and drag duels. Unlock cars, upgrade their performance in the garage, and unleash nitro boosts to chase victory. Enjoy realistic 3D-rendered artwork, distinctive tracks, and an energetic soundtrack as you work toward the final championship.

games.title: Movie Star Daily Routine
games.description: Let's join the a day in the life of a movie star stream. We will spend the whole day with a famous actress from the series. The morning begins with cosmetic procedures and skin care. See how the skin of a movie star shines! Time to go in for sports to maintain excellent physical shape. Preparing for going to the gym begins with packing a bag - you need to take water, a yoga mat and other accessories. A star needs to look stylish even in the gym, so you need to get serious about choosing a tracksuit. It's time to put on your makeup and go to the screen test. The movie star will have to go through a casting and try on the image of the heroines of films and series. And finally, it's time to enjoy the glory. Having collected everything you need in a small clutch, the girl goes to the red carpet to amaze everyone with brilliant and original outfits!

games.title: Field of Blooms
games.description:
Your garden dried out. But you can save it!
Sweep the watering can across the field and dry sprouts open in a line behind your cursor. Then the fertilizer turns them into fat golden heads, then the basket collects the lot. Cash in what you gathered, buy a wider spray and a longer timer, and go back for more. Harvest the whole map and the season starts over, permanently richer!

games.title: Team Men
games.description: Gather teammates of the same color on the roads and gather a larger army. Reach the finish line at the end of the road, build the best army you can, collect the highest score and strengthen your army with points.

games.title: Ragdoll Football
games.description:
Ragdoll Football is wild arcade soccer with ZERO gravity! Your goofy yet lovable ragdoll player floats, tumbles and flies across the arena to smash the ball into the opponent's goal.

Every match lasts just 60 seconds and bursts with silly physics, flashy special strikes and surprise modifiers — giant ball, bouncy ball, huge goals, currents and more. No boring rounds, ever!

Win cups in Tournament mode, climb the ranked ladder in 1v1 Duels, unlock dozens of characters, balls and arenas, complete daily quests and storm the leaderboards. Easy controls, instant fun and endless replayable chaos — drop in for a minute and stay for hours.

games.title: My Bakery
games.description:
Build your confectionery empire in Family Bakery. Bake delicious treats, serve guests, and decorate your café in this cozy simulator designed for everyone.
Have you ever dreamed of running your own café? This bakery game gives you the opportunity. Your task is to bake pastries and satisfy customers to grow your business.
Why You Should Play
Simple and Engaging Mechanics: Customers arrive, you bake pastries, and serve them quickly.
Pleasant Atmosphere: A vibrant and warm design creates a relaxing mood.
Constant Progression: Unlock new recipes and expand your dining area.
Perfect for Relaxation: Easy-to-learn gameplay makes it a great game to unwind and relieve stress.

games.title: Slinger
games.description: Guide a red square through compact grid levels in this modern minimalist puzzle game. Clear paths, collect every yellow key, unlock the yellow door, and slip through to win. Each level challenges your thinking with simple mechanics, subtle complexity, and clean, focused design.

games.title: Ragdoll Brainrot Meme: Walk Challenge!
Brainrot Hunters: Shooter 3D
games.description:
Dive into an intense battle for your farm in BRAINROTH HUNTERS: 3D SHOOTER!
Your mission: defend the farm from the invasion of cunning Italian Brainrots and wily rival hunters. Hold the line, shoot back waves of meme-inducing monsters, and don't let the enemies break through!
Key features:
🐗 A variety of Brainrots—each with their own habits and tactics
🔥 Stunning 3D graphics, full of chaos and adrenaline
👂 Smart enemies—they react to shots and footsteps, forcing you to keep your head down!
Become a hunting legend, save the farm, and show who's boss! 🏹🔥

games.title: Mole Dig Clicker
games.description: Help the mole dig to the center of the world! An idle clicker where you tap to break dirt, buy upgrades, and watch your mole gear up with pickaxes, drills and a cart. Mining keeps going while you're away — claim your dirt when you return. How deep can you get?

games.title: Graveyard Wars - Two player
games.description: Are you ready for a competitive game between the Mummy and the Pumpkin King? Yes, someone has to win! Team up with a friend and choose either the Mummy or the Pumpkin King.Collect as many flying pumpkins as you can! You can earn coins by eating candy and win the game by collecting all the pumpkins. Catch the balloons and bring them to the treasure chest. The fastest collector wins! Different hats await you as you win. So, gather your friends, race, and collect all the pumpkins!

games.title: Precision Parking Pro
games.description:
Precision Parking Pro is the ultimate test of control, timing, and skill. Step into the driver’s seat and prove you’ve got what it takes to park with perfection. From tight city alleys to complex multi-level garages, every challenge pushes your precision and patience to the limit.

Master realistic vehicle physics, responsive steering, and smooth camera controls as you navigate tricky obstacles, narrow turns, and dynamic environments. Earn rewards, unlock new cars, and climb the ranks from rookie driver to true parking professional.

games.title: Zoo Elephant Simulator City Attack
games.description:
Step into the world of a mighty wild elephant and experience an exciting wildlife adventure across forests and cities. Explore vast environments, raise your elephant family, battle dangerous predators, and complete action-packed missions in this realistic animal simulator. With Jungle, City, and Free Mode, there's always a new adventure waiting.

In Jungle Mode, survive in the wilderness by finding food, protecting your mate and calves, and fighting fierce predators like lions, tigers, wolves, and cheetahs. Build your elephant family, complete survival missions, and explore beautiful forests, rivers, and open landscapes.

In City Mode, unleash your elephant's strength as you roam through busy streets, smash vehicles, destroy objects, collect coins, and complete exciting city rampage challenges. Test your power and cause chaos while earning rewards to unlock new content.

In Free Mode, explore the world at your own pace without mission restrictions. Discover hidden locations, enjoy peaceful exploration, interact with wildlife, and experience the beauty of nature however you like.

Features
-3 exciting game modes: Jungle, City, and Free Mode.
-Raise and protect your elephant family.
-Fight dangerous wild animals in thrilling survival battles.
-Large 3D open-world environments with forests and cities.
-Customize your elephant with different skins and appearances.
-Complete exciting missions, challenges, and city rampage objectives.
-Collect coins and unlock new rewards.
-Smooth controls, realistic animations, and immersive gameplay.

Become the leader of your elephant herd, conquer the jungle, dominate the city, or simply explore the open world in Zoo Elephant Simulator City Attacck. Every mode offers a unique adventure for animal simulation fans.

games.title: Fun With Flags - Ultimate Quiz Game
games.description:
Fun With Flags – Quiz Game is the ultimate challenge for players who love geography, trivia, and brain-teasing fun! Test your knowledge of world flags as you progress through levels filled with colorful flags from across the globe.

Each level displays one flag along with four answer options—only one is correct! Choose wisely and unlock new levels as you master flags from every continent.

Stuck on a tricky flag? No worries! Use the Hint button to get help by removing wrong choices or receiving clues that guide you to the correct answer.

Perfect for kids, students, and adults—whether you're learning or sharpening your global IQ, this game makes world geography fun, engaging, and rewarding!

games.title: Obby: Ragdoll Boxing
games.description:
Immerse yourself in Ragdoll boxing chaos and fun with Obby!

This is a unique simulator that combines ragdoll physics and crazy fights! Here you control not just a fighter, but a real rag doll, who will have to go through trials in the arena, in training and in improvised fights. Funny animation, unpredictable behavior and collision physics turn every fight into an exciting spectacle.

Create your own character, explore locations and prove who is the best boxer among Obby fighters. Control punches, dodge and hit with precise calculation - or just enjoy the chaotic fun, watching your characters fly around the arena.

🔑 Key features of the game:
🥊 Ragdoll physics - every hit is unpredictable
🎮 Simple controls with deep gameplay
🧍 Character customization
🧠 Elements of strategy and reaction
😂 Fun and unexpected situations in every fight
🌍 Various locations and arenas for battles

games.title: Cannon Strike
games.description:
Welcome to the fun world of Cannon Strike, an arcade game where you shoot balls from a cannon! It's very easy to play.
So, are you ready to aim and fire? Download Cannon Strike Ball now and start playing! Challenge yourself to see how many levels you can pass! 
Get the game today and have a blast shooting cannonballs!

games.title: Bricks Balls Breaker
games.description:
Bricks Balls Breaker is a addictive and challenging brick game.
Just play it to relax your brain. Be focus on breaking bricks and you will find it more funny and exciting.
Play and relax your brain. Focus on breaking bricks and you will find it more funny and exciting.
Swipe, aim, and shoot to break bricks and overcome thrilling puzzles. Smash as many bricks as possible in a single shot to earn stars, gems, and power-ups. With no time limits, you can enjoy this relaxing yet challenging game anywhere, anytime!

games.title: CrowdGate
games.description:
CrownGate is an addictive runner game that tests both your reflexes and strategy. Your stickmen run automatically — your job is to guide them through the right gates, grow your crowd, and win the big battle waiting at the end of the road.


Features
	•	Simple yet engaging runner gameplay
	•	Strategic choices with number gates
	•	Colorful and dynamic levels
	•	Short, fast, and fun sessions
	•	Play instantly for free in your browser

👉 Play CrownGate now, gather your crowd, and march to victory on your way to the throne!

games.title: Block Puzzle Magic
games.description: Block Puzzle Magic is a simple yet addictive puzzle game that challenges players to arrange blocks on a grid to clear full rows and columns. It blends relaxing gameplay with a bit of strategy: you can play in a few seconds to refresh your mind, but thinking ahead helps you last longer.

games.title: Masterpiece Unharmed
games.description:
Masterpiece Unharmed a game about the restoration of paintings. Match the colors, finish the damage and  inspector to the end of the timer and save the museum!
A night out, a closed museum, and a collection of famous paintings that someone managed to ruin right before the inspector arrived. In the game "Masterpiece Unharmed" you have to hide the traces of the most ridiculous incidents and convince the inspector that everything is fine with the art. Examine the damage, select the appropriate color with a pipette or palette, adjust the thickness of the brush and carefully restore the lost fragment. If you make a mistake, use an eraser or cancel the stroke. Scale and move the canvas to get to the small details, but keep an eye on the timer: the inspector is already on his way. Before each painting you will find a new funny story, and after work — a comparison with the original, highlighting errors and the caustic verdict of the inspector. With each level, the gaps become more difficult, there is less time, and the accident plots become more absurd.

games.title: Slappy Bird
games.description:
Instead of controlling the bird, you control the green pipes. Time your smashes perfectly to crush birds as they fly through the gap and collect coins for every successful hit.

But don't let too many escape—missing three birds ends the run. Spend your coins on permanent upgrades to increase coin rewards, reduce smash cooldown, and improve the chance of rare golden birds worth bonus coins. Test your reflexes, beat your high score, and see how long you can keep the skies clear!

Key Features:
Smash birds to earn coins
Endless high-score challenge
Permanent upgrades
Rare golden birds with bonus rewards
Simple controls, fast-paced action

games.title: Moto Obby
games.description: Join the exciting world of Moto Obby, where your motorbike skills face intense challenges. Overcome tricky hazards like swinging hammers and sharp spikes in a quest for victory. Test your reflexes across various levels in this thrilling online game, available on phones and computers.

games.title: Super Fruit Runner - Hyper Casual
games.description:
In this hyper casual runner game 🚀, you control fast-moving fruits and dodge obstacles to reach the finish line 🍏. With 15 unique levels 🗺️ and 12 special achievements 🎖️, the fun never ends! Thanks to 7 language options — English 🇬🇧, Russian 🇷🇺, French 🇫🇷, Turkish 🇹🇷, Spanish 🇪🇸, German 🇩🇪, and Italian 🇮🇹 — everyone can enjoy the game 🌍.

Destroy fruits by hitting knives 🗡️ and earn Yakut to buy powerful upgrades 💎, including:

Increase starting fruit count 🍎

Increase Yakut earnings 💰

Extra reward for hitting green platforms ➕

Reduce loss from hitting red platforms ➖

Use your speed, reflexes, and strategy 🧠💨 to clear all levels, unlock every achievement 🎖️.

games.title: Monsters' Wheels Special
games.description:
Monsters' Wheels Special is a 2D race game created by Smokoko. In this online game you race with your own monster truck in different stages like the Industrial, Forest, Arctic, Desert and City stage. Ugrade your monster truck so you can stay ahead of the competition and equip it with rockets and other weapons to really crush it.
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what are the objectives?
A: It is a racing platformer where you must navigate obstacles and cross the finish line first, mastering the vehicle's physics to succeed.

Q: What is the game's unique hook and what makes it engaging?
A: The game features an upgrade system, a cool soundtrack, monster trucks, and diverse environments like forests, cities, winter landscapes, industrial zones, and deserts. It also offers multiple modes, including traditional races and time trials.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: The highlight of the game is the collection of awesome monster trucks and several beautifully designed locations.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What is the fastest way to level up?
A: Players need to win levels to accumulate gold, which is spent on vehicle upgrades. You can improve your car's durability, nitro capacity, tires, and engine performance.

Q: Is the total number of levels known?
A: There are 45 levels in the game.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: There is gold, which can be used to buy new cars or upgrade existing ones.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar retention mechanics?
A: Yes, the game features daily rewards to encourage regular play.

Q: Is it better to play with sound on, or are there difficulties playing without it?
A: While not strictly necessary for gameplay, the music and sound effects greatly enhance the overall atmosphere.

games.title: Acox
games.description: Acox is a simple platformer game that challenges players to complete 30 levels by controlling a character through various obstacles to reach the goal in each level.

games.title: SWARM MINERS
games.description: SWARM MINERS is a cozy mining-idle adventure. Swing your pickaxe to smash gem-rich rocks, hatch a swarm of collectible pets that mine and fight alongside you, and unlock 40 vibrant worlds from sunny meadows to cosmic voids. Upgrade tools, chase treasure rocks, spin the Wheel of Fortune, blast ore with dynamite, and battle bosses. Easy to pick up, endlessly rewarding.

games.title: Sweet Supermarket Simulator
games.description:
- Collect ingredients  
- Stock shelves  
- Earn money  
- Unlock new shelves with products  
- Hire new staff  
- Upgrade your character  
- Unlock new supermarkets

games.title: Knight Bolts : Merge Edition
games.description: The kingdom is under attack by evil orcs! Gather your knights, merge them to create stronger warriors, and fight back against the darkness.

games.title: Catch the Cat
games.description: Catch the cat is a cozy line-drawing puzzle. Draw a path from the kid to the same-color kitten, dodge cars, dogs, holes and fences, grab the food when the kitten is hungry, and bring it safely home. +50 hand-tuned levels, collectible coins, a pet home where you feed and play with your cat, and a wardrobe to dress it up. Simple one-finger controls. Playable in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

games.title: Evolution: Survival
games.description:
A survival game where you begin as a tiny cell in the primordial soup. Collect DNA by consuming food and defeating enemies to trigger evolution and choose your mutation: speed, attack, defense, poison, regeneration, or intelligence.

With each evolution, the world transforms — from open ocean to the deep sea, from shallow waters to dry land. Enemies grow stronger, elite opponents emerge, and fearsome bosses stand in your way. Combine mutations to unlock secret forms: Dragon, Leviathan, Phantom, Hive Mind, and more.

Collect rare stars scattered across the map and invest them into permanent upgrades that carry over between runs. Use active abilities — dash, acid spit, death cloud, traps, and cover — to survive as long as possible.

How many evolutions will you conquer?

games.title: Russian Drift: Overtaking in the City
games.description: Experience the thrill of Russian Drift: Overtaking in the City—an intense street racing game with realistic physics, stunning graphics, and adrenaline-fueled drifts. Overtake rivals, master your skills, and dominate the competition. Ready to become a legend?

games.title: Jump And Run For Brainrot
games.description:
Run and Jump for Brainrot is a fast-paced game where your goal is to collect Brainrot memes and grow stronger.

Jump across platforms to gather Brainrot, bring it back to your base, and power up. Level up to jump higher and reach even more challenging areas.

games.title: Rumbox Designer
games.description:
"Rumbox Designer" is a game about creating cozy mini—rooms in a box: arrange furniture, combine objects and assemble beautiful scenes step by step. 
The style is a pastel isometry with simple shapes and soft shadows, so that the process is perceived as calm creativity. 
Collect rumboxes from objects: furniture, decor, room details. 
Experiment with the arrangement to find the most harmonious compositions. 
Unlock new sets and room themes by adding to your collection. 
Complete the levels/tasks and develop your rumbox studio.

games.title: Bow Brawls
games.description:
Bow Brawls – Top-Down Archery Battles!

Enter Bow Brawls, a thrilling archery survival game where you aim with drag controls that feel like a real bow. Pull, release, and strike down endless waves of enemies! Each wave ends with a powerful boss fight, forcing you to master skill and strategy.

Unlock 5 unique bows, 5 armors, and 5 arenas as you progress. Every weapon and battleground adds a new style of play. Face bosses with special abilities and prove your reflexes in intense battles.

Compete with players worldwide through global leaderboards. Show off your best scores and climb to the top to become the ultimate archer.

Perfect for casual players, kids, and competitive gamers, Bow Brawls is easy to pick up yet challenging to master. Endless action, exciting unlocks, and competitive spirit await you.

🎯 Aim true. ⚔ Defeat bosses. 👑 Rule the leaderboard.
Play Bow Brawls now and test your archery skills!

games.title: The Depth of the Limbo
games.description:
The game is about a girl in limbo who has to complete all the levels to wake up. Top view: The character must overcome 13 levels. Each level is a one—minute test cycle, but the camera rotates around the hero, changing the orientation of the space. Due to the moving camera, you can get confused about right, left, up and down, which turns simple routes into a puzzle.

The lines of the path seem familiar until they turn around your head, forcing you to rethink each goal. The goal is simple and touching: to complete the route from beginning to end, overcome the inner noise of fear, and wake up refreshed and free.

games.title: A Long Way Home
games.description: A Long Way Home is a chilling survival horror game that plunges you into the role of a lost wanderer, desperately trying to find their way back home. Stranded in an eerie, ever-changing landscape, you must navigate through shadowy corridors and odd places while being relentlessly pursued by strange, otherworldly creatures. As reality begins to unravel, you'll encounter haunting visions and unsettling experiences that blur the line between fear and madness. Will you uncover the truth behind your nightmarish journey or succumb to the horrors lurking in the dark? Prepare for a gripping tale of survival, mystery, and terror in A Long Way Home.

games.title: Block Master Gem Puzzle
games.description: Block Master Gem Puzzle is a fun and addictive 8x8 block puzzle game with exciting game modes. Enjoy endless relaxing gameplay in Classic mode, collect diamonds and beat challenging levels in Diamond Quest, or clear every block within limited moves in Clear the Board mode. Easy to play but hard to master, this gem-style puzzle features smooth controls, satisfying effects, and brain-training challenges for all ages. Play anytime, anywhere!

games.title: Bubble Merge 2d
games.description: Bubble Merge is a relaxing physics-based puzzle game where you combine matching bubbles to create new items and complete each level’s objectives. Plan your moves carefully, use helpful power-ups, and discover new combinations as the challenges become more difficult.

games.title: Subby Quest
games.description:
Welcome to a world swallowed by darkness. An underwater cave stretches endlessly before you, full of mystery, danger, and things you never expected to find. Explore it, survive it, and uncover what lies beneath.
Coins are scattered all across the deep. Grab them and spend them wisely, whether that's growing your submarine fleet or loading up on boosts to push through the toughest moments the cave throws at you.
And keep your eyes open. Rare gems are hiding in places most players never reach. Finding them is the real challenge.
The cave doesn't care how far you've come. It just keeps going. Will you?

games.title: Besties on Wednesday
games.description: A young bestie goes to school to learn magic and make new friends. She has her own special style. The girl prefers black colors in clothes and a gothic look. Her roommate likes bright colors in her clothes. It will not be easy for new acquaintances to find a common language. However, this bright girl is not as simple as it seems at first glance. She has her secrets. Try to choose for each student an image that suits her perfectly. And one day these besties will be BFF.

games.title: Circle Car Crash 3D
games.description:
Drive fast, crash hard! Race in endless circles and survive epic 3D collisions.

Get ready for the ultimate crash challenge in Circle Car Crash 3D — a high-speed, physics-based racing arena where every turn could be your last!

Race around circular tracks, dodge opponents, and cause spectacular slow-motion collisions. Earn points for near misses, perfect drifts, and insane crashes that send cars flying!

With realistic crash physics, simple controls, and thrilling 3D visuals, this game delivers nonstop fun for fans of car stunt and destruction games.

🚗 Game Features

💥 Realistic crash physics and metal-bending effects

🔄 Endless circular tracks full of obstacles & chaos

⚙️ Upgrade cars for better speed and handling

🔊 Immersive engine sounds and visual effects

Can you survive the loop and become the last car standing? Download Circle Car Crash 3D now and crash your way to victory!

games.title: 4 Clues 1 Word
games.description:
Think you’re a master of language? Put your lateral thinking to the test with 4 Clues 1 Word, the word puzzle game that goes beyond the surface. Most games ask you to find a simple object; we ask you to find the hidden connection between worlds.

Whether it’s the Stock in a financial market, a pot of Stock on a stove, or the Stock in a warehouse—your job is to find the one word that rules them all. Featuring stunning, high-definition photography and curated levels ranging from "Casual" to "Mind-Bending," 4 Clues 1 Word is designed for the curious, the clever, and the linguistically brave.

It’s not just a game; it’s a workout for your synapses. Can you see the pattern?

games.title: Soccer Jump
games.description: Enter the playground where children are recreating the World Cup and imagining superpowers; watch out for the final, which will be a more complex match than the others!!

games.title: CLUTTER MASTER
games.description:
Clutter Master is a casual cozy game where you organize a messy room by placing each item where it belongs.
A secret awaits at the end of the game...

games.title: Cat Rescue
games.description:
The newest save cat game is here! Rescue the poor kitty from all the obstacles in his way. Draw a simple line to protect the cat from the evil bees that will try everything to sting him.

Cat Rescue is the best way to train your brain. Draws a line, a circle, a star, anything you like, the sky is the limit. Each level will require a different solution. It takes the sharpest of minds to complete every challenge and protect the kitty and his nap.

games.title: Foxy Eco Sort
games.description:
Join Foxy and Raccoon on their eco-mission! Sort waste, play match-3 and matching pairs to clean polluted locations. 

But it's not just cleaning! Uncover the conspiracy of cunning Ratty who wants to destroy the forest. Complete story chapters: track garbage trucks, expose arsonists and save your home!

Features:
🌿 Waste sorting - learn to separate waste: glass, plastic, paper and organics.
🌎 Clean up locations - each cleaned area becomes more beautiful, and the rescued animals rejoice!
🦝 Complete the story line by uncovering the cunning rat's conspiracies.
🦊 Funny characters - Foxy the fox will tell you why sorting is important, and the raccoon... well, he's still lazy, but he'll get it!
😂 Funny dialogues - the characters won't let you get bored, their communication will cheer you up!

Ready to save the planet? Then go ahead - Foxy and the raccoon are already waiting for you! ♻️🦝🦊

P.S. The game is made with love for nature and good jokes. Enjoy the game!

games.title: Crazy Sheep
games.description: Crazy Sheep is a fun puzzle-platformer where you help a clumsy sheep overcome obstacles by building a bridge with different items. Available for free online, it features engaging physics challenges. Playable on any device, it's perfect for those who love light-hearted, casual games.

games.title: Blondie in the Real World
games.description: Blondie lives in her perfect doll world. She is happy, but one day she realizes that something is wrong with her life. Her life is too artificial and perfect. Blondie decides to go to the real world to feel real. Help the Blonde to embody her image in makeup. Bake a cake for the guests and put things in order with Blondie in her new apartment. Choose an adorable party outfit for her and remember that Blondie's favorite colors are pink, gold and white.

games.title: DoggyDoku
games.description:
Head-to-head sudoku-style puzzle duel with a cartoon dog theme. You and a rival race to solve logic grids before a five-minute timer runs out.

Each puzzle is a grid divided into colored regions. Your job is to place exactly one dog in every row, every column, and every colored region — while making sure no two dogs touch, not even diagonally. Use deduction, mark impossible tiles with X’s, and spend coins on hints when you’re stuck.

Win more boards than your rival to climb the Pup Ladder, earn coins and rank points, and unlock cosmetics, daily tasks, season pass rewards, and more. Matches feel online, but everything runs locally — there’s no real backend.

games.title: Sling Chicken
games.description:
You start in a barn and climb upward by attaching to wooden rungs (pegs). From each rung you pull back and release the chicken like a slingshot to fling it to the next peg higher up.

The track is endless and gets harder as you climb:

Spinning saws guard some rungs
Wood boards block half the lane (with a gap you must fly through)
Other obstacles appear at higher heights: slanted beams, diamonds, moving pills, stone blocks, spinning wheels
Golden eggs float along flight paths as bonus pickups. Your main score is height in meters — how high you’ve climbed. A simulated rival chicken climbs alongside you, gaining meters over time.

Each match lasts 90 seconds. Win by ending with more meters than your rival. If you die mid-match, your score freezes at your peak height and the match ends shortly after; you still win if you’re ahead.

Outside matches you can earn coins and rank points (RP), unlock cosmetics, and play Quick Match or the Coop Climb ladder (5 rivals in a row).

games.title: Bird Game Clicker
games.description:
This is a clicker game about hesitation, doubt, and the eternal “well… maybe”.

In this world, birds never give clear answers.
To any question you’ll hear:
“I doubt it”, “50/50”, “unlikely”, “partially”, “hard to say” — and dozens of other evasive replies.

Click, collect feathers, and upgrade your flock of doubtful birds.
Unlock new ones and complete the full collection of the most uncertain creatures in the world.

🔹 Feathers — used for regular upgrades and faster progression
🌾 Grain — a rare currency for unique improvements and special bonuses
📈 Many upgrades with unexpected effects
🏆 Leaderboards — compete to become the most doubtful keeper of grain
💬 Chat — talk with other players who are just as uncertain

You don’t need to be right here.
You just need to doubt.

Become a legend of hesitation.
Or… maybe not.

games.title: Deep Drill
games.description:
Deep Drill Idle is a mining idle game that plays itself. There is no home screen: the page loads and the bit is already turning. Every metre it cuts pays ore, ore is the only thing you spend, and there is no timer, no lives and no way to lose — the well keeps producing while you read the panel, and it keeps paying while the tab is closed.

Twelve rig tracks are what you spend it on: a bigger bit for speed, coolant to cut the rock's hardness, a wider hopper for richness, a night shift that makes coming back tomorrow worth more. Ore is paid per metre rather than per second, so a hard layer is automatically both slower and poorer — and every one of the eight strata is harder and poorer than the one above it. The well decelerates rather than merely slowing, and that wall is the whole point.

When it stops being worth it, seal the well. Depth, ore and every rig level go back to zero, and the deepest point you reached pays out in cores. Twelve permanent core nodes never reset: speed, hardness liners, an old-workings charter that fast-forwards the shallows you have already drilled, a foreman that buys levels for you while you are away. The payout is superlinear, so one deep run always beats two shallow ones.

games.title: Harvest Haulers
games.description: Harvest is an idle tap game about running a fruit farm. Tap the hopper to shake loose fruit, dumping it onto trucks on the belt. Full trucks drive off and pay gold. Spend gold on upgrades: more fruit per tap, bigger trucks, a faster belt, extra lanes.

games.title: Frontline Commando Shooting: Gun Games
games.description: Welcome to the world of gun shooting games. Get ready to step into the world of intense gun battles, thrilling missions, and heart-pounding survival challenges in the most complete first-person shooter game. Choose from an enormous collection of authentic, modern firearms and futuristic experimental guns. Pistols, assault rifles, SMGs, sniper rifles, shotguns, heavy machine guns every weapon feels unique and powerful.

games.title: Easter Funny Makeup
games.description: Eliza and her niece are getting ready for Easter in the most creative way—by designing festive face art! Use cheerful symbols of the season like Easter eggs, bunnies, flowers, butterflies, and rainbows to craft a bright and joyful spring look.

games.title: 2048 3D: Merge Cubes
games.description:
Merge the Blocks, Reach 2048, and Conquer the Levels!**

Blocks with numbers from 2 to 2048 drop onto the field. Combine matching blocks to create higher-value ones and score points. But watch out — some blocks are stones, which can’t be merged. Use powerful boosters like bombs and lightning to clear them out.
1. Make the most of your boosters:
2. X2 — doubles the value of any number block
3. Bomb — destroys surrounding blocks

Flash — removes all stones from the field

Don’t let the blocks stack above the top boundary for more than three seconds — or it’s game over!

Complete challenging levels, set high scores in endless mode, and become the ultimate merge master!

games.title: Strike Bullet
games.description: Strike Bullet is a ricochet puzzle shooter. Aim carefully, bounce your shot off metal walls, and take out every enemy. Plan your angle, watch the trajectory, and clear 20 levels packed with challenge!

games.title: Tangram Triangle
games.description: Tangram Triangle is a captivating mobile puzzle game that reimagines the classic tangram tradition with triangular blocks, challenging players to drag and rotate colorful pieces—blue, yellow, red, and orange—to perfectly fill irregular silhouettes on a grid. Its core idea revolves around spatial reasoning and problem-solving, blending accessibility for all ages with progressively tougher levels and a time-attack mode for high-score chases, making it uniquely addictive through clean visuals, hundreds of puzzles, and family-friendly brain-teasing fun.

games.title: SquadZ
games.description: Get ready for fast-paced, action-packed battles that you can dive into at any time. This hyper-casual shooter features bite-sized levels full of non-stop excitement, where you can unlock cool heroes, collect powerful weapons, and take down enemies in a flash. With simple controls and quick missions, you can play for as little as one minute or twenty, delivering epic fun on the go. Whether you're short on time or ready to aim for a high score, this explosive shooter has something for everyone.

games.title: Happy Glass - Draw to Fill
games.description: Happy Glass: Draw to Fill is a creative and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to fill a happy glass with water — but there's a twist! You must draw lines and shapes to guide the water flow into the glass. Think strategically, draw creatively, and use physics to your advantage as you solve increasingly challenging levels. The game features colorful visuals, satisfying animations, and a joyful glass that smiles only when full. Whether you're a fan of brain teasers or just love doodling your way through clever puzzles, this game is sure to entertain and test your ingenuity.

games.title: Match them up!
games.description: Match Them Up! is a relaxing 3D matching puzzle where you search for pairs of identical objects scattered around the room. Tap to match, clear the space, and beat your best time! With smooth controls and colorful toon visuals, every round feels satisfying and fun.

games.title: Flow Blast Shooter
games.description:
Flow Blast Shooter is a fast-paced puzzle shooter where timing and color control are the key to victory. Blocks flow continuously along a conveyor system, and it’s your job to place shooters, aim carefully, and fire at the perfect moment to keep the flow moving.

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what is the objective?
A: The player controls ""units"" (colored characters marked with a number) to fill or clear colored segments on a closed track.

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: This is a typical hyper/hybrid casual game, where the narrative is secondary to the constant flow of levels.

Q: What is the unique selling point (USP)? What will hook players?
A: Number-based logic combined with color; the satisfying sensation of ""clearing"" or ""filling"" a space.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses, and how do they differ from one another?
A: No.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What in-game currencies exist, and what can they be used for (e.g., standard: gold, premium: crystals)?
A: Currency is spent on boosters.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you qualify, and what types are available (e.g., weekly, monthly, all-time)?
A: No.

Q: Is it advisable to play with the sound on for better immersion, or will playing without sound make the game more difficult?
A: The music is good and complements the gameplay, but it is not essential for completing the game."

games.title: Rolling Balancer Ball
games.description: Rolling Balance Ball 3D is a simple but challenging balance game where your main goal is to guide a rolling ball across narrow wooden bridges surrounded by water. You must keep the ball steady, avoid traps, and safely reach the boat at the end of each level. The gameplay feels physics-based, so small moves matter one wrong swipe and the ball can fall into the water.

games.title: Easy Obby Parkour
games.description:
Parkour-based game.
The nickname of the best player is shown to everyone at the start - beat the game and your nickname will be displayed too.
Change skins to easily tell players apart.
And check where each portal leads ;)

Colorful skins and different character models.

Pets (cats, sheep, dragons... they count as pets, right?)

If the game feels too hard, activate a boost like double jump or others to pass difficult sections.

Checkpoints are not saved - each run must start from the beginning so speed times are fair for all players.

games.title: Capy Cafe
games.description:
Capy Cafe is a cozy idle-management game where you run an adorable café as a hard-working capybara barista. Harvest fresh strawberries and tea leaves, brew fragrant teas, shake up bubble tea and boba, and blend creamy smoothies — then serve them to a steady stream of happy customers.

There are no buttons to fumble with: just waddle up to a station and your capy gets to work automatically. Reinvest your earnings to unlock new drinks and stations, and hire helper capybaras to keep every corner of the cafe humming while you expand. What starts as a tiny tea stand grows into a bustling boba empire — one cup at a time.

Simple one-thumb controls, satisfying progression, and the most relaxing café this side of the riverbank. Genre: casual idle tycoon / shop-management sim.

games.title: Mister Bullet: Arcade Shooter
games.description:
ou are a cool special agent Mr. Bullet. You are sent on the most dangerous missions in the world. Only Mr. Bullet knows how to use all types of weapons perfectly. Only Mr. Bullet can sneak into the enemy base unnoticed.
This time, a new threat looms over the world - the Balloon Villains! They brought a lot of equipment, soldiers, weapons, even Boss monsters! But Mr. Shooter knows what to do!
Features of the game:
- A huge arsenal of weapons! There are so many weapons that the enemies lose all desire to fight! Take what you like - pistols, shotguns, machine guns, grenade launchers and much more!
- Stealth shooter on huge territories! Stay in the shadows so that your enemies are afraid of you!
- Variability of level completion. Act stealthily or take a grenade launcher and give your enemies an unforgettable meeting!
- A large number of levels! You have a long journey through the game worlds, so be ready for battle!
- Many different types of enemies!
Forward to the Battle!

games.title: Yummy Waffle Ice Cream

Obby: Sword Hero Adventure is an exciting game where you’ll master your sword skills. Increase your attack power, obtain and use rarer swords. Build a collection of the best companions, defeat enemies, fight bosses, and explore all the game worlds in search of adventure!

games.title: Color Fall
games.description: Color Fall is a captivating puzzle game where you match colors with precision by sliding pins in various directions. What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? games.description:
100 Doors  Puzzle Box is an exciting puzzle and escape room game where every level brings a new challenge, mysterious doors, and hidden secrets.
