A: Yes, bosses try to block your path. For example, a coach will try to stop you from running through the gym.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main plot?
A: Yes. Once you escape the school, there are mini-games available in the yard.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on?
A: There are two currencies: tickets and money. You can use them to buy new skins.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you change the character's appearance?
A: Yes, you can purchase various skins and even a pet for your character.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them?
A: Yes, there is a time-based leaderboard. Try to escape school faster than anyone else\!

Q: Should the game be played with sound?
A: The music complements the atmosphere well, but it is not required to complete the game

games.title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
games.description:
Anime Couple: Avatar Maker, the ultimate anime avatar character creation experience! Dive into the world of anime with our cutting-edge app that lets you design anime avatar faces, dress up girl avatars, and create the coolest anime couple characters you've ever seen.

🌟 Key Features 🌟

👫 Romantic Anime Couple Creation: Unleash your inner artist and craft breathtaking anime couple avatars that radiate love and passion.

👗 Anime Dress Up Girl Avatar: Design your perfect anime girl with a wide range of stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles.

🤩 Cool Anime Avatar Maker: Get ready to be amazed by the sheer coolness of our avatar creator.

💏 Avatar Couple ASMR: Dive into a relaxing ASMR experience as you create your dream anime couple.

🎨 Anime Cartoon Avatar: Bring your imagination to life with our anime-inspired art style.

👑 Avatar Couple Creator: Be the mastermind behind the most captivating anime couples.

games.title: Word String
games.description:
🧠 Challenge Your Mind with Word Chains! 🧠
Do you love word games, brain teasers, and puzzle challenges? Get ready for a unique twist on wordplay with Word String Puzzle! Use the first given word, then uncover the next word, which either forms a compound word or completes a famous phrase. Keep guessing and linking words to create an exciting word chain that will test your vocabulary, logic, and creativity!

games.title: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzles
games.description: A beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with hundreds of stunning images to assemble. Choose from 7 difficulty levels — from relaxing 35-piece puzzles to epic 630-piece challenges. Explore daily puzzles for fresh content every day, or try Mystery mode where the picture is hidden and you race against the clock. Smart piece grouping, smooth drag-and-drop  controls, section zoom for large puzzles, and helpful power-ups like magnets and picture hints make every session satisfying. Whether you have five minutes or an hour, there is always a perfect puzzle waiting for you.

games.title: Animals vs Zombies
games.description:
Your beloved animals have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to rescue them and teach those alien bullies a lesson. Tame and befriend a wide variety of creatures, evolve them to defeat stronger enemies, and unlock rare resources to help your companions grow even more powerful. From familiar cats and dogs to unique representatives of wild fauna, every animal brings something special to your adventure. Build your ultimate team and discover just how incredible your animal allies can become!
Explore new territories—from sunny beaches and peaceful parks to bustling city squares and mysterious forests—each filled with new creatures waiting to be saved.

Game features:

Animal evolution! Your companions can transform into powerful and unique defenders, each with their own abilities.
A huge variety of animals! Befriend everything from common cats and dogs to rare and exotic wildlife.
Engaging story and quests! Uncover the mystery of the island and complete exciting challenges.
Countless alien enemies! Encounter a wide range of funny and dangerous opponents.
Epic Alien Bosses! Face powerful bosses—you’re not alone in this world!
A vast game world! Explore diverse locations full of secrets and new animals to discover.

games.title: Plants vs Zombies Fusion Nightmare
games.description:
Welcome to the ruins of the suburban zone, where the old rules no longer apply. You are not a gardener. You are the Chaos Dispatcher.

 The zombies have mutated, now moving stealthily, attacking from the sky, and hacking into your turrets. The only way to survive is to create hybrid mutants from the scraps of plant DNA. Chimeras that carry the fury of the Pea Farmer and the coldness of the Recidivist Cactus.

 Forget the "plant and water" tactic. Here, every hybrid is a crime against nature, and it's worth it.

games.title: Solar Smash
games.description:
Solar Smash is a fun game that allows you to fully embrace cosmic power and create or destroy planets as you wish. You can choose from a variety of different weapons and use them to destroy planets and moons. Additionally, you can create your own planetary systems and customize them as you wish.

Solar Smash is also an opportunity to unleash your creativity and create worlds or destroy them in your hands. You can tear apart planets, cause supernovas and create black holes that consume everything in their path. The game has intuitive controls that are suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

Overall, Solar Smash is an addictive game that allows you to harness cosmic power and create or destroy planets at will. If you love physics simulators and space, then this game is definitely for you!

games.title: From Nerd to School Popular
games.description: Dress up and style: from nerd to cool! In this game, you set the rules. Transform your look, be all the rage, from school outcast to center stage!

games.title: Rise of the Dead
games.description: Rise of the Dead is a shooting horror game where you must fight off waves of zombies at every angle while completing task-driven quests. As the city falls into chaos, your mission is to uncover the cause of the apocalypse and fight to survive. Upgrade your weapons, buy new guns, and improve your skills to increase your chances. Play through different modes like sniper missions, survival challenges, and resource exploration. Dive into the intense horror of this post-apocalyptic world and battle to stay alive!

games.title: Neon Maze
games.description: Neon maze is a vibrant neon logic puzzle where every move counts. Untangle the maze, clear the arrows, and play now!

games.title: Click Click Clicker
games.description: Click Click Clicker defines the idle clicker genre, offering engaging gameplay where players accumulate wealth by clicking a button. As you advance, you can unlock different buttons, cursors, themes, and music. This free game is available on mobile devices and computers, providing fun for all.

games.title: Sprunki Action Playground: Ragdoll Sandbox
games.description: Action 2D sandbox with physics, where battles, destruction, construction and complete freedom of action await you!

games.title: Chicken Merge 2
games.description: Chicken Merge 2 is a merge-meets-tower-defense game where your feathered army stands between your base and endless waves of enemies! Train, upgrade, and merge your chickens to create powerful defenders, then position them strategically on the battlefield. The stronger your flock, the better weapons and upgrades you’ll unlock! Can your ultimate chicken squad hold the line?

games.title: The Tall Man
games.description:
The Tall Man is a horror game where you explore darkness, searching for clues with only a weak light to guide you. But something is watching, always, just out of sight.

In this first-person horror survival game, the player navigates a dark, desolate forest at night with the primary objective of collecting nine mysterious pages scattered across the environment before a supernatural entity arrives. Movement is cautious and tense, utilizing a flashlight with a depleting battery to illuminate looming pine trees, abandoned structures, and rusted vehicles. The core gameplay loop focuses on exploration and stealth, where success depends on finding all collectibles while managing limited light sources to avoid the looming threat. The visual style is rooted in a gritty, realistic 3D aesthetic featuring a high-contrast palette of deep blacks, navy blues, and cold grays, creating a chilling atmosphere punctured only by the harsh yellow glow of the flashlight. A persistent HUD displays a countdown timer for the Slender-inspired Tallman, a page counter, a flashlight battery indicator, and a mini-map for navigation. The setting is a classic horror woodland characterized by tall, spindly trees and foggy patches, evoking a sense of isolation and vulnerability. The protagonist appears as a generic human figure in a pinkish sleeve, seen only via their hand clutching the light. The emotional tone is high-tension and creepy, targeting teens and adult fans of the urban legend horror genre who enjoy skill-heavy survival mechanics and jumpscares. Progression is measured by the increasing number of pages found, which heightens the difficulty and atmospheric soundscapes as the player nears the final objective.

games.title: Gym Boss
games.description:
💪 "Gym Boss" – a casual game where you start with basic equipment and gradually become a true champion!

🔥 Game Features:
✔ Strength Training – from simple push-ups to heavy barbells!
✔ Players Rivals – compete for the title of the best!
✔ Ring Bosses – defeat them all!
✔ Simple Mechanics – perfect for mobile & PC!

🎯 Can you become the ultimate Gym Boss? Test yourself now!

games.title: Paper Doll Diary: Dress Up DIY
games.description:
🌈 Welcome to Paper Doll Diary: Doll DressUp, where the timeless charm of DIY paper dolls meets the exhilarating world of fashion dress up! Step into a realm of creativity and style where you become the master stylist of your enchanting paper doll dress up. With an expansive wardrobe featuring over 1000 fashion items, including the latest in trendy attire, distinctive accessories, diverse hairstyles, and soothing ASMR makeup touches, your creative potential is limitless.

🎀Paper Doll Diary: Doll DressUp is more than a mere dress up game; it's an adventure that unfolds with every outfit and accessory you choose. Not only do you get to design and style your paper doll DIY, but you also craft her story. From diary entries that capture the essence of your fashion journey to photo shoots that showcase your styling prowess in various scenes, immerse yourself in a narrative of your own making. Navigate through captivating plotlines, face makeover challenges, and let your style decisions shape the destiny of your paper doll.

games.title: Obby: Mini-Games VS 1000
games.description:
Become the best out of 1,000 players and win the grand prize in the thrilling new Squid Game!
Extreme challenges await you, where only the strongest survive. Here are some of them:

🔨 Savage Hammers – Dodge them before they smash you!

➕ Math Spikes – Solve equations quickly and correctly, or lose!

🟥 Falling Tiles – Don’t stand too long — the tile might collapse beneath you!

🧱 Building Madness – Dodge brick blocks building up in front of you! Climb fast or get trapped!

🎵 Dancing Tiles – The music stopped? Stand on the right color — or it’s game over!

⛰️ Deadly Climb – Reach the top of the mountain while dodging massive rolling balls!

Can you survive and prove you're number one out of a thousand?

games.title: Barry Prison: Parkour Escape!
games.description: Embark on an epic adventure in Barry Prison: Parkour Escape! Outwit the warden, pass the tests, collect all the coins and get out of prison!

games.title: Bubble Pop Fairyland
games.description:
Bubble Pop Fairyland is an exciting bubble shooter game that’s very highly addictive!
Aim, shoot & pop all the color bubbles using epic blasters to clear the board and win coins!

Bubble Pop Fairyland is a fun and relaxing puzzle game designed to keep your mind sharp at any age.
It also is a perfect brain training and fast solution making game
You will have hours of fun shooting & matching the same colored bubbles!
With thousands of challenging & addictive unique levels, you simply won’t put it down!

games.title: Where Are the Puffies?
games.description:
Tiny Puffies. Big hiding places.

Explore 30 cozy, illustrated scenes in this hidden-object game, from leafy gardens to star-filled workshops. Look closely: playful little Puffies are tucked among books, plants and everyday treasures. Tap each one to reveal its color and watch your collection grow.

Meet 10 lovable characters, complete their scenes and collect their portraits in your album. Zoom in, move around the picture and enjoy the search without a countdown. Stuck on one sneaky Puffie? A hint can help you spot it.

A warm, charming seek-and-find adventure for a quick break or one more cozy level. Play with touch or mouse, in portrait or landscape. Available in English and Russian.

games.title: Truck Jam Puzzle
games.description: Untangle a colorful truck traffic jam in this 3D sorting puzzle! Send trucks out in the right order, match them with cargo of the same color, and keep your limited loading slots clear. Discover locked, frozen, hidden, and overheating trucks as the puzzles grow more challenging. Use helpful boosters and aim for three stars on every level.

games.title: Toy Smash
games.description:
Toy Smash is a bright physics knockdown game set in a toy fairground. A tower of tin cans, wooden crates, glass blocks, stone cubes and sticks of dynamite stands on a purple carnival platform, and your cannon is loaded with a limited number of balls. Aim, fire, and watch the whole stack wobble, tip and tumble off the stand.

Every level is a new tower: castles of cans, domino lines, layer cakes of crates, glass gates and mixed piles that fall only when you hit the right support. Clear the stand before the balls run out to open the next level. Along the way you unlock special shots: a heavy ball, a blast that pushes everything away, a triple volley and a piercing shot that goes straight through.

Short rounds, real physics and cheerful plastic toys make it an easy pick-up-and-play game for kids and families, on a computer or a phone.

games.title: Tasty Out Arrow Puzzle
games.description:
Tasty Out! is a satisfying 2D logic puzzle game where your goal is to untangle delicious food-shaped arrow boards before your moves run out! Tap each directional arrow to clear the path, think ahead, and clear the screen step by step.  

KEY FEATURES:
* Deceptively Smart Puzzles: Over 150 handcrafted micro-levels shaped like sushi, burgers, and sweets.
* Move-Efficiency Bonus: Master every layout with minimum steps to earn bonus Gold and Trophies.
* Weekly Competitive League: Climb from Wood to Diamond against simulated player rankings.
* Exclusive Elite Vault: Spend your hard-earned Gold to tackle VIP stages and collect rare Food Badges.
* Endless Replayability: Unlock the infinite League mode once you conquer level 150.  
Can you untangle every delicious recipe and reach the Diamond League? 

Play Tasty Out! now!

games.title: Mini Chess 3D
games.description: Pocket Chess 3D is an addictive 3D tactical puzzle game that transforms classic chess into bite-sized, brain-teasing challenges! Analyze unique board setups, predict enemy moves, and find the winning checkmate in just a few smart moves. With sleek 3D visuals, smooth animations, and hundreds of clever levels, it’s the ultimate chess puzzle experience for both beginners and grandmasters!

games.title: Heist Idle
games.description: Heist Idle puts you in the shoes of a lone thief pulling off daring robberies across the city. Break into banks, museums, jewellery stores, and car showrooms, then dig, crack, and loot your way to valuable items. Sneak past guards, dodge laser tripwires, and stay out of camera sight as you fill your van with stolen goods. Every haul you drop off converts straight into cash, letting you upgrade your gear and pull off bigger, riskier heists. But pull off one job too many and the police will be on your tail — outdrive them in a high-speed getaway or risk losing it all. Simple to pick up, endlessly satisfying to master: plan the perfect heist, grab the loot, and make your escape.

games.title: Freekick Hero
games.description: Freekick Hero is a 3D arcade football game about bending spectacular free kicks past defensive walls and goalkeepers. Aim your shot, choose where to strike the ball, and adapt to changing distances, angles, and wind. Build scoring streaks, upgrade power and curve, and unlock special balls with abilities such as homing shots, wind resistance, and explosive Meteor strikes.

games.title: Delete it: Erase One Part
games.description:
What is hiding in the picture? Find out in this addictive erase puzzle game! At first glance, scenes look normal, but look closer. Swipe your finger to erase one part and uncover hidden secrets. 🔍
Every visual puzzle tells a unique story. Reveal unexpected objects, funny details, or secret endings beneath the surface. The challenge? Figure out exactly what to wipe away. Just one swipe completely transforms the scene! ✨
With simple one-finger controls, it’s easy to play but tricky to master. These logic games will test your IQ and observation skills. Is a clue waiting behind an object? Is the answer in plain sight? 🤔
Features:
🕵️ Find hidden clues & solve mind games.
🎨 Uncover hidden objects and surprising details.
👆 Simple swipe controls for instant fun.
🧩 Unique brain teasers to challenge your logic.
If you love hidden object games and tricky picture puzzles, this relaxing brain training challenge will definitely keep you guessing. Examine carefully and reveal the truth today! 🚀

games.title: Cut it : Voxel Crusher
games.description:
Step into the ultimate demolition workshop! In Voxel Crusher, you take control of a high-tech robotic arm equipped with a spinning chainsaw. Swipe to guide the saw and grind down structures built from hundreds of colorful voxels. Watch them crumble, explode, and disintegrate in a super-satisfying physical way!
But watch your fuel tank! Moving the heavy saw consumes energy. Gather coins from crushed voxels and spend them in the shop to upgrade your fuel capacity and extend your arm's reach. Crush everything from simple shapes to complex figures, complete challenging levels, and unlock the ultimate satisfaction of total voxel destruction.
Features:
Satisfying Voxel Destruction: Grind and crush structures block-by-block with realistic crumbling physics.
Interactive Robot Arm Controls: Simple drag-and-swipe controls to guide your robotic saw.
Strategic Upgrades: Upgrade your robot's fuel tank size and arm range to crush larger models.
ASMR Gameplay Experience: Relaxing sound effects and satisfying visual feedback.
Progression & Variety: Grind through a wide array of creative voxel shapes and levels.

games.title: Cheat and Don't Get Caught!
games.description: Sneak a look at your phone, find the answers and finish your schoolwork before the bell. Watch the teacher, keep suspicion low and choose upgrades to survive more school days.

games.title: Italian Brainrot Merge
games.description: Merge the Rot is an idle merge game packed with quirky brainrot characters. Combine identical characters to discover stronger forms, earn coins, and progress through colorful animated challenges. Build your brainrot collection and enjoy matching and digging mini-games for extra rewards!

games.title: Hill Ride 3D
games.description:
A bright arcade racing game with 3D physics where speed alone is not enough. Keep your balance, control your landings, and overcome dangerous sections filled with hills, ramps, bridges, steep drops, and tricky obstacles. Perform stunts, collect coins, and unlock new opportunities as you progress.
The game features different characters, vehicles, and maps with unique atmospheres: green hills, desert roads, snowy tracks, and night routes. Earn coins to upgrade your engine, suspension, grip, and fuel tank, and buy useful bonuses to handle harder challenges.
The farther you go, the faster and more dangerous the ride becomes. Master the vehicle physics, improve your timing, and beat your own distance records in every run.

games.title: Memorya
games.description: Memorya is a relaxing memory game. Memorize the position of the cards and find matching pairs, trying to make as few mistakes as possible. Unlock new levels and improve your scores.

games.title: Turnline: Relaxing Puzzle
games.description:
Turnline: Relaxing Puzzle is a calm minimalist puzzle about connecting lines.

Tap the tiles to rotate them and find the correct position for every part of the network. Once all required paths are connected, the puzzle is complete.

The first levels are simple and introduce the rules naturally. Later puzzles become larger and more challenging, with branches, multiple paths and increasingly intricate layouts.

There is no timer, so you can think and solve each puzzle at your own pace.

• Thousands of levels
• Gradually increasing difficulty
• Clean and relaxing visuals
• Hints for difficult puzzles
• Progress saving
• Great for both quick and longer sessions

games.title: Fruit Lane Cafe
games.description: Fruit Lane Cafe is a colorful card-sorting puzzle game with a busy shop twist. Slide cards through lanes, line up matching sets, and complete your customers' orders before time runs out. Plan around the next card, manage the spare card, and unlock helpful boosters as the challenges grow. Simple tap controls, satisfying chain reactions, and a growing level map make every order a fresh puzzle.

games.title: Equal Cut
games.description:
Equal Cut is a one-swipe balancing puzzle: cut each piece of food into two exactly equal halves, then watch the scale prove how close you got. There's no timer and no live weight readout while you aim — just the shape in front of you and your own eye for where it balances.

25 foods, each an odd or irregular shape that hides its true balance point: a lopsided pretzel, a corn cob, a wedge of cheese, a whole pumpkin slice. Land a clean, even cut for up to three stars; miss and you get another attempt — there's always a free way to keep playing, never a wall.

games.title: Arrows: Make It Cozy!
games.description:
Colorful arrows are tangled up on the board — help them find a way out! ➡️ 

Tap on arrows to send them sliding off the grid, but be careful: collisions cost lives, and the clock is ticking. ⏱️ Every level is a puzzle where sequence and speed matter. 🧩

Game features:
— 🎮 Over 850 levels of increasing difficulty — never a dull moment.
— 🔥 Combo system: send arrows off in a row without mistakes, score points, and climb the leaderboard.
— 💡 Two boosters: a hint for one arrow's path or a full map of all arrow paths on the level.
— 🏠 Decorate your space: earn stars for completed levels and buy furniture for your room collection.
— 🏆 Leaderboard — compete with players for the best combo score.

Solve puzzles, chain combos, furnish rooms, and become the ultimate arrow master! ✨

games.title: Ruthless! Merciless Cards
games.description:
RUTHLESS! is an online multiplayer card game from the crazy eights family — with a mean streak. Empty your hand to win, or be the last one standing: every penalty makes you draw, and whoever reaches 25 cards is eliminated.

What makes it different are three rules of its own. RUNS let you drop a whole sequence of consecutive numbers in the same colour in one turn — the last card rules, so a good run changes the colour, lands a penalty and empties half your hand at once. COLD BLOOD is one token per match that freezes the penalty coming at you and doubles the next one you deal. DOUBLE! raises the XP at stake when you feel ahead, and your rivals can fold before it lands on them.

Play against real people online, with bots that have personality when nobody is around. Classic, a daily table that changes for everyone, ranked Arena with leagues, 2 vs 2, three-round tournaments and private rooms. 168-card deck, five languages, free.

games.title: Merge Mania
games.description: Zap those numbers by pitting them against one another! Let's see how much you score in this race against time!

games.title: Pistonio
games.description: A cozy 3D puzzle about pistons. Tap a piston and it fires, shoving whatever stands in front of it — your job is to push the golden cube onto the goal plate in as few moves as you can. Sticky pistons pull blocks back, pressure plates open gates, conveyors shift everything after each move. 84 handcrafted levels across five planets, plus a fresh puzzle every day. Clear a level and you earn a chest, and inside the chests live musicians: seat twelve of them on an island and it plays a whole song of its own.

games.title: Game Mania
games.description: It's 3 AM at a lakeside cabin. The power's out, the Wi-Fi's down, and you can't sleep — so you scribble strange ideas in a spiral notebook, and each becomes a frantic five-second doodle game. Plug a thrashing router cable, swat mosquitoes, go Super Saiyan, stomp bugs, tune a TV antenna through the static, and more. Survive a night of escalating micro-games and a boss on three hearts, until the morning sun rises. It's all hand-drawn ballpoint on paper.

games.title: Bus n Ball Jam
games.description: Bus n Ball Jam is a fun and engaging color puzzle game where every bus, every ball, and every drop counts!

games.title: Nine to Wonderland
games.description:
Nine to Wonderland is a head-to-head card duel RPG where a standard deck becomes a weapon. Every card you lay down hits: number cards strike or heal, face cards burn the mana right out of your rival's pool. Play them one at a time, or chain a pair, a flush, a run — the bigger the hand, the harder it lands, and jokers slot themselves into your strongest combination.

Mana is the whole game. Small cards mint the most of it, so you are always choosing between a big hit now and the fuel for a bigger one later. Spend it on Blade to sharpen a strike, Shield to soak one, and Swap to trade up to three cards out of your hand.

Your hero is the other half of the deck. Every portrait is a card you own, with its own trump suits, a favourite poker hand and one ULT charged by the cards you play — Strike, Poison, Mend, Bloom, Cleanse, Shackles or Thorns. Collect duplicates to star a hero up and open every duel with a fuller mana bank.

Play a quick match against the computer, pass the device for a local duel, or challenge a real opponent online. Take the long road through Adventures, where each chapter is a board-game maze of fights, chests, traps and mini-games leading to a boss; climb the endless Gauntlet; or take the daily challenge, where both sides get the same freshly-rolled epic set — no gear, no excuses.

games.title: Clash of Armour
games.description: Clash of Armour is real time strategy tank game. Objective is to destroy the opponent defense by deploying the armored units . Each unit has its own weakness and strength, selecting the right units at appropriate time is best way to win the battle. Good Luck

games.title: SnakeArmyDefense
games.description: Snake Army Defense is a colorful 3D tower defense game where squads of soldiers face giant, winding snakes. Place fighters around the battlefield, combine different weapons and support units, and protect your base through successive enemy waves. Earn coins to unlock and upgrade your army, then tackle tougher levels across varied environments. Tactical placement, a growing roster, and segmented snake enemies give every defense a different challenge.

games.title: Classic Number Puzzle
games.description: 🧩 Number Puzzle – Classic Number Slide Puzzle is a classic math-based puzzle game that challenges your brain and keeps your mind sharp. Tap the empty space to slide the numbers into the correct order. Easy to learn, yet hard to master!

games.title: Swarm Siege
games.description: Aim, fire, survive — defend your castle from endless bug swarms and giant bosses in this intense arcade shooter. Face off against massive waves of unique insects, unlock powerful upgrades for your defenses, and test your skills against epic giant bosses. How long can your castle hold out against the ultimate swarm siege?

games.title: Arrow Free 3D
games.description:
Welcome to Arrow Free 3D!
Ready to challenge your brain? Arrow Free 3D is a satisfying 3D logic puzzle game where simplicity meets deep strategy. Immerse yourself in a quiet, beautiful world designed to test your mental agility, spatial awareness, and concentration.

games.title: Bridge Bounce: Jump Challenge
games.description:
Bridge Bounce: Jump Challenge is a fast-paced arcade runner where every jump counts. Bounce across a high bridge, flip through gates, dodge barriers, and leap over dangerous gaps above the water. Collect coins, keep your momentum, and see how far you can go without falling.
Easy to play, challenging to master — one mistake can end your run!

games.title: Vials: ASMR Sand Sort Puzzle
games.description: A quiet ASMR sand-sorting puzzle. Pour coloured sand between hourglass-shaped vessels until each one holds a single colour. No timers, no fail state, no pressure — the pleasure is the pour itself: a hand-tuned animation and layered sand audio. 1000 levels with a difficulty curve calibrated by an offline solver, so it stays gentle for a long time and then quietly gets interesting. Live on the App Store and Google Play.

games.title: Not Your Seafood Salad
games.description:
Don't get eaten.
You've had enough of the food chain and are rebelling against your fate.Using treasures washed ashore, you fend off the ravenous waves.

Your goal is survival. As you evolve and equip increasingly strange items, you become increasingly powerful. Be smart and use upgrades that are the best fit for your current hero

games.title: Timer Cannon
games.description:
Timer Cannon

Every second on the screen is coming to kill you — and the only way to buy life is to destroy time itself.

🕹️ About the Game

How to Play: Aim, time your blast, and fire. A single precision tap triggers the heavy cannon, launching explosive rounds across the field to obliterate the nearest approaching clock before its hand completes a full rotation. Every clock you destroy clears vital breathing room and adds precious seconds back into your run's master timer. Miss your window, and the ticking swarm closes the gap.

games.title: Sponge Strike: Clean & Smash
games.description: Sponge Strike: Clean & Smash is a satisfying physics puzzle game where every launch brings a hidden picture to life. Pull back, aim, and send your sponge sliding across the board to remove the dark coating underneath it. Bounce off walls, smash colorful block towers, spin up moving obstacles, trigger bombs and buttons, and collect coins along the way. Clear every objective, reveal the full picture, and use your rewards to unlock new sponge skins.

games.title: Bounce Up!
games.description: Bounce Up! is a colorful arcade roguelite inspired by pachinko and peg games. Launch balls, hit pegs, trigger wild combos and unlock powerful upgrades to turn every run into a satisfying cascade of points and coins. Build your own strategy, chase high scores and discover unexpected effects.

games.title: Block Sort Pirate Treasure
games.description:
🏴‍☠️ Ahoy, puzzle mateys! Ready to sort some loot? 💎💰

Welcome to Block Sort Pirate Treasure, a brain-teasing puzzle adventure where your logic is the key to unlocking massive wealth! Your mission is to sort mixed stacks of colorful pirate treasures—like glowing gems, shiny gold coins, and ancient relics—until each stack contains only one type of loot. 🧩

With a staggering 5,000 unique levels 🗺️, the challenges get tougher and the treasure gets shinier as you sail through the campaign! Test your spatial reasoning, plan your moves carefully, and become the ultimate puzzle pirate. ⚓

🌟 Key Features:

💎 Massive Campaign: Sail through 5,000 progressively challenging puzzle levels!

🧠 Brain-Teasing Logic: Train your brain with satisfying sorting mechanics.

⚡ Helpful Boosters: Stuck on a hard level? Use tools to add an extra empty slot or undo your last move!

games.title: Fit in the Wall
games.description: Fit in the Wall challenges you to guide a floating block into the matching slot on moving walls. Using quick reflexes and perfect timing is essential, as each wall offers just one correct fit. Success means survival, but a miss ends the game. Stay alert and keep fitting!

games.title: NumMerge Clash
games.description: A dynamic number puzzle where you connect adjacent cards with matching values. Tap a card to merge it with all neighbors of the same value, increase its worth, and clear space for new cards falling from above. Use energy for tactical moves: swap adjacent cards or remove obstacles. Simple at first glance, this mechanic hides deep strategy: plan your moves, adapt to the shifting board, and chase high scores under limited conditions.

games.title: Oddly Sorted: Color Sort
games.description: Sort colorful blocks into matching boxes and uncover 49 original pixel-art reactions. Plan the front-box order, manage your slots, and clear each portrait. Recommended age: 13+. AI tools assisted code, procedural art and sound, localization, and promotional artwork; no generative AI runs during gameplay.

games.title: Planko
games.description: Planko is a strategy game where you need to make the ball travel from one point to another. By tapping on the targets you can make the planks move by making them fall. Be sure to make sure you make them fall at the right time to ensure you don't miss your chance.

games.title: Wander Wild
games.description:
A fantasy card battler with roguelite progression, where tactical card battles combine with constant camp development and a relic system.

The player assembles card combinations, manages moves, super attacks, and status effects, and between battles develops their character, camp, and relics. Each playthrough gradually unlocks new opportunities for developing a personal playstyle.

games.title: Escape from Wave for Brainrots
games.description:
Welcome to the game "Escape from Wave for Brainrots"! 🌊🧠

A giant tsunami is already coming — and only you can save the Brainrots! Grab them, run away from the wave and get them to the base before it's too late. The faster you act, the more chances you have to save the rarest and most valuable brainrots.

Boost your speed to take the brainrots further and faster.
🧠 Find rare Brainrots — from ordinary to truly legendary.
🏠 Deliver them to the base, expand the collection and become a real savior.

Each new brainroot is a step towards progress, new opportunities and even more action. Test your reaction, strategy and speed — because the tsunami is not waiting!

Can you save all the brainrots and become the main hero of the base?
Run, rescue and collect the rarest ones before the wave catches up with you! 🌊🔥

games.title: Merge Rockets: Obby
games.description:
“Merge Rockets: Obby” is a fast-paced 3D game inspired by 2048, where the rockets you merge can be launched straight at your opponents!

Merge two identical rockets to create a more powerful rocket of the next level. Expand your arsenal, choose a target, and attack other players bases.

Do not let your rivals destroy your rockets: activate your shield at the right moment, block incoming attacks, and strike back. Earn in-game currency by dealing damage, buy upgrades, and become even stronger.

Destroy buildings, sink ships, and turn the entire city into a massive rocket battlefield!

games.title: Weapon Upgrade
games.description: Dive into the action with a dynamic runner where weapon creation meets shooting fun. Shoot enemies and obstacles to unlock powerful weapons and test your accuracy as you take on targets. Craft and combine parts to upgrade your arsenal, evolving from simple guns to advanced firepower. Become a master of weapon creation!

games.title: Domino Battle
games.description: Dominoes are back better than ever. You can choose your preferred style of game where it doesn't matter whether you choose Draw or Block. The level of fun is always the same!

games.title: Obby: Climb and Slide
games.description:
🏔️ Ready to conquer the tallest slides? In this game, you can! 🎢

Climb higher and higher up the ladders, then rush down the thrilling slides! 💨 The farther you slide, the more coins you collect! 💰

And with cute pets by your side, you’ll earn even more — they’ll help you gather coins! 🐱🐢🐰

What awaits you:
• Long ladders and exciting slides for speedy rides 🪜➡️🎢
• Funny pet companions 🐦
• Bright levels and new heights ⛰️
• Fun gameplay and colorful graphics 🎨

Climb up, slide down, and become the ultimate slide champion! 🎮✨


Controls:
Desktop: WASD / Arrow keys - move around the map, Space - jump, click - confirm actions.  
Mobile: virtual joystick - move around the map, tap - confirm actions.

Tips & Tricks:
• Auto climb: allows you to release control of the character for a while.  
• Cup: Don't forget to separately go for the cup and collect it; without this action, climbing will only earn you coins for descending.

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Pets: allow you to earn more coins, depending on the multiplier.  
• Boats: affect the speed of ascent and the number of coins earned during descent.

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• 5 worlds  
• Each world features a slope, a boat shop, and three pet sales stations. The more expensive the unlock for a new world, the more challenging the ascent to the top will be, but the rewards will be greater (more coins, and at the top, you can earn not just 1 cup, but 5, 10, and so on).

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Reach the top of the slope, collect the cup, and enjoy sliding down to repeat the feat. Earn coins, acquire new gear, and enjoy the process.

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?  
A: Simple, understandable gameplay, an easy task, and soothing graphics draw you in from the very first moments of the game.

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: As you progress, new difficulty levels, pet collections, and watercraft become available.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each new tower becomes harder to overcome and requires the character to be more upgraded.

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: You can start with short ascents to upgrade your boat, allowing you to ascend the entire height of the slope more quickly later on.

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?  
A: You can purchase pets (three power levels depending on price) and boats (which affect the character's ascent speed on the ladder).

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?  
A: The onboarding guides the player through all available options on the basic path.

games.title: Skyblock 3D: Survival
games.description: Embark on a unique survival adventure on floating islands in a 3D world, where each island offers valuable resources. Explore vibrant landscapes, battle monsters to grow stronger, and trade with villagers for useful items. Build plantations and breed animals to ensure a steady supply of food and resources. The skies are full of islands, each one holding secrets and challenges. Survive, craft, battle, and thrive in this exciting world!

games.title: The Queen's Jewels
games.description: This is a casual physics-based jewel matching game. There are interesting levels with different mechanics to challenge.

games.title: Sticker Art Book Puzzle
games.description:
Dive into the delightful world of Sticker Art Book Puzzle, where imagination meets puzzle-solving in a fun and engaging experience. This innovative app is the ultimate blend of adult coloring, art games, and brain-teasing challenges. This unique app offers a calming and colorful escape, combining the joy of coloring with the thrill of solving puzzles.

Say goodbye to traditional coloring books and hello to the Sticker Book Puzzle. Instead of using pencils, you'll fill intricate designs with vibrant stickers. It's a fresh take on adult coloring; every sticker is a stroke of creativity. Choose from a rich range of colors and match them with stickers to complete stunning artwork. Relax and unwind with Sticker Book Puzzle's calm gameplay.

Sticker Book Puzzle isn't just a coloring book; it's a brain teaser, too! Solve puzzles by strategically placing stickers to match the patterns and unlock the complete picture. Flex your mind and boost your IQ skills!

games.title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
games.description:
Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home!
This colorful parking puzzle will give you an exciting adventure and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
Get ready for the challenge: sort the cars, find the right solutions and free up parking spaces. Each car and bus has a limited number of spaces, so plan your moves in advance to unravel this chaotic traffic jam!

Game features:
🚌 Simple gameplay: Move buses and cars, sort them by color and free up the parking lot.
🎮 Challenging puzzles: Levels of varying difficulty are suitable for all ages and experience levels.
🎨 Bright design: Colorful levels will help you relax and enjoy the process.

games.title: Poison Candy: Obby 1 Or 2-Player
games.description:
"Poison Candy: Obby 1 Or 2-Player" – an exciting obby game where you have to outsmart your friend! Can you make your opponent eat the poisonous candy that you chose?  

🎭 Game Features:  
✅ Detective obby – become a real detective in the world of obby and parkour games! 
✅ Two game modes – play with a friend on one device or compete with a random opponent! 
✅ Strategy and bluffing – skip turns to confuse your opponent and lead them to the poisoned candy! 
✅ Bright graphics – colorful world in the style of your favorite obby games!  

🍭 How to play?  
Choose a poisonous candy 
Use clever maneuvers to make your opponent eat it 
Become the king of the party! 
Try the sweetest and most dangerous obby adventure! 
Can you outplay your friend and survive?

games.title: Sudoku
games.description:
The playing field is a grid with 9x9 cells, divided into smaller grids with a side of 3 cells. Thus, the entire playing field consists of 81 cells. At the beginning of the game, there are already some numbers in them (from 1 to 9). The player is required to fill in the free cells with numbers from 1 to 9 so that in each row, in each column and in each small 3 ×3 square, each digit would occur only once.
There are multiple levels of difficulty you can choose. Beware of mistakes you can make.

games.title: Bubble Word Jam
games.description:
Pop word bubbles, sort them into categories, and relax while you train your brain. Word Bubble Sort is a satisfying word puzzle with one simple goal: tap the bubbles, spot the hidden theme, and sort every word to clear the board. 

HOW TO PLAY 
- Tap the bubbles 
- Find the hidden category 
- Sort each word into its group to win 
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT 
- Thousands of handcrafted levels 
- Satisfying bubble pop controls 
- A relaxing brain workout, no time limit - Plays offline, no wifi needed 
- Free to play Two minutes or two hours, every level is a fresh challenge for your brain.

Ready to pop, sort, and clear them all? Start popping now!

games.title: Pregnant Mom Simulator Family Life
games.description:
Experience the journey of motherhood and family life in Pregnant Mom Simulator Family Life! Play as a virtual mom and manage daily household activities, family responsibilities, pregnancy tasks, and baby care missions. Complete exciting levels and experience different stages of family life through realistic and engaging gameplay.
Choose from three unique modes: Pregnancy, Baby Care, and Life Without Him. In Pregnancy Mode, experience the daily routine of a pregnant mom, prepare meals, manage household tasks, attend hospital checkups, and complete pregnancy-related missions. In Baby Care Mode, take care of your newborn, complete baby care activities, manage daily routines, and keep your little one happy and comfortable. In Life Without Him Mode, take on new challenges and experience the responsibilities of managing family life independently.
Features

3 exciting modes: Pregnancy, Baby Care, and Life Without Him.
-Experience different stages of pregnancy and family life.
-Complete pregnancy checkups and hospital missions.
-Take care of your newborn with engaging baby care activities.
-Cook meals, clean the house, shop for groceries, and complete daily chores.
-Complete family and household missions across multiple levels.
-Experience realistic 3D environments and family activities.
-Smooth and easy controls with engaging animations.
-Different challenges and tasks that increase as you progress.

Experience the challenges, responsibilities, and memorable moments of motherhood in Pregnant Mom Simulator Family Life. Complete your daily tasks, care for your family and baby, and explore all three modes in this engaging family life simulator.

games.title: Bus Parking Out
games.description: Logic meets strategy! Operate 3 types of buses in 8 vibrant colors, each requiring careful planning. Enjoy a stunning 3D environment, as you clear the way for the selected bus and collect passengers. Master the art of optimal movement.

games.title: Ellie Summer Spa Beauty Salon
games.description: Ellie Summer Spa: a soothing shore where beauty and joy are yours to explore! With gentle care, her glow will bloom. Play to find a sweet escape in a sunlit room!

games.title: Home Design: Decorate House
games.description:
Welcome to renovation game, where all your dreams come true! Renovate and decorate your home and solve challenging puzzles with this relaxing match 3 design game!

If you ever dreamed of having a mansion of your own, now’s your chance in this redecor game! Move into your mansion with tons of rooms, gardens, swimming pools, playgrounds, and decorating this house! Everything you can imagine you’d find in a house decor we got it here!

Home Design: Decorate House is not just a home decoration and matching game:
•A combination of match 3 game puzzles plus home decorating gameplay brings you an overwhelming fun gaming experience!
•Design, decorate, unlock new rooms, plenty of house areas to renovate, never get bored!
•All mansion makeover needs is a brilliant mind of a talented designer like you!

Decorate the library, kitchen, garden, tennis court, swimming pool and many more house areas to come! Help her renovate dream house to make it the best manor in town in this puzzle game!

games.title: Hexa Master 3D: Sort Puzzle
games.description:
Each stage introduces new difficulties where you strive to attain precise color arrangements. This equilibrium of exhilaration and tranquility renders Hexa Master 3D: Sort Puzzle ideal for those who relish a captivating brain teaser with a soothing element.

Key attributes:
— User-friendly and calming gameplay that's ideal for unwinding;
— Intricate puzzles that keep your brain agile;
— Stunning 3D visuals featuring lively colors and gradients breathe life into each hexagon;
— Helpful tools and power-ups to conquer challenging levels effortlessly;
— Soothing ASMR effects heighten relaxation, making every tap and match a delight.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?
A: HEX is a game where you need to collect hexes and then build gardens.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game offers an interesting metagameplay with garden building.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Currencies can be spent on garden upgrades and visual customizations.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can upgrade gardens and change the board's appearance.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to return?
A: Yes, there are daily rewards for logging in.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or can the game be played without sound without affecting the gameplay?
A: Playing without music is possible, but the sound effects are pleasant and fitting. The music sets the vibe.

games.title: Merge World
games.description: Immerse yourself in a world you can mold to your desires. Merge different materials and construct bigger buildings to fill it out. The good fairies will help you build a paradise!

games.title: Mahjong 3
games.description:
Embark on a fairytale adventure!
This unique puzzle game combines the best mechanics of match-3 and mahjong. You'll be faced with a game board filled with tiles. Your goal is to clear them all! Use various boosters to complete levels and earn coins!

games.title: Robby: Double jump for brainrots
games.description:
Robby: Double Jump for Brainrots is a fun jumping game 🚀

Jump higher, go further and collect as many brainrots as you can.

Improve your jump and speed⚡
It helps to get to new areas. 🌌

Caution! If you fall, you'll have to start over.

games.title: Crosswords: Big Collection
games.description:
Crosswords: Big Collection is a classic crossword game for anyone who loves to think. You get over 800 levels with more than 30,000 unique clues, a daily crossword that refreshes every day, and a collectible items system with quests and rewards.

The game is translated into six languages: Russian, English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian. Choose your theme — soft green or dark brown — to match your mood. The interface adapts to any screen: play on PC or smartphone with the same comfort and clarity.

Progress saves automatically. Every solved word earns you points that push you up the leaderboard. Come back to unfinished puzzles, unlock collection items, and compete with players worldwide.

games.title: Idle Airport Tycoon
games.description: Idle Airport Tycoon is a casual simulation game that puts you in charge of building and managing your very own bustling airport. Start with a humble airstrip and turn it into a world-class travel hub—move over Atlanta airport; we're looking to be the busiest airport in the world now! Upgrade everything from planes to terminals, unlock new revenue streams, and watch your profits soar! Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the ultimate airport tycoon?

games.title: Break Stick Completely
games.description: Dive into the quirky realm of Break Stick Completely, where you unleash mayhem with a stick figure. Use vehicles and obstacles to create comical chaos and rack up points through fun stunts. Accessible on phone and computer, this free game promises endless laughter and enjoyment.

games.title: Wood Blocks Jam
games.description:
Wood Blocks Jam is a relaxing logic puzzle game with colorful wooden blocks. Your goal is to drag each block into a gate of the same color. No time limits — just calm, thoughtful gameplay.

Enjoy thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty and new mechanics to discover. Use powerful boosters to help you solve tough puzzles:
🔧 Saw – cuts through annoying blocks,
🔨 Hammer – smashes any single block,
✨ Magic – removes 3 random blocks.

Perfect for players of all ages, Wood Blocks Jam combines strategy, color-matching, and satisfying visuals in one cozy package.

games.title: Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat
games.description: Ever wanted to experience life as a mischievous cat? In Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat, you take on the role of a playful yet naughty kitty, causing absolute mayhem inside Grandma’s house—all from a first-person perspective! This exciting 3D simulation game lets you see through the eyes of a troublemaking feline as you knock over furniture, scratch walls, and do everything in your power to drive Grandma crazy! Are you ready to embrace the chaos? 😼

games.title: Millionaire Life
games.description: After a rough start, you've hit the jackpot, won the lottery and now go wild! Live out your wildest RICH dreams! Indulge in lavish spending, fulfill your biggest dreams, and embrace a life of over-the-top luxury with no regrets.

games.title: Blackriver Mystery. Hidden Objects
Block Blast Master
games.description:
Game Block Blast Master, where every move counts and strategy and speed are the keys to success. In this exciting game your task is not just to collect and destroy blocks, but to do it with intelligence and ingenuity to gain maximum points and overcome difficult obstacles on your way.

Your main goal is to score as many points as possible by removing blocks and creating combinations. Be attentive and strategic with every move to set a new record and become a master of the block game!

games.title: Word Associations Solitaire
games.description:
Word Associations Solitaire is a relaxing card puzzle. Match words by associations, unlock themes, and train your brain at your own pace.

Word Associations Solitaire is a calm and clever puzzle game that blends classic solitaire mechanics with word associations. Match cards by meaning, discover shared themes, and clear the board step by step.

The game offers hundreds of levels with a wide variety of themes such as food, animals, objects, professions, and more. Simple rules make it easy to start, while increasing difficulty keeps the gameplay engaging over time.

Designed for relaxation, the game features a soothing pace, pleasant visuals, and no time limits. Play whenever you want and enjoy a stress-free experience while improving focus, memory, and associative thinking.

Use boosters and special cards to overcome tricky situations, unlock new themes, and feel the satisfaction of bringing order to the board.

games.title: Emerland Solitaire
games.description:
Welcome to the wonderful country of Emerland! 
     Dive deep into the world of magical tale where great mages battle for the Source of the ancient magic of the Cards! Explore mysterious lands accompanied by heroes that include a noble Knight, an Elven Archeress and a mystical Sorceress to defeat the malevolent Dark Master! 
     Solve puzzles and collect combinations to complete difficult and varied levels! Get rewards and find new assistants! 
Use the left mouse button to interact with in-game UI.

games.title: 2 Minute Football QB Legend
games.description: 2 Minute Football QB Legend 27 focuses on the best parts of football - strategy, completing passes and scoring TD's! We make it as easy as possible -- just start passing with a single tap on the screen. There are no complicated control schemes, only pure touchdown bliss! Play live offense and match up against simulated opponents to win your way to the World Championship! Now with Kickoff Return, Field Goals, 2 Point conversions and more!

games.title: Ball Sort Puzzle
games.description: Someone mixed the balls in the flasks! Put things in order and sort the balls so that each flask contains balls of the same color. There are many challenging levels in this puzzle game, ranging from easy to hard!

games.title: Hidden Objects: Home Sweet Home
games.description:
🔎 Immerse yourself in the cozy atmosphere of a relaxed objects search among the charming interiors of houses and beautiful corners of nature.

🏡 "Hidden Objects: Home Sweet Home" game invites you to explore your home, courtyards and natural landscapes without haste, each of which has its own unique atmosphere and unique design.

🧖 Search items and find hidden objects by developing attentiveness and observation. Searching for objects is a leisurely relaxation with pleasant music that is interesting to everyone - this game for girls, for children and adults, for girls and boys, women and men.

games.title: TRAFFIC Rush Online
games.description:
TRAFFIC Rush Online is a dynamic 3D driving game set on the streets of a large city. Change lanes between moving cars, control your speed, and prove that you can make it through heavy traffic without mistakes.

Choose from three game modes. Drive with other players online, explore the city without restrictions in Free Ride, or dodge traffic and earn more gold in Traffic mode. Level up, expand your garage, and customize your car with new colors, wheels, and exterior parts.

Responsive driving physics, multiple camera views, and detailed urban roads make every run exciting. Take calculated risks, choose the right moment to move, and set a new record!

games.title: Geometry Vibes
games.description: Geometry Vibes is a reaction-based arcade game where you avoid obstacles, traps and spikes that come at you in waves. Your goal in the game is to keep your arrow on the route and take it as far as possible. Geometry Vibes, where the excitement never ends, invites you to challenge.

games.title: Collect Brainrot Arena
games.description:
Collect Brainrot Arena is a chaotic multiplayer collecting and stealing game where luck, strategy, and timing are equally important. Enter the arena, gather valuable Lucky Blocks, unlock rare Brainrots, upgrade your collection, and protect your base from rival thieves. Every Lucky Block can contain a surprise, and every opponent is looking for an opportunity to steal your most valuable Brainrots.

In the center of the map, a mysterious portal continuously spawns Lucky Blocks of different rarities. Players can purchase these blocks, carry them back to their base, and open them to discover one of the 86 unique Brainrots available in the game. The rarer the Lucky Block, the greater the chance of obtaining legendary and highly profitable Brainrots.

games.title: Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor
games.description: Kiki World is a home design game where you transform cluttered rooms into stylish living spaces. By cleaning, removing old items, and arranging chic furniture, you’ll bring empty areas to life with your personal touch. Perfect for design enthusiasts, it challenges your creativity as you decorate, makeover, and create the dream home you’ve always imagined.

games.title: Idle Game Dev Simulator
games.description:
Become the Ultimate Game Developer!
Start from a small garage and build your way up to a legendary game studio in Idle Game Dev Simulator — the ultimate idle tycoon for every gamer and creator at heart!

Create hit games, upgrade your studio, hire the best talent, and research cutting-edge technologies to dominate the gaming industry. Every tap brings you closer to success… or another flop.

CREATE. INNOVATE. DOMINATE.
Mix genres, choose themes, and pick the perfect platform to craft the next big hit. Strategy, arcade, or adventure — your creativity is the key to success. Analyze reviews, track ratings, and evolve your studio to become a true legend of game development.

UPGRADE YOUR STUDIO. GROW YOUR EMPIRE.
From a dusty laptop in your garage to a sleek high-tech office buzzing with talent — unlock new rooms, features, and upgrades. Automate production, research advanced mechanics, and push your limits to the top of the charts!

games.title: Cozy Coloring
games.description:
Discover a world of vibrant colors and calm creativity with our color-by-number game. Choose beautiful pictures, find the right colors, and fill in each image step by step. It’s a simple and enjoyable way to relax, take your mind off daily worries, and build your own collection of colorful artworks.

The game offers pictures for every mood and age: cute images for kids, beautiful illustrations for adults, animals, flowers, nature, food, patterns, mandalas, and much more. Each coloring page is divided into numbered areas — simply choose a color and tap the matching sections.

The game is perfect for a short break, relaxing after school or work, a peaceful evening, or family time. You don’t need any drawing skills — everyone can create a beautiful finished picture.

There is also a creative mode where you can color each image in your own style!

Color by number, create beautiful images, and enjoy calm creativity anytime.

games.title: BMG: Ragdoll Car Race
games.description:
"BMG: Ragdoll Car Race" is a crash test simulator with plenty of destruction and obstacles that will easily destroy your car.
Immerse yourself in the crazy world of ragdoll racing, where physics is the main source of fun and unexpected situations. A huge open world awaits you, filled with diverse locations, hidden routes, and challenges that will test not only your speed but also your driving skills. Complete unique levels with varying conditions—from extreme tracks to complex stunt zones—where every collision turns into a spectacular show thanks to a realistic destruction system.

games.title: Imposter 3D online horror
games.description:
Save all the mini-crewmates from the traitor in single player or online. 

Play online with other players, or with friends by creating your own room! 
 
The horror game "Imposter 3D online horror" features 7 online multiplayer game modes and 8 unique maps!  
 
"Mafia" - up to 10 players, including an impostor who looks like the other players. But at any moment he can turn into an imposter and catch the other players! Use a vote to identify the imposter and shout "Impostor among us!". Be careful and collect all the little ones. 
"PvE" - play with friends against an imposter controlled by the computer. 
"PvP" - spacemen against imposter, players play for impostors. 
"Zombie" - Infection mode, who has been caught by the imposter, he also becomes an impostor.  
"Hide and Seek" - In this mode, you have to hide, playing as an astronaut, and hold out until the end of the round. Collecting babies in this mode is optional!
"Hunt" - collect most babies in time!
"Rescue" - Imposters can get astronauts in a cage!
"Lava" - Lava rises periodically! Complete objectives and escape to high ground while imps hunt the astronauts.

games.title: Animal Hair Salon
games.description: Enter the enchanting realm of Animal Hair Salon, where you unleash your creativity as a stylist for adorable animals. Enjoy this free online game and utilize various tools to design, cut, and color unique hairstyles while adding charming accessories. Get ready to work your magic!

games.title: Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D
games.description:
Lead your own burger adventure!

Dive into the exciting world of restaurant management, where you will cook delicious dishes, expand your business and delight customers in this exciting simulation game.

From frying juicy burgers to managing staff, every decision you make is important on the way to creating a real culinary empire!

🔑 Key features:
🍔 Cook and serve: Create a variety of burgers, crispy fries, juicy nuggets, refreshing drinks and aromatic coffee.

💰 Burger tycoon: Manage finances, upgrade equipment and hire employees.
✨ Expand and decorate: Use profits to create a unique interior.
🚀 Develop a network: Open new branches with car services!
⏰ New horizons: Launch a trendy cafe or food truck!

games.title: Obby: Mini-Games
games.description:
Obby: Mini-Games - play against other players and win Cups! Triumph in each mode and stand on the golden winner's pedestal!

🔴 MODES 🔴

🚀 PARKOUR 🚀
Complete colorful levels on the parkour map and reach the end!

🎯 COLORFUL FLOOR 🎯
In this mode, you need to step on tiles whose color is displayed at the top of the screen.

🎯 GLASS BRIDGE 🎯
And in this mode, you need to choose which glass tile to jump on, but one will break, and the other will remain intact.

🎯 FALLING TILES 🎯
In this mode, you have to run across tiles, but there's a condition: the tiles you've already run on will fall down and disappear after a second. So, be careful.

☀️ RAIN OF BLOCKS ☀️
This mode will unlock as you progress through the game!

games.title: Cat and Granny
games.description:
Cat and Granny is a chaotic first-person action game where you play as a clever orange cat outsmarting the new black cat Granny brought home! Cause mischief by knocking over flower pots, scattering objects, and scratching furniture all while making Granny think the black cat is to blame.

Sneak around Granny’s house, explore destructible environments, and set up perfect pranks. Knock over lamps, plants, and chandeliers when the black cat is nearby so Granny blames him instead of you.

Hide in boxes if Granny gets too close, or risk a stern scolding! Outsmart your feline rival, create hilarious chaos, and reclaim your spot as Granny’s favorite.

Fun, simple, and addictive Cat and Granny lets you unleash your inner troublemaker!

games.title: Mystery of the Old House: Hidden Objects
games.description:
Every corner holds a secret, and every find brings you closer to the solution.

Explore old rooms full of antiques and forgotten things. Find the hidden objects and uncover all the secrets

games.title: Screw Match
games.description: Screw Match - Nuts and Bolts. Your task is to put screws of different colors on the glass nut to the box on the top with the same color as the screws. If the nut holes on the box are full, you will be replaced by a new box.

games.title: Sorter: Ragdoll Playground Shooter
games.description:
Anti-stress ragdoll shooter: guns, explosions, physics, familiar characters, detailed damage system, lots of weapons and simple gameplay.

“Sorter: Ragdoll Playground Shooter” is a fast-paced action game with advanced physics and countless ways to eliminate ragdoll enemies. Each opponent behaves like a real doll with full ragdoll animation, reacting to shots and explosions with dynamic, expressive movement.
Expect familiar characters, recognizable locations, and simple yet addictive gameplay. Use a huge arsenal of weapons — pistols, rifles, shotguns, SMGs, launchers and more — to clear levels and unlock new challenges.
Perfect for players who enjoy physics-based interactions, satisfying shooting and a relaxing anti-stress experience. Become the best mercenary and prove your precision, reaction and skill on every level!

games.title: Drive Quest

games.title: Eat Blobs Simulator
games.description:
Enter the Colorful Blob Arena
Eat Blobs Simulator is a competitive growing game where tiny slimes can become enormous arena champions. Choose your favorite blob, enter a nickname, and begin collecting the colorful slime pieces spread across the map. Every piece you eat increases your size and brings you closer to the top of the arena.

Growing also changes which opponents you can challenge. Smaller blobs become valuable targets, but larger players can end your run if you get too close. Watch the sizes around you, choose safe routes, and wait until you are strong enough before beginning the hunt.

Eat, Grow, and Take Control
The main objective is to become the biggest blob in the arena. Start by collecting the small pieces around the map, then chase opponents who are smaller than you. Eating another slime can provide a major growth boost and quickly improve your position.

Do not focus only on nearby targets. A larger opponent may be approaching from behind, and chasing one small blob too far can lead you into danger. Camera control and map awareness are important, especially once the arena becomes crowded.

Unlock New Blob Skins
Earn coins and rewards while playing, then use them to unlock different blob appearances. New skins let you enter future matches with a fresh look while continuing to improve your performance.

Your rewards depend on the size you reach, the coins you collect, and how well you perform during each round. Even a short run can help you build toward another skin or give you a better start in the next match.

Play Solo or With a Friend
Eat Blobs Simulator supports single-player and local two-player gameplay. Solo mode gives you full camera and zoom control as you explore the arena and compete against other blobs.

In two-player mode, you can share the same device with a friend. Collect slime pieces, grow faster than the other player, and decide whether to explore separate parts of the arena or compete for the same targets. The simple controls make it easy to begin, but becoming the largest blob still requires smart movement.

How to Play
Move around the arena and eat the small slime pieces to grow. Once you are larger than another blob, chase and consume it for a bigger reward. Stay away from opponents that are larger than you, because they can eat your character.

Keep collecting until you become one of the strongest blobs in the arena.

Helpful Tips
Collect nearby slime pieces before challenging other players.
Compare sizes carefully before beginning a chase.
Keep moving so larger blobs cannot trap you.
Use open areas when you need to escape.
Avoid following a target without checking what is behind you.
In two-player mode, do not let the other player take every safe group of slimes.

Main Features
Colorful eating-and-growing arena gameplay
Single-player and local two-player modes
Smaller blobs to hunt and larger opponents to avoid
Coins, performance rewards, and unlockable skins
Simple keyboard and mouse controls
Mobile and tablet joystick support
Quick matches with increasing competition
Easy-to-learn rules with strategic movement
Eat Blobs Simulator turns a simple growing idea into a lively arena battle. Collect, grow, unlock new looks, and prove that your slime can become the king of the blob arena.

games.title: Basket Random
games.description:
Basket Random is a chaotic arcade basketball game where every match turns into a funny test of timing, luck, and unpredictable physics. Instead of giving players a serious sports simulation, it focuses on quick rounds, simple controls, and hilarious ragdoll movement. You control your team with one key, jump toward the ball, block your opponent, and try to score before the other side reaches the winning point. The idea is easy to understand, but the random physics make every attempt feel different.

What makes Basket Random stand out is the way it changes after almost every score. One round may take place on a normal court, while the next may throw you into a completely different setup with unusual players, strange body proportions, or a ball that behaves in an unexpected way. Sometimes the characters have long arms, sometimes their movement feels heavier, and sometimes the ball bounces in a way that makes even a simple shot difficult to predict. This constant variety keeps the game fresh without making it complicated.

The controls are intentionally simple, which makes the game accessible for almost anyone. In single-player mode, you can play against the CPU and practice your timing. In 2-player mode, the game becomes even more entertaining because both players share the same device and compete in fast, messy basketball duels. Since both sides are dealing with the same strange physics, every point feels like a mix of skill, reaction, and comedy.

Basket Random is especially enjoyable for players who like short sports games with instant action. You do not need to learn complex moves, manage a team, or follow advanced basketball rules. The goal is clear: jump, reach the ball, defend your basket, and score. However, the challenge comes from reading the movement of your characters and adapting quickly when the game changes the court, the players, or the ball behavior.

The pixel-style visuals give the game a clean and playful look, while the ragdoll animation creates many unexpected moments. A missed jump can turn into a lucky block. A bad shot can bounce into the basket. A perfect attack can fail because your player lands in the wrong position. These small surprises are the reason Basket Random feels fun even after many rounds.

For fans of funny basketball games, local 2-player games, and physics-based sports challenges, Basket Random offers a simple but highly replayable experience. It is easy to start, fast to understand, and unpredictable enough to keep every match exciting. Whether you are playing alone or challenging a friend, each round brings a new chance to score a ridiculous basket, make a surprising comeback, or laugh at a completely unexpected play.

Game Features: 🎼 Unlimited musical possibilities: Discover hundreds of sound combinations that are perfect for you.  🧩 Complete creative freedom: Play your way—no restrictions, just mix and experiment.  🌟 Find the best combinations: Choose the ideal rhythms and melodies to craft your unique musical style.  🎧 Engaging and relaxing: Perfect for laid-back gameplay and inspiring musical experimentation.  In Sprunki Incredibox Original, everything is simple and fun: drag characters, mix rhythms, and create tracks with no limits. games.title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
games.description:
Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

Controls:
Desktop: click  
Mobile: tap  

Power-ups / Abilities:  
• Clean: Clear all waiting holes to free up space.  
• Unlock the box: Add an extra box with spools for faster level completion.  

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: If you struggle between a desire for destruction and a craving for comfort, this game is for you. Unravel knitted shapes layer by layer, filling spools of specific colors. A pleasant casual puzzle for stress relief.  

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?  
A: From the very first moments, the desire to solve the puzzle at once captivates, along with pleasant graphics and simple gameplay. A contemplative game where it's easy to get lost for a long time.  

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: If you manage to distribute all the threads onto the spools without using the spare slots for them, you win. However, if you run out of free slots and the toys are not fully unraveled, unfortunately, you'll have to restart the level.  

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: With each new level, the shapes become more complex, there are more colors, and the elements become trickier. You need to devise a strategy for interacting with the spools and accurately identify shades to avoid filling free slots for spools unnecessarily.  

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: Sound adds a grounding effect to the calm visuals. It is not essential for the flow of the game.

🧠 Key Features:
Challenging & Rewarding Puzzles: Test your logical thinking as you sort threads and complete intricate puzzles.
Boosters to Help You Progress: Get support from helpful tools like New Hole, Magic Box and Broom 🧹 when you face tough levels.
Customization Options: Tailor the game to your liking by adding extra boxes and slots for a personalized experience.
Beautiful Graphics: Relaxing and calming visuals of colorful threads and knitted objects that add to the fun.
🧘‍♀️ Why You’ll Enjoy It:
Perfect blend of relaxation and mental challenge to keep you engaged.
Easy-to-learn gameplay that becomes progressively more challenging.
Ideal for quick play sessions or long, relaxing gameplay.- Great for puzzle lovers who enjoy sorting games and testing their brain.
🧶 Ready to Unravel the Fun?
Play Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle and dive into this soothing yet challenging world of colorful threads and exciting puzzles. Start organizing, sorting, and unlocking the joy of unraveling these fun puzzles while listening to some good music!

games.title: Wild Love
games.description:
An adventure awaits you on a mysterious island where the heroine is in danger at every turn. Make the right decisions, try to guess who is a friend and who is an enemy.

Unravel the mystery of the island! Your heart will tell you!

Match your heroine's looks to your liking and go adventurous!

games.title: Epic Sword Battle! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena!
games.description:

Here you can cut enemies, dodge blows and prove your superiority in a sword fight! Use agility and reaction to become the hero of the arena!

games.title: Favorite Puzzles

Meet Favorite Puzzles, your new favorite jigsaw puzzles! This addictive puzzle game will delight you with an endless gallery of beautiful images for every taste! Then turn on the Realistic mode and solve jigsaw puzzles from pieces scattered across the field! And you can also create a puzzle from your own picture or photo! Features:

- Customizable interface and background color
