games.title: My Castle. Merge & Story
games.description:
My Castle: Merge & Story is a relaxing merge 2 puzzle game set in a warm and atmospheric medieval world of renewal, mystery, and self-discovery. Merge items, restore and decorate an ancient castle, and follow the journey of a young princess who chooses a new path in life.

This calm offline merge adventure combines cozy gameplay, castle restoration, and a story about starting over — far from royal expectations, closer to one’s true self.

Restore and Decorate a Forgotten Castle

The story begins when a young princess leaves her father’s royal court and travels to a remote medieval castle once owned by her grandfather. The reasons behind her escape remain a mystery — and uncovering it is part of the journey.

The castle has stood empty for years. Time has worn it down, but its spirit remains.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?
A: The goal is to restore a huge castle. It is a merge game with Homescape mechanics.

A: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: Yes, the storyline is extensive and interesting.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?
A: Strong storyline and interesting tasks.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You need to merge items and help the castle's inhabitants.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Special stars are spent on castle repairs and progressing through the storyline, crystals help restore energy.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?
A: Yes, you can buy crystals, special items, and speed up progression. Donations greatly simplify the game.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Not exactly, but the game has a strong storyline and captivating story.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Players focus on improving the castle.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to encourage players to come back?
A: Yes, there is a mandatory daily reward.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse yourself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?
A: The game has pleasant sound, but it is not essential for gameplay.

Q: Are there achievement systems? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Yes, for leveling up the castle and progressing through the storyline.

games.title: Car Smash Simulator: Crash & Tune
games.description:
Welcome to the ultimate car crash simulator!

Smash, crash, and customize your vehicles in a giant open-world sandbox. Experience realistic damage - watch doors fly off, hoods crumple, and wheels pop off in brutal crashes.

Drive through zones packed with destruction tools:

Discover new cars roaming the world and make each one yours with tuning:

Whether you're here to break stuff, perform insane stunts, or just roam free - it's your playground of metal and madness.

games.title: Backgammon
games.description: Discover the captivating game of Backgammon, where strategy and skill are key. Navigate your pieces to eliminate them before your rival does. Enjoy playing this timeless game online for free on your device, and strive to become a Backgammon champion!

games.title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
games.description:
ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang is a casual food game where you are the star of a mukbang stream. You get to enjoy delicious dishes, interact with your audience, and grow your popularity with every bite, all on camera! Each meal takes you closer to becoming even more popular, so keep eating, keep engaging, and watch your virtual foodie journey unfold.
How to Play ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
Relaxing, fun, and super engaging, ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang lets you enjoy cooking, eating, and styling in a way that’s not only entertaining but also rewarding. Keep streaming, earning, and upgrading to become the most popular mukbang star! Become a livestream star with your channel, serving up drinks, dishes, and endless ASMR satisfaction. There are a few livestreams that you’ll participate in to get as many likes and hearts as possible from your fans.
Curate Your Stream
Start with a drink, pick your glass from thin-rimmed, stemmed, and rounded, and then add ice cubes in shapes from classic squares to cute bears. Garnish with fruits like lime, kiwi, or raspberry (some unlock as you earn rewards). Choose your syrup, give it a shake, add a straw, and get ready to sip your way into livestream fame. But beware — a boring drink could mean negative feedback!
Dig In on Camera
Once the drinks are done, move on to food. Eat tempura, sundaes, ramen, chicken, lobster, and even mix them in one stream for bigger rewards. The more fun and satisfying the experience, the more your audience grows. Once your food is ready, it’s time to go live! Eat, chat, and interact with your viewers as you enjoy the food. Your realistic ASMR sounds will make the experience feel so satisfying that your viewers won’t want to miss a moment. Engage with fans and watch your audience grow!
Go to the Supermarket
Start by shopping for ingredients, then move on to cooking mouth-watering dishes! From spicy noodles to delicious seafood and even sweet treats, the possibilities are endless. Prepare a meal that will make your audience hungry for more! For some of your livestreams, you get to shop for snacks and treats like sushi, dumplings, candy, and ice cream, but don’t get brain freeze! Pay with your card, stock up, and get ready to stream again.
Cook, Stream, and Engage
Shop for ingredients, cook delicious meals, then go live. Eat, chat, and interact while your realistic ASMR sounds keep viewers hooked. Successful streams bring in money. Spend it on stylish outfits for your character, or unlock even more mouth-watering food to keep your audience entertained.
If you’re a livestream fan, this game can get quite addictive. The more successful your streams, the more money you make. Use your earnings to upgrade your girl’s outfits, giving her a stylish and trendy appearance. You can also buy even more delicious food to satisfy your growing audience and keep the mukbang going!


Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, move the mouse to rotate.
Mobile: Tap on buttons, swipe your finger to rotate.

Key Features:
• Plenty of Food: Discover a wide variety of dishes to suit every taste! Try them all and showcase them to your audience!
• Interactive: Visit restaurants for delicious treats or head to the supermarket to pick out your favorite dishes. Scan items at the checkout and pay with your card! And that's not all. You can even prepare some delicacies yourself! Skewer fruits and berries and coat them in caramel glaze. A perfect dessert for your mukbang!
• Decorate Your Home: Choose furniture, flooring, walls, and other details for your home! Mukbangs need to be filmed in a cozy setting!

Game Modes:
• Dining: Head to a café and select delicacies for your mukbang!
• Minimart: Go shopping at the supermarket! Pick something tasty and showcase it on your stream!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: You play as a mukbang streamer! Eat delicacies live on stream, gain new subscribers and likes, enjoy new tasty treats, and build your popularity with your audience!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: A plethora of delicious options! You’ll find a variety of tasty dishes here, from sweets and drinks to hot fish or meat dishes. Takoyaki, onigiri, caramel-coated berries, and much more—there will definitely be plenty to eat on your stream and show to your viewers!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game flows seamlessly. Days pass one after another, and with each new day, your subscribers will grow, and you'll earn more money!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new foods and modes. Surprise your viewers with new dishes, and of course, try them out yourself!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?
A: Purchase new food at the store, but you can also visit restaurants to choose treats there! You can even make drinks and some desserts yourself!

Q: Are there skins/customization options?
A: Your viewers will love to see you in new outfits. Choose a costume from the skin shop and stream your mukbang in style! You can also change not just your character's skin but also the table or walls in your room! Diversify your background!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Right from the start, you will make drinks for your first mukbang! Pour a cocktail of your choice, add selected ingredients, mix well, and see what you’ve created!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily tasks / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: Yes! Spin the wheel of fortune and win prizes! You won’t be disappointed. You’re sure to get something worthwhile!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play as you like. But with sound, you’ll immerse yourself better in the cozy atmosphere of the game!

Q: What achievements are there and how can you earn them?
A: Stream and post updates, collect clips from your mukbangs, and cherish the wonderful moments!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: The game is intuitive from the first seconds. It will guide you through all the mechanics and show you how to play without unnecessary text.

games.title: Arrow Exit Puzzle

🔓 Unlock your logic with Arrow Away!

In this addictive arrow puzzle, you must use your IQ to navigate through complex boards. Whether you call it a brain teaser or a logic game, the goal is simple: clear the board by tapping arrows in the right order. 💡

games.title: Basketball Stars

Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen. Once fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you stand; it never fails. Be the best player!

games.title: Snake 2048

Start with a small cube. Eat small snakes and dodge strong ones. Become a giant!

In the game you will find:
- a lot of fun
- simple and responsive controls

- hefty opponents
- competition for leadership
- two difficulty levels

games.title: Gym Simulator Online, Escape
games.description:
Imagine a Gym Simulator Online where you wake up locked inside a massive escape fortress — a place where only the STRONGEST survive. No boring workouts — only insane muscle gains, real-time body growth, and epic online battles for the title of ultimate champion!

Your goal in this escape gym simulator is simple: become so huge that you literally smash through the castle walls and defeat every boss in your way. Bench press, lift kettlebells, crush dumbbells — and watch your character instantly bulk up and grow right before your eyes.

What awaits you: • Explosive visual growth — you literally GET BIGGER after every training session. • Online competitions — prove to your friends you’re a machine, not a human. • Ranking system — rise from rookie to mythical titan. • Tons of skins, hairstyles, and wings — become unstoppable. • Pets from eggs — collect powerful boosters and train X10 faster.

This is a game where progress is not just numbers — you SEE it. Every tap makes you stronger. You don’t grind… you DOMINATE.

Ready to be the one who breaks through the castle walls and enters the legends? Start your transformation right now!

Controls:
Desktop: WASD / arrows, space - jump, click to select option;  
Mobile: virtual joystick, virtual jump button, tap to select option  

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Power Points: Earned through training. Can be spent on skins. The amount of power points affects the damage dealt with each hit when battling bosses.  
• Trophies: Earned through boss fights. Can be spent on pets. Required to advance to the next level.  

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: You find yourself trapped in a world where the most important thing is to enhance your strength through various training. Defeat all the bosses to gain the opportunity to move to the next level.  

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?  
A: Simple controls, clear achievements, and the ability to buy different pets. The tutorial is presented in a gentle mentoring style, and there are no strict requirements on how to develop your character: build your own strategy by combining different types of training.  

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: New difficulty levels, training loads, and pets unlock as you progress, allowing for faster advancement.  

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Choose combinations of training and pay close attention to the Wheel of Fortune, which allows you to quickly earn a large number of trophies or power points.  

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: You can buy:  
- pets: regular or more exclusive  
- skins for character customization  
- VIP status, granting access to more skins and faster progress accumulation.  

Q: Are there skins/customization options?  
A: You can change your character's clothing and hairstyle, as well as add wings.  

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily tasks/wheel of fortune/achievements/tasks?  
A: The Wheel of Fortune: provides the opportunity to quickly earn a lot of power points or trophies.  

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?  
A: Onboarding introduces the player to the types of training, guides them through the scenario of their first victories, and helps them quickly get oriented in the game.

games.title: Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting
games.description:
Welcome to Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting — a relaxing puzzle game where colorful crystals gradually transform into beautiful sparkling pictures.
Sort the gems by color and place them into the matching cells. With every correct move, the image becomes brighter and more complete. Simple controls, satisfying gameplay, and a calm atmosphere make each level enjoyable and easy to play.

- Select a crystal and identify its color.
- Move it to a matching cell on the board.
- Use the storage area when the required cell is blocked.
- Plan your moves to avoid filling the storage slots.
- Use hints or boosters when you need help.
- Place all crystals correctly to complete the picture!

games.title: Build an Aquapark
games.description:
🎢 Welcome to the craziest water park! 💦

Build your own dream water slide and ride it at full speed! Buy parts, combine them however you like, and create the longest, fastest, and craziest tracks in the game.

games.title: Sprunki Sandbox: Ragdoll Playground Mode
games.description: Sprunki Sandbox: Ragdoll Playground Mode is a game with destruction, combat, construction, weapons and explosives! Your freedom, your rules!

games.title: Mahjong Puzzle: Tile Match
games.description: Mahjong Puzzle: Tile Match is a soothing yet brain-teasing tile-matching game where you clear the board by linking identical tiles in smart rows and columns. You study every layout, spot hidden patterns, and plan each move ahead. As difficulty rises, you test your focus, relax your mind, and sharpen your puzzle-solving instincts.

games.title: Hidden Objects: Island
games.description: Step into the world of hidden secrets and surprises, where every location tells a story. From serene beaches and tranquil Japanese gardens to magical flying houses and rustic fishing villages, this game takes you to breathtaking destinations. Uncover the secrets behind each scene as you search and find hidden objects, solve the puzzles and collect rare treasures!

games.title: Bubble Shooter: Tap & Pop
games.description: Play Bubble Shooter: Tap & Pop – a thrilling bubble-shooting game with exciting levels, upgrades, and bonuses! Test your skills, pop bubbles, and enjoy nonstop fun in this addictive puzzle adventure.

games.title: Plants vs Zombies Hybrids
games.description:
A new era of Plants vs. Zombies has arrived — blending the best of the old with exciting new mechanics.

Build your defenses like never before by creating hybrid plants, each combining the abilities of multiple classic plants. With these powerful crossbreeds at your command, you'll face smarter, stronger, and more devious zombie hordes.

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse — select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger — select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Combine Plants: Merge different plants to create unique species with their own abilities and appearances. This will significantly boost your defense against the undead!
• Cheats!: You can purchase plants for your defense during gameplay using sun points. Don’t worry about running out of plants. Just hit the Cheats button and get a ton of sun points instantly without limits!
• Various Zombies: You will face many zombies, and some may surprise you. Be well-prepared for their arrival!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points: Earn them from sunflowers or simply collect them during levels. You can use them to buy plants during battles. Press the Cheats button to get an unlimited amount!
• Dollars: Collect them during levels and purchase items in the shop or new challenges!

Game Modes:
• Adventure: The basic mode. Here, you will progress through levels one after another, fending off waves of zombies eager to invade your home. Each level will be more challenging, with larger and more dangerous waves of the undead!
• Challenges: Test yourself in various challenges! Play as a zombie or, for example, take on the glove challenge! And that’s not all. You can also buy new challenges with in-game currency.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Cactus: The sniper in your garden! Shoots spikes directly at zombies. A fantastic marksman!
• Squash: One jump on a zombie — and it’s gone! A great option for quickly eliminating the undead!

Enemies / Bosses:
• Backup Dancer: He runs straight for the plants with a pole and jumps over the first plants. This could be a problem for you!
• Pea Shooter: Zombies can shoot too! Instead of a head, he has a living pea, and this plant is definitely not on your side. Destroy this zombie quickly!

Story / Setting:
The world is overrun by zombies! They are everywhere. Only your home and garden remain safe, but the zombies won’t let that stand. Protect your home from the undead with living plants!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Build a defense with living plants and protect your home from hordes of zombies that have taken over this world! Combine plants to create an effective defense and merge them together to obtain unique species!

Q: How do you win / what constitutes a loss?  
A: Don’t let the zombies breach your defense and invade your home! Destroy all waves of the undead attacking you!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?  
A: A vast array of plants and different types of zombies! Each plant has its own abilities and unique appearance! Meanwhile, zombies can have their own capabilities too. An epic battle will unfold right in your garden!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: Levels follow one after another, and each can differ in features and appearance. In some, you will even have to fight at night!

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each level will be harder. Zombies will be better prepared, and with each new wave, there will be more of them! Combine plants, strategize, and fend off the attacks!

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: You have a Cheats button. Press it and get as many sun points as you want! With sun points, you can buy plants for defense right in the level. Build your defense without limits!

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: New levels with different conditions and constantly increasing difficulty will unlock for you, and you will also be able to open new levels in challenge mode!

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?  
A: Head to the shop and purchase bonuses, such as a shovel — with it, you can dig up unwanted plants, a skin pack for plants, and other useful bonuses and items!

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Dress your plants in skins. Defending against the undead should also be stylish!

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: Most plants in the game are available from the start. You can immediately build a powerful defense with strong plants and merge them together!

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Collect daily rewards for a full 50 days! Each day in the game, you will be delighted with new rewards for an extended period. It’s always nice to return to the game when a gift awaits you!

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: Sound is not mandatory, but if you turn it on, you can hear the legendary music and immerse yourself in the zombie apocalypse world.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: Everything will become clear right away. You will be taught how to play, and you will quickly get into the process.

games.title: Kick Lucky Blocks Online
games.description:
Kick Lucky Blocks Online is a colorful progression adventure built around distance, upgrades, and reward hunting. Your objective is to kick lucky blocks across expanding arenas, chase them through dangerous areas, and return safely with valuable rewards before tsunamis flood the map. The farther the lucky block travels, the better your chances of unlocking rare Brainrots and high-tier lucky boxes.

Every run creates a balance between risk and reward. Some players focus on safe farming and consistent upgrades, while others push deeper into dangerous zones searching for stronger Brainrots and limited rewards. The game keeps progression active by constantly opening new areas, upgrades, and collection goals.

Explore and Collect
More than 75 Brainrot characters can be discovered throughout 14 unique areas. Different zones contain different reward pools, making later arenas much more valuable but also more dangerous. Brainrots appear in multiple variants including Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Toxic, Lava, Candy, and more.

The rarity system ranges from Common and Rare all the way to Celestial, Divine, Ascended, Eternal, Omniversal, and Supreme tiers. Some of the rarest Brainrots only appear during events or special moments, encouraging players to keep improving their routes and upgrades.

Upgrade Your Power
Players can improve kick distance using weights, increase movement speed, rebirth for higher income rates, and expand their base with more floors and storage slots. Stronger upgrades help players reach deeper destinations and return safely with more rewards.

Managing progression becomes an important part of the experience. Choosing when to spend currency, rebirth, or risk deeper arenas can completely change the pace of future runs.

Online and Local Multiplayer
The online mode is available in solo play and supports chat, room joining, and player invites. Local 2-player mode allows two players to compete or progress together on the same device, creating a more social experience.

Customization and Live Events
Character customization includes clothes, wings, hats, glasses, and different bag styles. Live events such as Diamond Rain, Rainbow, Toxic, Volcano, and Candy events regularly introduce better rewards and rare Brainrot opportunities.

Why the Game Feels Rewarding
Kick Lucky Blocks Online combines simple controls with satisfying progression. Every kick can unlock stronger rewards, better areas, and faster growth. Between collection mechanics, survival moments, upgrades, and replayable runs, the game delivers a fun gameplay loop that stays engaging over time.

games.title: Golf Orbit
games.description:
Golf Orbit is an exciting golf simulator game within sports category where you aim to launch golf balls to incredible heights, even reaching Mars. Have fun in one-shot golf battles, complete challenging levels, and master the art of the perfect shot. Compete to become the golf king in this entertaining and unique golfing adventure.

Core: A vibrant and highly accessible casual sports title centered on the fundamentals of golf.
Loop: Player skill is directly rewarded with in-game currency for successful long-range shots, facilitating a clear progression path through continuous gear upgrades.
Start: The game features highly intuitive controls and is immediately engaging, supported by a robust system of mini-quests to drive early-game retention.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a polished Stylized / Cartoon art direction, providing an appealing and universally pleasant visual experience.
Key Feature: Offers an enjoyable blend of satisfying gameplay challenge coupled with eye-catching, high-quality graphics.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons and move the cursor.
Mobile: Tap buttons with your finger, drag your finger across the screen.

Key Features:
• Hit Accurately! : Try to hit the green indicator for a stronger shot and to make the ball fly further!
• Hit the Green Zones! : Did you hit the green zone? Great! Now take another shot!
• Obstacles on the Field! : Hit harder to make the ball fly higher! There can be various obstacles on the field, like trees, rocks, or even someone's house...

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Go play golf! Hit the ball as far as possible and try to get it into the holes.

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Get the ball into the holes or the green zones, then take another shot. Aim more accurately to avoid missing, or you'll have to start over!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?
A: Try to hit the green section on the indicator when you take a shot. This way, you can hit harder, and your ball will fly further!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?
A: Upgrade your abilities: ball flight speed, shot power, and more. Get better and hit the target directly!

games.title: Soccer Random
games.description:
Soccer Random is a funny physics-based soccer game where every match feels unpredictable from the first kick. Instead of following the style of a serious football simulation, it turns soccer into a fast, chaotic, and easy-to-play challenge built around one-button controls. Your goal is simple: jump, kick, defend, and try to score before your opponent reaches the winning number of goals. The rules are clear, but the movement is never fully predictable, which is what makes each round so entertaining.

The game uses ragdoll-style character movement, so players do not run, turn, or shoot in a traditional way. They bounce, fall, stretch, and swing toward the ball with awkward timing. A perfect-looking attack can suddenly miss, while a strange jump may turn into an unexpected goal. This mix of timing, reaction, and random physics gives Soccer Random its playful identity. It is easy to understand in seconds, but every match still creates surprising moments.

One of the strongest parts of Soccer Random is how the game changes between rounds. The field, players, weather-like conditions, ball behavior, and match rhythm can shift after a goal. You may play on a regular soccer field in one round, then face a slippery or unusual setup in the next. These random changes keep the experience fresh and stop the matches from feeling repetitive. Players must quickly adapt instead of relying on the same move every time.

Soccer Random can be played alone against the CPU, but it becomes even more enjoyable in local 2-player mode. Two players can share the same device and compete in short, messy football duels where both sides are dealing with the same unpredictable movement. Because the controls are simple, the match stays focused on timing, quick reactions, and funny mistakes rather than complicated button combinations.

The pixel art style gives the game a clean, retro look that fits well with its arcade feeling. The visuals are simple enough to keep the action easy to follow, while the strange animations make every goal, save, and missed kick more memorable. A small bounce, a late jump, or an accidental block can completely change the result of a round.

For players who enjoy quick soccer games, local 2-player challenges, and funny sports games with random physics, Soccer Random offers a light but highly replayable experience. It works well for short sessions because the matches start quickly, the goal is always clear, and every round can produce a new kind of chaos. Whether you are trying to beat the CPU or challenge a friend, Soccer Random keeps football simple, strange, and entertaining from one goal to the next.

A: The game features free progression. Thanks to the cheat feature, you can give yourself as much currency as you want. With it, you can buy plants to defend your garden, so there are no barriers to how many plants you want to purchase.

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: You can buy bonuses and skins in the game. For example, a time acceleration x3 or a skin for a plant.

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Yes, you can purchase various skins for your plants in the game.

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: Most plants in the game are available from the start, allowing for great opportunities for unique combinations from the first levels.

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: You can play without sound. The game is intuitive, so sound is not essential. However, with sound, you will immerse yourself better in the world.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: Yes, there is a brief tutorial at the beginning that provides basic knowledge. It does not overwhelm with information. After that, you immediately start playing a level, testing your knowledge in practice and discovering new possibilities.

games.title: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake
games.description:
Join the enchanting world of Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake, an engaging game that combines puzzle-solving with café management. Explore a beautiful mansion, uncover family secrets, and help Emily grow her café into a culinary empire. Enjoy this unique experience for free on your phone or computer.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, drag items.
Mobile: Tap buttons, drag items with your finger.

Key Features:
• Expand your cooking table! : Combine ingredients and find matches on the table. Merge and expand your territory! This way, you can cook more masterpieces!
• Combine ingredients! : Want to create something more complex than a sandwich? Great! Combine ingredients to unlock increasingly complex dishes.
• Restore the café! : Restore the café and other areas with the money you earn. An incredibly engaging process where you’ll see progress at every stage!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• 21 maps
• Café. : Your grandfather's café has fallen into disrepair. Why be sad when you can restore it and make it better than before? Get to work!
• Café facade. : You've done well inside the café, great! But the facade also needs repairs, it's time to work on that too!

Story / Setting:
You've come to your grandfather's café in the countryside. Unfortunately, it has long been abandoned. Once a popular spot, it's now your task to restore it and make it even better!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Revive your grandfather's café and breathe new life into its walls! Cook delicacies for visitors and develop your kitchen by unlocking new dishes!

Q: Is there a story?
A: You lived in a big city, but you had to return. Your grandfather had an old café, but sadly, it has fallen into disrepair. Help restore it and make it better than before! You will encounter new characters—delight them with your tasty treats!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?
A: Pleasant graphics, everything looks cozy and warm. It's especially satisfying to watch the progress of the café's reconstruction. With each amount earned, you can repair and upgrade your café and move on to other locations! With each new stage, you will see progress.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game features a total of 21 locations! You will restore them one by one, cooking food and drinks. Each location is unique with its own distinct style and theme.

Q: How can I level up faster?
A: Combine ingredients to get new ones. Expand your cooking table to hold more ingredients. Upgrade your kitchen tools to cook more efficiently!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?
A: As you play, you will expand your table, allowing you to accommodate more ingredients for cooking. You will also upgrade your kitchen setup, receiving new equipment. But you won't be limited to just the kitchen. New locations will unlock as you progress through the game!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?
A: Upgrade the café and other locations. And don't forget about kitchen tools. With them, you can cook more delicious food!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: You start with an abandoned coffee shop and gradually, step by step, restore it. It's very engaging to watch life return to a once-popular place!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play anywhere and even without sound if that suits you better.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: From the first missions, the game will show you what to do and how to do it. Additionally, hints will guide you in moments where you might miss something. But don’t worry, you’ll understand everything quickly!
